raw.excerpt: DescriptionOverview We are looking for a Client Success Manager (Performance Marketing) to join our growing global team.
raw.description:
Description

Overview

We are looking for a Client Success Manager (Performance Marketing) to join our growing global team. In this role, you will own a portfolio of client accounts end-to-end: setting account strategy, guiding success plans tied to business KPIs, driving growth opportunities, and proactively managing retention and risk. Your portfolio will include paid media-driven accounts as well as SEO-focused accounts. The ideal candidate combines marketing strategy thinking with strong client communication, ties every decision to client ROI, and can lead cross-functional specialists (Paid Search, Paid Social, SEO, DSP, Creative, Analytics) toward clear priorities and outcomes.

This is a remote role open to candidates willing to work US business hours.

Responsibilities

  • Own account strategy and success planning: define goals, KPIs, priorities, and quarterly roadmaps with each client.
  • Lead client relationship and communication: run recurring meetings, manage stakeholders, align expectations from day one, and document next steps.
  • Drive account performance management: interpret results against business metrics (ROAS, CPA, CAC vs. LTV, organic growth), identify issues and opportunities, and coordinate actions with channel owners.
  • Identify and scope account growth opportunities: expansions, tests, and new initiatives tied to performance signals and client objectives.
  • Manage account health, retention, renewal, and risk: flag risks early, create mitigation plans, and ensure consistent value delivery across a multi-client portfolio.

Why Join Finch

  • Work globally, stay flexible: Join a fully distributed team across the US, LATAM, Europe, and APAC.
  • Meaningful impact from day one: Your work directly influences client outcomes and how Finch grows.
  • A culture built on curiosity, transparency, and ownership: We share context and empower people to make decisions.
  • High-caliber teammates: Collaborate with specialists in Paid Search, Paid Social, SEO, DSP, Creative, Analytics, and more.
  • Learning as a default: We encourage experimentation, cross-training, and growth as the company scales.
  • Real work-life balance: We value high performance, not overwork.

Requirements

We’re looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience as an Account Manager or Client Success Manager in a performance marketing or digital marketing agency (required).
  • Acted as the primary point of contact (POC) for multiple client accounts simultaneously (required).
  • Strong understanding of performance marketing fundamentals: paid advertising, attribution, KPIs, and optimization logic (required).
  • Experience working with paid advertising-driven accounts across Paid Search, Paid Social, and Programmatic/DSP (required).
  • Proven track record of improving client retention or growing accounts, with concrete examples (required).
  • Fluent English, written and spoken, and comfortable leading strategic conversations with senior client stakeholders (required).
  • Availability to work with consistent overlap with US business hours. (required)
  • Background managing SEO-driven accounts or hands-on SEO experience (advantage).
  • Experience working with US or international clients (advantage).

raw.description:
The Junior Media Buyer at Mynt Agency is an entry-level role supporting the media team with day-to-day operations across audio and video channels. This position is ideal for someone detail-oriented and eager to learn the inner workings of media buying, with a primary focus on podcast and other audio placements. You will work closely with senior buyers, account managers, and clients to keep campaigns running smoothly and on time.

What Makes a Good Fit

    Mynt is built for driven intrapreneurs who treat their work like they own it. We move fast, hold a high bar, and push each other forward with genuine support and positivity, never pressure. If you're ambitious, growth-minded, and energized by a team that wins together, you'll thrive here.

About Mynt Agency

    Mynt helps growth brands turn video and audio into measurable acquisition channels. We plan, buy, and measure across CTV, linear TV, YouTube, podcasts, streaming audio, and radio, with a specific focus on using premium media more efficiently than traditional agencies and proving the business impact through attribution, lift testing, and incrementality. We work with amazing brands including Oats Overnight, Grüns, Liquid Death, Prenuvo, and many more.

    The broader Mynt story is simple: we have generated $3bn+ in incremental client revenue, have 5.5+ years of average client tenure, and average 4x ROAS on evergreen campaigns. We are not a generic media agency. We focus on helping brands find solutions for incremental scale, especially when search and social are becoming expensive, saturated, or insufficient for the next stage of growth.

Data Entry & Administrative Support

    ● Enter and maintain accurate data across media plans, insertion orders, and tracking spreadsheets
    ● Input and update campaign details in internal systems and trafficking tools
    ● Compile and organize post logs for completed campaigns across audio and video placements
    ● Assist with maintaining accuracy across all contracts, insertion orders, and campaign documents

Creative Briefs, Scripts & Talking Points

    ● Prepare creative briefs for audio and video campaigns based on client goals and campaign details
    ● Draft podcast host-read scripts and talking points for client-approved endorsements
    ● Coordinate with clients and account managers to gather key messaging, product details, and brand voice guidance
    ● Revise and refine scripts and talking points based on client feedback
Qualifications:
Required:
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work/internship experience
• 0–2 years of experience in a coordinator, assistant, or administrative role (media/advertising experience a plus)
• Familiarity with audio advertising: podcast, digital streaming and radio
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and PowerPoint
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy
• Solid time management and prioritization skills
Preferred:
• Exposure to media buying, advertising, or ad operations
• Familiarity with CTV and Linear TV
• Agency experience or internship
• In-platform experience with DSPs, Innovid and Core Systems
• Interest in performance marketing and data-driven media

raw.description:
Role: Technical Product Manager/Owner - Partnerships

Mission

Own the product side of QuintAce's partner integrations (Club WPT Gold, WPT Global, WePoker, and future partners) and drive cross-team feature delivery between CAI, AceCoach, and Data Science. Serve as the connective tissue that turns partner requests and new-feature ideas into shipped product across all three teams.

Must-haves

Native/fluent Mandarin Chinese(spoken + written) — many partners are CN-based or CN-speaking

Fluent English— internal teams and Western partners

3+ years as a Product Manager / Product Owner / Technical Project

Manager, ideally with B2B partner or platform integration experience

Hands-on prototyping— must independently build clickable prototypes (Figma, Claude Code, or similar) to align partners and internal teams on integration UX and new-feature flows. Non-negotiable; we don't want someone who needs a designer for every mock.

Strong spec-writing: user stories, acceptance criteria, integration contracts, API requirements

Technical fluency: reads API docs, understands data flows, can talk credibly to engineers

Strong cross-team facilitation skills — can run a meeting with CAI, AceCoach, and DS in the same room and walk out with clear decisions and owners

Excellent partner-management instincts — managing expectations, scoping requests, saying "no" diplomatically

Comfortable across time zones (CN + EU + US)

Nice-to-haves

Background in poker, gaming, or fintech— familiarity with the poker operator landscape (WPT, GG, partypoker, etc.) is a strong plus

Prior experience owning multiple concurrent B2B integrations

Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Slack

Exposure to data pipelines / analytics / AI-ML products

Day-to-day

Partner-facing: primary contact for partners — gather requirements, manage requests, run weekly/biweekly syncs

Cross-team product delivery: drive new features that span CAI, AceCoach, and DS — write specs, align stakeholders, sequence delivery, track progress

Build click-dummies to pressure-test integration UX and new-feature flows before engineering starts

Translate partner needs and internal feature ideas into Jira tickets and roadmaps

Coordinate cross-team delivery; unblock dependencies; escalate risks early

Own QA / UAT sign-off and partner go-live readiness

Maintain a clean backlog across live partners and in-flight cross-team features

Salary: 60,000 - 65,000 USD

raw.title: Director, VIP Experience & Loyalty
raw.excerpt: At PrizePicks, we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc.
raw.description:
At PrizePicks, we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc. 5000. As the leading platform for Daily Fantasy Sports, we cover a diverse range of sports leagues, including the NFL, NBA, and Esports titles like League of Legends and Counter-Strike. Our team of over 550 employees thrives in an inclusive culture that values individuals from diverse backgrounds, regardless of their level of sports fandom. Ready to reimagine the DFS industry together?

PrizePicks Most Value Player (MVP) program is intended to ensure the most engaged players enjoy a high quality experience with our brand and product, inspiring loyalty as they enjoy the action and excitement of our leading product portfolio. We are seeking a strategic and people-driven Director, MVP to lead our high-performing MVP team. This leader will be responsible for growing, engaging, and retaining our most engaged users. This leader sets a high bar for partnership management, operational execution, and people leadership. They bring structure to complex work, non-negotiable responsibility and operational standards, make sound decisions with incomplete information, communicate clearly across stakeholders, and create an environment where the team can deliver a consistent, trusted, and differentiated MVP experience. You will implement and lead customer engagement strategies, oversee a team of MVP relationship managers, and work cross-functionally with product, marketing, compliance, and analytics teams to ensure a best-in-class experience for our top users.

What you’ll do:

Set the MVP strategy and business plan

  • Own and evolve the MVP strategy, including player segmentation, tier design, service model, and engagement principles across the player lifecycle - across all products.
  • Develop an annual roadmap and operating plan that connects MVP initiatives to retention, engagement, lifetime value, and responsible gaming objectives.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities to improve the MVP experience through personalized outreach, rewards, exclusive access, events, and product or service enhancements.
  • Establish clear decision frameworks for investments, offers, experiences, and escalations, balancing player impact, commercial value, and regulatory requirements.
  • Communicate and present to the executive leadership team on a regular basis.

Lead and develop a high performing team

  • Lead, coach, and develop MVP Managers and Player Representatives, creating clear expectations for leadership, relationship management, and operational excellence.
  • Set team goals, service standards, performance measures, and capacity plans; use performance trends to improve execution and develop talent.
  • Build scalable playbooks, training, quality standards, escalation protocols, and knowledge-sharing routines that enable consistent, high-quality player experiences.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, sound judgment, collaboration, discretion, and responsible gaming stewardship.

Own the MVP player experience

  • Design and oversee high-touch engagement strategies that anticipate player needs, strengthen loyalty, and address churn risk before it materializes.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for sensitive or complex MVP matters, ensuring thoughtful resolution and appropriate cross-functional coordination.
  • Ensure the program delivers a consistent and differentiated experience across digital touchpoints, service interactions, rewards, and live experiences.
  • Use player feedback and relationship-manager insights to identify friction, improve service design, and advocate for the MVP player perspective.
  • Have overview and ownership of the entire end-to-end MVP experience

Drive cross functional execution

  • Partner with RevOps and CRM teams to translate MVP strategy into targeted lifecycle campaigns, communications, and engagement journeys.
  • Work with Product and Analytics to improve the MVP holistic offering and journeys, our understanding of players, product requirements, outcome assessments, and convert insights into scalable solutions.
  • Collaborate with Customer Support to align service expectations, handoffs, and escalation practices for top-tier players.
  • Partner closely with Compliance and Legal to ensure player interactions, rewards, communications, and events are executed in accordance with applicable requirements and company policies.

Manage performance and continuous improvement

  • Define and monitor a balanced scorecard of program and team performance, including retention, engagement, churn, lifetime value, player satisfaction, operational quality, and responsible gaming indicators.
  • Translate data and qualitative insights into clear recommendations for senior leaders, with an emphasis on impact, tradeoffs, risks, and next steps.
  • Collaborate cross-function to lead testing & measurement of new MVP initiatives; scale successful programs and discontinue approaches that do not create sufficient value.
  • Establish disciplined operating rhythms for planning, forecasting, reporting, issue management, and stakeholder communication.

What you have:

  • 10+ years of experience in high-value player management, customer success, loyalty, CRM, retention, or customer experience, ideally within gaming, sports betting or DFS.
  • 4+ years of progressive people leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to build, coach, and retain high-performing teams.
  • Proven success developing and executing customer engagement or loyalty strategies that improve retention, engagement, and lifetime value.
  • Strong commercial and analytical judgment, with experience using player or customer data to identify opportunities, measure impact, and make decisions.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, product, analytics, customer support, compliance, and legal stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present to and influence senior stakeholders and build trusted relationships with high-value players.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, segmentation, loyalty programs, and performance reporting. Familiarity with responsible gaming practices is strongly preferred.
  • Unrelenting passion for delivering exceptional player experiences.
  • A passion for sports, fantasy sports, and/or iGaming is a plus.

Where you’ll live:

  • While we prefer candidates based in Atlanta, we are open to qualified applicants from anywhere in the U.S. and are willing to consider remote candidates.

Working at PrizePicks:

The typical salary range for this position is $140,000 to $180,000. At PrizePicks, we consider your role, level, and where you'll be working when determining our salary ranges. The compensation info you see on our job postings gives you an idea of the starting pay range for the position. Your actual pay within that range will depend on your specific work location, as well as your skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter will be happy to chat more about the specific pay range for your location and how we arrived at it during the hiring process.

This application period will remain open for 30 days. We’re committed to finding the best candidate, so this date may be adjusted, and any changes will be reflected in this posting.

Date Posted: 10/16/2026

Benefits you’ll receive:

In addition to your great compensation package, full-time employees will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Company-subsidized medical, dental, & vision plans
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Annual bonus
  • Flexible PTO to encourage a healthy work/life balance (2 weeks STRONGLY encouraged!)
  • Generous paid leave programs, including 16-week paid parental leave and disability benefits
  • Workplace flexibility and modern work schedules focused on getting the job done, not hours clocked
  • Company-wide in-person events and team outings
  • Lifestyle enhancement program
  • Company equipment provided (Windows & Mac options)
  • Annual performance reviews with opportunities for growth and career development

You must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

PrizePicks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.


Join NVIDIA, an established leader in computer graphics, personal computer gaming, and high-performance computing for over 25 years. We are embarking on a new era fueled by AI. We are in search of a remarkable Automotive Performance Senior Software Engineer to join our energetic team. You will participate in groundbreaking projects that drive technology and innovation forward. Our team values cooperation, and your work will impact leading performance solutions in the automotive industry.


What you'll be doing:

  • Play a key role in optimizing system software for NVIDIA automotive performance platforms with Safe RTOS.
  • Collaborate closely with Hardware Architecture, DriveOS, Power, and Test teams to track key boot & runtime performance benchmarks.
  • Ensure the software and hardware meet projected targets by closely supervising micro benchmarks and industry-standard benchmarks across IPs.
  • Contribute to developing innovative features in automotive profiling tools with AI assistance.
  • Benchmark the hypervisor and ensure the lowest overhead on ARM systems.
  • Collaborate with the ADAS/AV team in optimizing the next-gen stack from NVIDIA on Tegra platforms.

What we need to see:

  • Master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of proven experience in systems or software performance.
  • Solid C/C++ programming abilities accompanied by previous experience in the automotive sector.
  • Proficiency in Linux and QNX; Knowledge of Android is advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Solid understanding of Benchmarking, boot time optimization, compiler optimizations and runtime performance improvements.
  • Knowledge of hypervisors, virtualization, and overhead analysis.
  • Experience working with profiling utilities to improve system software efficiency.
  • AI/ML experience is highly desirable.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD for Level 3, and 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 27, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

raw.excerpt: About MPLC MPLC is the legal way to show movies and TV in public or commercial spaces across the globe.
raw.description:
About MPLC
MPLC is the legal way to show movies and TV in public or commercial spaces across the globe. For over 30 years, we’ve been the trusted partner to major Hollywood studios, independent producers, and the wider creative ecosystem, ensuring content creators are paid fairly and organisations respect copyright.

About Global Technology Services

GTS is technology at MPLC, all of it. And we are honest about where we are: we are rebuilding and elevating our technology capability, from the ground up and by design. New platforms, new data foundations, new roles: this team is being built for what MPLC becomes, not what it was. You will own real outcomes early, automate the repetitive rather than absorb it, and help shape the rebuild rather than inherit someone else’s. Technology is the engine of how MPLC grows. People are the fuel. AI is the turbocharger. That is where you come in.

The Role in Two Bullet Points
  • Help keep MPLC's global technology estate running smoothly by providing system support, user administration and access management across the business.
  • Build the skills, knowledge and experience needed to progress through our Systems Analyst career pathway, with opportunities to develop into a Systems Analyst role.

Let's be honest

  • This is a hands-on support role and a large part of your day will involve helping colleagues, managing requests and keeping records up to date.
  • Accuracy matters. Access permissions, user accounts and asset records need to be right every time.
  • Some of the work can be repetitive, but we're looking for someone who'll spot opportunities to improve and automate where possible.
  • You'll be expected to follow documented processes and procedures while building your knowledge and experience.
  • This isn't a role where you'll immediately be designing new systems. It's a chance to learn the estate, build credibility and develop into the next step in your career.

If you need more information

We're looking for an IT Support Analyst to join our IT Operations team and help support colleagues across more than 40 countries.

Reporting to the VP of IT Operations, you'll play an important role in the day-to-day running of our technology estate, which includes Salesforce, Microsoft 365, finance systems and a range of business applications. You'll manage support tickets, user access requests, joiner, mover and leaver processes, asset records and a variety of administrative tasks that help keep the business running.

You'll work closely with the Systems Analyst, following established processes and learning how our systems fit together. Over time, you'll build the knowledge and confidence to take on greater responsibility and develop your technical and analytical skills.

This is the first step in our Systems Analyst career pathway. It's designed for someone who enjoys solving problems, likes understanding how systems work and wants to grow their career in technology.

You'll Love This Role If...
  • You have some experience in IT support, a service desk environment, systems administration or a similar role.
  • You're organised, reliable and take pride in getting the details right.
  • You enjoy helping people and communicate clearly and professionally.
  • You're naturally curious about technology and how systems work.
  • You like finding better ways to do things and have an interest in automation.
  • You enjoy solving problems and learning something new every day.
  • You're looking for a role that offers genuine development and progression opportunities.

Benefits

• Salary band: £27,000–£36,000 depending on experience.
• Remote Working with occasional travel.
• 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays
• Private medical insurance (AXA), including dental, optical and 24/7 GP access.
• Life assurance at 3x base salary (Legal & General).
• Salary sacrifice pension with Aviva, 4% employer contribution.

raw.description:
Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.

With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.

About Atos Group

Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.

Join Our Team

We’re looking for an experienced ABM & DBM Marketing Manager to join our UK & Ireland Marketing Team and help Atos win priority accounts and strategic deals.
Sitting within the UK Client Growth Office, you’ll work closely with sales leads, presales specialists, bid directors and account teams. Together, you’ll turn account and deal strategies into tailored campaigns, compelling content and executive engagement that help move opportunities forward.

About the Team

The ABM & DBM team supports Atos’ growth across priority accounts and major deals in the UK. We work alongside sales, presales, bid and account teams to understand each client, identify the right stakeholders and create marketing activity that supports the wider pursuit strategy.

It’s a collaborative and commercially focused environment where marketing is closely connected to revenue. You’ll have the freedom to use your judgement, shape the approach for each account or deal and adapt your activity as the opportunity develops.
This is a growing area of the UK business, and you’ll have the opportunity to help shape how we deliver account- and deal-based marketing in the future.

Key Industries

You’ll support accounts and opportunities across five key industries:
• National Security & Emergency Services

• Health

• Financial Services

  • Critical National Infrastructure

• Manufacturing, Logistics & Retail

Why Join Us

Work on high-profile accounts and deals
You’ll work directly with sales, presales and bid teams on priority accounts and major opportunities, helping Atos strengthen client relationships and improve its position in competitive deals.
Create marketing with a clear purpose
Rather than delivering broad campaigns, you’ll design tailored activity for specific clients and opportunities. This could include personalised content, targeted digital activity, executive briefings or account-level engagement.

Help shape a growing capability

Deal-based marketing is becoming increasingly important to the UK business. You’ll join a growing area where your experience, ideas and judgement will have a visible impact on how the capability develops.

The Opportunity

As our ABM & DBM Marketing Manager, you’ll take ownership of marketing activity for a defined group of priority accounts and live deals.
You’ll use account intelligence, buyer insight and the wider pursuit strategy to decide which stakeholders to engage, what messages will resonate and which channels will have the greatest impact. You’ll then bring the plan to life, working with internal teams, designers, agencies and other delivery partners.
You’ll be trusted to manage your work independently, respond to changing deal requirements and keep activity aligned with sales and bid timelines. Although this is not a formal people-management role, you’ll provide direction and bring different stakeholders together around a clear plan.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop account and deal marketing plans
    Create tailored ABM and DBM plans for priority accounts and live pursuits, using account insight, buyer intelligence and commercial objectives to guide the approach.
    • Work closely with sales, presales and bid teams
    Partner with colleagues to understand the client, buying committee, win themes and deal strategy, ensuring marketing activity supports the wider pursuit.
    • Deliver targeted campaigns and content
    Lead personalised campaigns, including digital activity, executive outreach, client-focused content, briefing materials and account-level engagement.
    • Build strong stakeholder relationships
    Become a trusted marketing partner to senior sales, bid and client-facing stakeholders, bringing clear recommendations and keeping everyone aligned as opportunities develop.
    • Measure impact and optimise future activity
    Track engagement, pipeline influence, and business outcomes at both account and opportunity level. Provide clear, actionable insights to the Growth Marketing Lead and use performance data to continuously refine future campaigns. All results should be measurable, traceable, and directly attributable to marketing activity.

Must-Have Experience

  • Strong B2B marketing experience, with hands-on responsibility for ABM, DBM, strategic pursuit marketing or deal support.
    • Experience designing and delivering personalised 1:1 or 1:few campaigns for named accounts.
    • Experience marketing technology services, digital solutions or similarly complex B2B propositions.
    • A track record of working closely with sales, presales, bid or account teams to support live opportunities.
    • Has built joint account or deal plans with sales or bid teams, working to their timelines rather than a marketing calendar
    • Understands how ABM/DBM contributes to pipeline, revenue and win rate, not just campaign delivery
    • Strong written and verbal communication, adapting style for different audiences
    • Self-driven in keeping up with ABM and MarTech developments
    • Extend the stakeholder bullet to include making timely decisions and taking ownership of outcomes.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience working within technology, professional services or a regulated industry.
    • Familiarity with Marketo, Salesforce, Matomo and LinkedIn Campaign Manager, or similar marketing platforms.
    • Experience supporting partner marketing, co-marketing or co-selling activity.
    • Working knowledge of WordPress, Drupal or a similar content management system.
    • Experience using account intelligence, intent signals and engagement data to inform marketing decisions.

Additional Requirements

• Full right to work in the UK.

  • Eligibility and willingness to obtain SC security clearance.
    • Willingness to travel occasionally for client and internal meetings.
    • Ability to manage several accounts or live pursuits at the same time.

Benefits

  • Pension Scheme, with contributions matched up to 10%

• Private medical cover

• Income Protection

  • Life Assurance
    • 25 days’ annual leave plus public holidays

• Flexible benefits programme

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

We are seeking a highly motivated, energetic, and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong interest in cybersecurity and a proven track record of success in sales or lead generation roles. As a BDR at Chainguard, you will be responsible for prospecting, qualifying leads, and setting appointments for the sales team to help drive revenue growth.

What you’ll do:

  • Prospect and identify potential clients in the security sales market using various lead generation techniques, such as cold calling, emailing, social media outreach, and attending industry events.
  • Conduct thorough research on prospects to identify their specific security needs, pain points, and decision-makers.
  • Generate a consistent pipeline of high-quality leads by meeting or exceeding weekly and monthly targets.
  • Qualify leads by understanding their business requirements and matching them with our security solutions and services.
  • Schedule meetings and product demos for the sales team with qualified prospects.
  • Collaborate with the sales team to develop and implement targeted sales strategies for specific industries, regions, or clients.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of prospects, leads, and customer interactions in the CRM system.
  • Stay current on industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging security technologies to better position our solutions to prospects.
  • Attend sales training sessions and participate in team meetings to continuously improve sales skills and product knowledge.
  • Provide feedback to marketing and product teams based on prospect and customer interactions to help refine messaging and improve product offerings.

What we're looking for:

  • Based in Bangalore or Mumbai
  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
  • 1-3 years of experience in sales, lead generation, or business development, within the cloud native, cybersecurity or devops industry.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and relationships with prospects and clients.
  • Proficiency in using CRM systems, preferably HubSpot CRM or Salesforce, and other sales enablement tools.
  • Excellent research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and able to work independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales targets and KPIs.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts, products, and services is a strong plus.

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
  • We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
  • We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
  • We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

  • Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
  • Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
  • 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
  • ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
  • 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Chainguard will process your personal data in accordance with Chainguard's Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

raw.title: Partner Program Manager
raw.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
raw.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Partner Program Manager.

About the job

As we expand our partner ecosystem to support global growth targets, we are expanding our team to scale responsibly. We are seeking a versatile Partner Program Manager to drive an exceptional experience across our Systems Integrators (SIs), ISVs, Resell, and Technology partners. This balanced role bridges the gap between high-touch partner experience, strategic cross-functional project management, and advanced lifecycle automation. If you have a deep background in partnerships, an AI-forward mindset for process optimization, and hands-on experience with modern ecosystem toolsets, this role offers an exciting opportunity to shape the future of our global network.

In this role, you won't just follow a static blueprint—you will help build it. We are seeking a highly proactive partner program manager to drive exceptional experiences for our Systems Integrators (SIs), ISVs, Resell, and Technology partners. You will take the lead on optimizing the end-to-end partner journey, managing cross-functional projects, and eliminating operational friction.

This position requires a "can-do" attitude and a passion for continuous improvement. You will be responsible for transforming manual workflows into automated, scalable systems, managing key vendor capabilities, and implementing strategic initiatives that directly unlock ecosystem revenue velocity.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Drive Program Modernization & Scale: Act as an operational engine for the team, identifying process bottlenecks and proactively designing new ways to automate existing manual workflows.
  • Own Problem-Solving: Step into complex challenges across the partner lifecycle and chart a clear path forward to build repeatable, programmatic solutions.
  • Optimize the Partner Experience: Lead and refine core partner onboarding pathways, lifecycle touchpoints, and support workflows to deliver a seamless, world-class journey for external ecosystems.
  • Accelerate Partner Revenue Mechanics: Build and execute operational frameworks that eliminate transaction friction, streamline incentive administration, and maximize partner-sourced revenue pipelines.
  • Manage Technology & Vendor Capabilities: Serve as a strategic owner for key components of our partner tech stack and vendor relationships, ensuring our data models and tools are optimized for ecosystem scale rather than mere maintenance.
  • Orchestrate High-Touch Communications: Develop and execute comprehensive partner engagement strategies, ensuring clear, accessible program documentation, impactful updates, and consistent enablement communications across all segments.
  • Lead Cross-Functional Project Execution: Develop and run end-to-end project plans for new partner initiatives, collaborating closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Legal, and Tech teams to ensure alignment and timely milestone delivery.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field; relevant experience may be considered.
  • Experience: 5–8 years of experience in partner program or project management, partner management, strategy and operations, or a similar role within a fast-paced technology company.
  • The "Get-Stuff-Done" Mindset: A proven track record of operating effectively in complex environments, turning ambiguous problems into plans, and delivering results without a rigid instructions script.
  • Project Management & Collaboration: Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage complex cross-functional timelines, align diverse stakeholders, and drive accountability.
  • Communication & Content: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for translating complex program guidelines into clear, compelling partner assets, guides, and updates.

Desired:

  • Ecosystem Acumen: Solid understanding of modern partner program structures, lifecycle methodologies, and experience working with SIs, ISVs, Resell, or Technology tracks.
  • Tech Stack & Automation Familiarity: Hands-on exposure to CRM and partner ecosystem technologies (such as PRMs, account-mapping utilities, or data integration tools) with a strong desire to leverage software and AI to remove manual tasks.
  • Revenue Orientation: Experience designing or supporting commercial program models, referral paths, or joint sales plays that directly drive channel pipelines.
  • Advanced Degree: BA/BS degree or equivalent required. MBA is a plus.

Location

This role will be remote,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $116,960 - $146,200.
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $123,760 - $154,700.
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $137,520 - $171,900.
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 23,2026, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

raw.title: Chef, Formation en santé, Gastroentérologie
raw.excerpt: Vous joindre à AbbVie signifie que vous ferez partie d’une équipe de professionnels exceptionnels qui se sont engagés à avoir un impact remarquable sur la vie des patients.
raw.description:
Vous joindre à AbbVie signifie que vous ferez partie d’une équipe de professionnels exceptionnels qui se sont engagés à avoir un impact remarquable sur la vie des patients. Chez AbbVie, nous effectuons des recherches scientifiques révolutionnaires à l’échelle mondiale au quotidien. AbbVie Canada est l’un des meilleurs lieux de travail au Canada.

Lorsque vous déterminez votre cheminement de carrière, choisissez d’être remarquable.

AbbVie a pour mission de découvrir et d’offrir des médicaments novateurs pour répondre à des besoins importants en matière de santé aujourd’hui et relever les défis médicaux de demain. AbbVie met tout en œuvre afin d’avoir un impact remarquable sur la vie des gens dans divers secteurs thérapeutiques clés, dont l’immunologie, l’oncologie, les neurosciences, les soins de la vue, la virologie, la santé des femmes et la gastroentérologie, de même que dans le domaine de l’esthétique par le truchement des produits et services d’Allergan Esthétique.

Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d’un Chef, Formation en santé pour notre gamme de produits en gastroentérologie. Le titulaire du poste sera un membre actif du Centre d’éducation et de formation en santé AbbVie (ACET). À ce titre, il aura la responsabilité de cerner les besoins en matière de formation en santé des professionnels de la santé et de mettre au point de multiples initiatives de formation en santé adaptées pour y répondre. Le titulaire du poste travaillera à distance et relèvera du Chef principal, Équipe de formation en santé.

Principales responsabilités

  • Procéder à l’évaluation des besoins des professionnels de la santé à l’échelle nationale et contribuer à la détermination des écarts et besoins en matière de formation en partenariat avec des collègues interfonctionnels.
  • Diriger la planification et l’élaboration d’un plan stratégique de formation en santé conformément à l’évaluation des besoins, aux lacunes en matière d’apprentissage et aux impératifs stratégiques globaux de la marque afin de concevoir, d’élaborer et de mettre en œuvre avec succès des solutions en matière de formation en santé.
  • Diriger la conception de stratégies et de tactiques de formation en santé avant-gardistes, mesurables par des indicateurs de rendement clés (IRC) définis, visant à influencer les connaissances, les attitudes et les compétences des professionnels de la santé, ainsi que leurs comportements généraux, afin d’élever les normes de soins et de favoriser l’amélioration des résultats pour les patients.
  • Superviser la teneur, l’échéancier, et le budget du plan de formation en santé en veillant à la rentabilité, à l’optimisation des ressources et à la réussite de l’exécution.
  • Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies d’engagement numérique efficaces, en utilisant divers outils et canaux pour améliorer les interactions numériques avec les professionnels de la santé.
  • Mener et favoriser la responsabilité de l’examen des normes en matière de formation pour le matériel de formation en santé, en veillant à ce qu’il réponde aux critères établis et aux critères de qualité.
  • S’assurer que toutes les offres de formation en santé d’AbbVie respectent les normes éthiques les plus rigoureuses, y compris, mais sans s’y limiter, celles de Médicaments novateurs Canada, les normes nationales d’agrément, les exigences de l’Association médicale canadienne ainsi que les politiques internes.
  • Identifier et cultiver les relations avec les parties prenantes internes, y compris, mais sans s’y limiter, les membres de l’équipe de marque et l’équipe sur le terrain, pour assurer une qualité optimale de la formation en santé et une approche globale pour une exécution réussie.
  • Identifier et cultiver les relations avec les parties prenantes externes, y compris les professionnels de la santé, les associations professionnelles et les fournisseurs afin de créer un contenu de formation en santé de grande qualité qui respecte les normes de formation en santé d’AbbVie.
  • Évaluer l’efficacité des offres de formation en santé par la collecte et l’analyse de données, en tirant parti des connaissances acquises pour élaborer et adapter des solutions éducatives fondées sur des données probantes.
  • Rendre compte des activités et autres livrables, de l’impact et des perspectives de la formation en santé en communiquant clairement, à l’oral et à l’écrit, avec l’ensemble des parties prenantes.
  • Se tenir au courant des connaissances thérapeutiques et environnementales afin de garantir la conception et la mise en œuvre de programmes de formation en santé à la fine pointe de l’industrie.
  • Faire preuve d’un engagement envers le perfectionnement professionnel continu et un leadership éclairé dans le domaine de la formation en santé.

Formation ou expérience requises

  • Baccalauréat en science ou en soins de santé
  • Formation et/ou expérience pertinente dans le domaine de la formation en santé et des principes de l’apprentissage des adultes, un atout important
  • Connaissance du milieu canadien des soins de santé et des divers environnements, organismes et systèmes d’agrément nationaux dans le domaine de la formation en santé, un atout important
  • Certification en formation continue en santé ou équivalence obtenue ou à obtenir dans l’année qui suit la prise de responsabilité des activités de formation continue en santé

Compétences et capacités essentielles

  • Attitude proactive et solides compétences en matière de relations interpersonnelles et de collaboration, capacité de communiquer efficacement avec des personnes, individuellement et avec des groupes, et d’influencer les parties prenantes pour qu’elles s’alignent sur les objectifs en matière de formation en santé
  • Présentation efficace, aptitudes pour la communication orale et écrite
  • Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et administratives, et capacité à travailler de manière autonome
  • Capacité démontrée à travailler dans un environnement dynamique aux priorités multiples qui exige la faculté de prendre des décisions et capacité de gérer simultanément de nombreux projets et parties prenantes
  • Réflexion stratégique et compétences analytiques garantissant une planification et une mise en œuvre efficaces des offres de formation en santé
  • Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word)
  • Aisance avec l’utilisation des différents outils/systèmes pour effectuer ses tâches quotidiennes
  • Connaissances et expérience des stratégies et des outils d’engagement numérique, et capacité démontrée à se connecter et à interagir efficacement au sein de paysages numériques, un atout important

AbbVie s'efforce d'offrir un milieu de travail français à ses employés au Québec. Bien que, dans le cadre de son programme de francisation, AbbVie ait pris toutes les mesures raisonnables pour éviter d'imposer l'exigence suivante, le degré de connaissance de l'anglais et la maîtrise de l'anglais est de niveau avancé, ceci estune exigence essentielle pour le poste de Chef, Formation en santé, notamment, mais sans s'y limiter, pour les raisons suivantes :

  1. Bassin d’employés uniquement anglophone à l’extérieur de la province du Québec.
  2. Client uniquement anglophone à l’extérieur de la province du Québec.
  3. Région uniquement anglophone à l’extérieur de la province du Québec.

AbbVie est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances et s'engage à agir avec intégrité, à stimuler l'innovation, à transformer des vies et à servir notre communauté. Égalité des chances pour les employeurs, les anciens combattants et les personnes en situation de handicap.

About AbbVie

AbbVie a pour mission de découvrir et d’offrir des solutions et des médicaments novateurs pour répondre à des besoins importants en matière de santé aujourd’hui et relever les défis médicaux de demain. AbbVie met tout en œuvre afin d’avoir un impact remarquable sur la vie des gens dans divers secteurs thérapeutiques clés, dont l’immunologie, l’oncologie, les neurosciences et les soins oculaires, de même que dans le domaine de l’esthétique, avec les produits et services d’Allergan Aesthetics. Pour en savoir plus sur AbbVie, visitez le site www.abbvie.com. Suivez AbbVie sur LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X et YouTube.

raw.description:
Job Title: Healthcare Operations Coordinator – Medical & Aesthetics

Position Type: Full-Time
Work Schedule: Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EDT / 9:00AM - 6:00PM EDT with (1hr unpaid lunch break)

Location: Remote – Philippines

Pay Rate: $6–$7 USD/hour, depending on experience

About the Client and Role

Our client operates two U.S.-based healthcare practices specializing in internal medicine, primary care, preventive health, longevity, and medical aesthetics.

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Healthcare Operations Coordinator to oversee daily administrative operations and coordinate approximately 10–15 staff members across both practices.

In this role, you'll work closely with physicians, staff, and external service partners to keep operations running smoothly, monitor performance, resolve concerns, and ensure important tasks are completed on time.

The position focuses on practice operations, staff coordination, AthenaHealth reporting, and encounter management, rather than independently handling specialized billing or credentialing functions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Practice Operations & Team Coordination (Primary Focus)

  • Oversee daily administrative operations across two healthcare practices.
  • Coordinate daily workflows and provide operational oversight for approximately 10–15 staff members.
  • Monitor staff schedules, responsibilities, and task completion to ensure efficient operations.
  • Communicate physician feedback, address operational concerns, and coordinate workflow improvements.
  • Support staff training and ensure established procedures are followed.
  • Identify operational issues and proactively follow up on outstanding tasks.

2. AthenaHealth, Reporting & Encounter Management

  • Generate and review AthenaHealth reports to monitor practice performance and identify outstanding issues.
  • Review daily patient encounters and verify or enter procedure codes provided or confirmed by physicians.
  • Identify missing or incomplete encounter information and coordinate corrections with physicians.
  • Monitor billing reports, accounts receivable, and claim denials, coordinating follow-ups with the external billing team.
  • Coordinate with external credentialing partners regarding outstanding requirements and updates.
  • Support healthcare quality initiatives by coordinating with staff and the CIN coordinator on HEDIS-related activities.

3. Administrative, Vendor & Staff Management

  • Coordinate staff scheduling, attendance monitoring, routine PTO approvals, and payroll preparation.
  • Address day-to-day staff concerns and escalate matters requiring executive approval.
  • Communicate with vendors, monitor inventory, and prepare purchase orders for approval.
  • Handle patient concerns escalated by front-office staff.
  • Provide regular operational updates and communicate unresolved issues to practice leadership.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 2–3 years of experience as a Medical Office Manager or in a healthcare management role involving practice operations, reporting, billing, and accounts receivable/accounts payable (AR/AP) management.
  • At least 1 year of recent hands-on AthenaHealth experience, ideally in the most recent role, specifically involving reporting and encounter management.
  • Proven experience overseeing healthcare staff, coordinating daily medical practice operations, and working closely with physicians.
  • Solid understanding of healthcare administrative workflows, billing processes, and operational reporting.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, leadership, and follow-up skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work independently.

raw.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager - North America
raw.excerpt: Traild: Who are we?  Traild is a high-growth SaaS company redefining how finance teams operate, combining AI, automation, and payments infrastructure to power the future of B2B finance.
raw.description:
Traild: Who are we? 

Traild is a high-growth SaaS company redefining how finance teams operate, combining AI, automation, and payments infrastructure to power the future of B2B finance.

Every year, businesses lose billions to fraud, errors, and mistakes. Traild exists to solve this at scale, helping finance teams move faster, stay in control, and operate with confidence.

With rapid customer growth, global expansion across APAC, North America and EMEA, and continued investment in product innovation, we are at a defining stage of our journey.

This is an opportunity to help shape the next category leader in finance automation, control and security, building technology that transforms how businesses manage, move, and protect money. At the core of this is a powerful AI-driven platform, enabling finance teams to deploy intelligent agents that do the work, surface risk in real time, and continuously improve how financial operations run.

Traild is building the infrastructure behind modern finance, protecting and powering meaningful volumes of the world’s B2B transactions.

If you’re excited by high growth, real ownership, and building something that matters, Traild is the place to do the most impactful work of your career.

Hear how Traild customers speak about us here.

The Role

    As Traild scales, our clients are getting bigger and more strategic. We already have an Enterprise Implementation role, and now we need an Enterprise Customer Success Manager to care for these accounts after go-live. This is the first role of its kind here, so you will help shape how it works as we learn what our largest customers need.

    You will own a portfolio of high-value accounts, acting as trusted advisor and advocate for client leadership and day-to-day teams. You will build long-term success strategies, protect and grow revenue, and turn happy clients into public references. Expect ambiguity, change, and plenty of room to make your mark.

    This is a full-time, remote and open to candidates across North America. Some early morning or evening calls will be needed to work with our development teams in APAC and EMEA.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of strategic and enterprise-level accounts as their primary point of contact and advocate.
  • Develop long-term success strategies with each customer, aligned to their goals and desired outcomes.
  • Drive revenue retention and expansion, partnering with Sales on upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Manage churn - Spot at-risk accounts early using health, usage, and sentiment signals. Lead save plans with cross-functional support, and track churn reasons to feed back to Product, Support, and Sales.
  • Plan and deliver Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), building the value narrative for client leadership.
  • Manage escalations end to end: pull in Engineering and Product, turn client concerns into action, and keep stakeholders updated.
  • Follow up on roadmap commitments and interim fixes with Product and Engineering.
  • Monitor usage, health, and support activity daily to spot early escalation risks.
  • Spot trends across the customer base and share them with Product, Support, and Sales.
  • Turn successful clients into references
  • Contribute to documentation and mentor junior team members

Who You Are

    You are a proactive and customer-obsessed professional who thrives on building relationships, solving problems, and driving customer value. You understand the customer journey end-to-end and excel at helping clients succeed post-onboarding. You are confident engaging with stakeholders at all levels and enjoy working in a fast-moving, scaling environment. You are at ease with executives, you think commercially, and you thrive in a start-up where the role is still taking shape and the path is not always clear.

    Must have

  • 2+ years of experience in a start-up or scale-up, ideally in fintech or payments.
  • Experience managing high-value accounts ($100K+ ARR) in a customer success, account management, or similar client-facing role.
  • Strong relationship and stakeholder management skills, including executive presence and C-suite fluency.
  • Commercial acumen, with a track record of driving retention and expansion.
  • Data-driven storytelling: you can turn usage and health data into a clear value narrative for EBRs.
  • Project management and cross-functional orchestration across Support, Product, Engineering, and Sales.
  • Comfort working independently, managing your own time, and adapting as the role evolves.
  • The ability to de-escalate clients and own mistakes rather than assign blame.
  • Flexibility to take occasional early morning or evening calls with global teams.

    • Nice to have

  • Experience in the ERP, accounts payable, or payments space.
  • Familiarity with Zendesk, HubSpot, Jira, Slack, Confluence, Omni, and Claude.

    • We know great customer success people come from all sorts of backgrounds. If you have transferable skills from other project management, onboarding, consulting or delivery roles, we'd still like to hear from you, please apply and use the relevant/transferable skills question in the application to tell us how your experience maps to this role.

Salary Range

    The base salary range for this position is:

  • U.S. Candidates: $100,000 - $140,000 USD per year
  • Canadian Candidates: $100,000 - $140,000 CAD per year

    • Compensation is determined based on experience, education, and geographic location. The final offer may vary within the stated range to reflect the candidate’s qualifications and market conditions in their area.

The Perks of Working at Traild  

  • Flexibility: we offer a range of remote, hybrid and flexible working options. 

  • Global team: we are growing across APAC, NA and EMEA and have team all across the world. 

  • We are growing at an exponential rate, this is an opportunity to get involved with a true rocketship with all the excitement and opportunities that comes with it 

  • Our team genuinely loves working at Traild: our eNPS score is 68, where anything above 50 is considered world-class.

Please note that the final applicants for this job will be asked to consent in writing to a police check / criminal background check to the extent permitted by law in your jurisdiction of employment. Please note that Traild is an E-Verify employer.

About the role

As Senior Product Owner for Risk Tools & Applications, you will define and deliver the product vision, roadmap and backlog for internal and partner-facing solutions used to monitor activity, identify risk and manage investigations. These products may include alerting, case-management, surveillance, reporting and player-protection capabilities.

You will work closely with Risk Operations, Engineering, Data, Architecture, QA and other product teams to turn complex operational challenges into secure, scalable and intuitive products. You will also explore how automation and AI can improve detection, decision-making and operational efficiency.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can combine product strategy with hands-on delivery in a complex, data-rich environment.

What you will do

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Live Casino risk tools and applications.
  • Translate risk, surveillance, game-integrity and player-protection needs into clear product outcomes.
  • Manage and prioritize the product backlog based on user value, risk impact and technical feasibility.
  • Lead product discovery with internal users, partners and subject-matter experts.
  • Define workflows for monitoring, alerts, investigations, case management and reporting.
  • Create clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Partner with Engineering, Data, Architecture and QA throughout discovery, development and release.
  • Use dashboards, operational metrics and user feedback to guide product decisions.
  • Evaluate opportunities to apply automation, machine learning and AI-assisted decision-making.
  • Balance detection quality, operational efficiency, false positives and user experience.
  • Ensure products support appropriate access controls, auditability and data protection.
  • Coordinate releases and confirm that new capabilities are operationally ready.
  • Track product performance and demonstrate measurable improvements after launch.
  • Communicate priorities, decisions, progress and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Identify dependencies, resolve delivery blockers and keep cross-functional teams aligned.

What you bring

  • At least 5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager working closely with software development teams.
  • Proven ownership of complex software products from discovery through delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Hands-on experience delivering complex digital products, platforms, internal systems, or partner- and operator-facing tools
  • Ability to translate business, operational, user, and technical needs into clear, scalable product solutions.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering reporting systems, dashboards, workflow tools, or other data-driven products.
  • Excellent analytical skills, with experience using data and metrics to drive prioritization and product decisions.
  • Ability to understand complex workflows, identify dependencies and edge cases, and turn them into clear functional requirements.
  • Proven experience working with cross-functional and distributed teams in an Agile environment.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to align and influence diverse stakeholders.
  • Confidence working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including Engineering, Architecture, Data, Operations, Risk, and business teams.
  • Strong ownership of product outcomes, from problem definition and discovery through delivery, rollout, and continuous improvement.
  • Fluency in English.

What sets you apart

  • Experience with Live Casino products, operations, platforms, or ecosystems is a significant advantage.
  • Experience delivering Live Casino risk management, surveillance, game integrity, fraud prevention, player protection, or investigation tools is a strong advantage.
  • Experience working on AI-powered or machine-learning-enabled products, particularly solutions involving detection, monitoring, classification, prediction, or operational decision support, is a significant advantage.
  • Understanding of how AI-powered solutions are evaluated, including data quality, accuracy, false positives, explain ability, operational usability, and continuous improvement.
  • Understanding of access-control models, permissions, auditability, and role-based systems.
  • Experience designing tools for internal users, external partners, or operators with varying levels of technical maturity.
  • Experience working with regulated, compliance-driven, or operationally sensitive products.

About us

ARRISE is a global leader in software development and services for the iGaming industry, bringing together more than 2,500 professionals operating across more than 12 locations worldwide.

From concept through to delivery, we combine technical expertise, creativity and industry knowledge to develop products, platforms and services that shape player experiences and support some of the industry's leading brands.

We are best known for the work we deliver for Pragmatic Play, creating and supporting technology, products and specialists services enjoyed by millions of players worldwide.
