title: Partner Program Manager
description: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.

raw.title: Partner Program Manager
raw.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
raw.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Partner Program Manager.

About the job

As we expand our partner ecosystem to support global growth targets, we are expanding our team to scale responsibly. We are seeking a versatile Partner Program Manager to drive an exceptional experience across our Systems Integrators (SIs), ISVs, Resell, and Technology partners. This balanced role bridges the gap between high-touch partner experience, strategic cross-functional project management, and advanced lifecycle automation. If you have a deep background in partnerships, an AI-forward mindset for process optimization, and hands-on experience with modern ecosystem toolsets, this role offers an exciting opportunity to shape the future of our global network.

In this role, you won't just follow a static blueprint—you will help build it. We are seeking a highly proactive partner program manager to drive exceptional experiences for our Systems Integrators (SIs), ISVs, Resell, and Technology partners. You will take the lead on optimizing the end-to-end partner journey, managing cross-functional projects, and eliminating operational friction.

This position requires a "can-do" attitude and a passion for continuous improvement. You will be responsible for transforming manual workflows into automated, scalable systems, managing key vendor capabilities, and implementing strategic initiatives that directly unlock ecosystem revenue velocity.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Drive Program Modernization & Scale: Act as an operational engine for the team, identifying process bottlenecks and proactively designing new ways to automate existing manual workflows.
  • Own Problem-Solving: Step into complex challenges across the partner lifecycle and chart a clear path forward to build repeatable, programmatic solutions.
  • Optimize the Partner Experience: Lead and refine core partner onboarding pathways, lifecycle touchpoints, and support workflows to deliver a seamless, world-class journey for external ecosystems.
  • Accelerate Partner Revenue Mechanics: Build and execute operational frameworks that eliminate transaction friction, streamline incentive administration, and maximize partner-sourced revenue pipelines.
  • Manage Technology & Vendor Capabilities: Serve as a strategic owner for key components of our partner tech stack and vendor relationships, ensuring our data models and tools are optimized for ecosystem scale rather than mere maintenance.
  • Orchestrate High-Touch Communications: Develop and execute comprehensive partner engagement strategies, ensuring clear, accessible program documentation, impactful updates, and consistent enablement communications across all segments.
  • Lead Cross-Functional Project Execution: Develop and run end-to-end project plans for new partner initiatives, collaborating closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Legal, and Tech teams to ensure alignment and timely milestone delivery.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field; relevant experience may be considered.
  • Experience: 5–8 years of experience in partner program or project management, partner management, strategy and operations, or a similar role within a fast-paced technology company.
  • The "Get-Stuff-Done" Mindset: A proven track record of operating effectively in complex environments, turning ambiguous problems into plans, and delivering results without a rigid instructions script.
  • Project Management & Collaboration: Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage complex cross-functional timelines, align diverse stakeholders, and drive accountability.
  • Communication & Content: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for translating complex program guidelines into clear, compelling partner assets, guides, and updates.

Desired:

  • Ecosystem Acumen: Solid understanding of modern partner program structures, lifecycle methodologies, and experience working with SIs, ISVs, Resell, or Technology tracks.
  • Tech Stack & Automation Familiarity: Hands-on exposure to CRM and partner ecosystem technologies (such as PRMs, account-mapping utilities, or data integration tools) with a strong desire to leverage software and AI to remove manual tasks.
  • Revenue Orientation: Experience designing or supporting commercial program models, referral paths, or joint sales plays that directly drive channel pipelines.
  • Advanced Degree: BA/BS degree or equivalent required. MBA is a plus.

Location

This role will be remote,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $116,960 - $146,200.
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $123,760 - $154,700.
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $137,520 - $171,900.
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 23,2026, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

raw.title: Chef, Formation en santé, Gastroentérologie
raw.excerpt: Vous joindre à AbbVie signifie que vous ferez partie d’une équipe de professionnels exceptionnels qui se sont engagés à avoir un impact remarquable sur la vie des patients.
raw.description:
Vous joindre à AbbVie signifie que vous ferez partie d’une équipe de professionnels exceptionnels qui se sont engagés à avoir un impact remarquable sur la vie des patients. Chez AbbVie, nous effectuons des recherches scientifiques révolutionnaires à l’échelle mondiale au quotidien. AbbVie Canada est l’un des meilleurs lieux de travail au Canada.

Lorsque vous déterminez votre cheminement de carrière, choisissez d’être remarquable.

AbbVie a pour mission de découvrir et d’offrir des médicaments novateurs pour répondre à des besoins importants en matière de santé aujourd’hui et relever les défis médicaux de demain. AbbVie met tout en œuvre afin d’avoir un impact remarquable sur la vie des gens dans divers secteurs thérapeutiques clés, dont l’immunologie, l’oncologie, les neurosciences, les soins de la vue, la virologie, la santé des femmes et la gastroentérologie, de même que dans le domaine de l’esthétique par le truchement des produits et services d’Allergan Esthétique.

Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d’un Chef, Formation en santé pour notre gamme de produits en gastroentérologie. Le titulaire du poste sera un membre actif du Centre d’éducation et de formation en santé AbbVie (ACET). À ce titre, il aura la responsabilité de cerner les besoins en matière de formation en santé des professionnels de la santé et de mettre au point de multiples initiatives de formation en santé adaptées pour y répondre. Le titulaire du poste travaillera à distance et relèvera du Chef principal, Équipe de formation en santé.

Principales responsabilités

  • Procéder à l’évaluation des besoins des professionnels de la santé à l’échelle nationale et contribuer à la détermination des écarts et besoins en matière de formation en partenariat avec des collègues interfonctionnels.
  • Diriger la planification et l’élaboration d’un plan stratégique de formation en santé conformément à l’évaluation des besoins, aux lacunes en matière d’apprentissage et aux impératifs stratégiques globaux de la marque afin de concevoir, d’élaborer et de mettre en œuvre avec succès des solutions en matière de formation en santé.
  • Diriger la conception de stratégies et de tactiques de formation en santé avant-gardistes, mesurables par des indicateurs de rendement clés (IRC) définis, visant à influencer les connaissances, les attitudes et les compétences des professionnels de la santé, ainsi que leurs comportements généraux, afin d’élever les normes de soins et de favoriser l’amélioration des résultats pour les patients.
  • Superviser la teneur, l’échéancier, et le budget du plan de formation en santé en veillant à la rentabilité, à l’optimisation des ressources et à la réussite de l’exécution.
  • Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies d’engagement numérique efficaces, en utilisant divers outils et canaux pour améliorer les interactions numériques avec les professionnels de la santé.
  • Mener et favoriser la responsabilité de l’examen des normes en matière de formation pour le matériel de formation en santé, en veillant à ce qu’il réponde aux critères établis et aux critères de qualité.
  • S’assurer que toutes les offres de formation en santé d’AbbVie respectent les normes éthiques les plus rigoureuses, y compris, mais sans s’y limiter, celles de Médicaments novateurs Canada, les normes nationales d’agrément, les exigences de l’Association médicale canadienne ainsi que les politiques internes.
  • Identifier et cultiver les relations avec les parties prenantes internes, y compris, mais sans s’y limiter, les membres de l’équipe de marque et l’équipe sur le terrain, pour assurer une qualité optimale de la formation en santé et une approche globale pour une exécution réussie.
  • Identifier et cultiver les relations avec les parties prenantes externes, y compris les professionnels de la santé, les associations professionnelles et les fournisseurs afin de créer un contenu de formation en santé de grande qualité qui respecte les normes de formation en santé d’AbbVie.
  • Évaluer l’efficacité des offres de formation en santé par la collecte et l’analyse de données, en tirant parti des connaissances acquises pour élaborer et adapter des solutions éducatives fondées sur des données probantes.
  • Rendre compte des activités et autres livrables, de l’impact et des perspectives de la formation en santé en communiquant clairement, à l’oral et à l’écrit, avec l’ensemble des parties prenantes.
  • Se tenir au courant des connaissances thérapeutiques et environnementales afin de garantir la conception et la mise en œuvre de programmes de formation en santé à la fine pointe de l’industrie.
  • Faire preuve d’un engagement envers le perfectionnement professionnel continu et un leadership éclairé dans le domaine de la formation en santé.

Formation ou expérience requises

  • Baccalauréat en science ou en soins de santé
  • Formation et/ou expérience pertinente dans le domaine de la formation en santé et des principes de l’apprentissage des adultes, un atout important
  • Connaissance du milieu canadien des soins de santé et des divers environnements, organismes et systèmes d’agrément nationaux dans le domaine de la formation en santé, un atout important
  • Certification en formation continue en santé ou équivalence obtenue ou à obtenir dans l’année qui suit la prise de responsabilité des activités de formation continue en santé

Compétences et capacités essentielles

  • Attitude proactive et solides compétences en matière de relations interpersonnelles et de collaboration, capacité de communiquer efficacement avec des personnes, individuellement et avec des groupes, et d’influencer les parties prenantes pour qu’elles s’alignent sur les objectifs en matière de formation en santé
  • Présentation efficace, aptitudes pour la communication orale et écrite
  • Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et administratives, et capacité à travailler de manière autonome
  • Capacité démontrée à travailler dans un environnement dynamique aux priorités multiples qui exige la faculté de prendre des décisions et capacité de gérer simultanément de nombreux projets et parties prenantes
  • Réflexion stratégique et compétences analytiques garantissant une planification et une mise en œuvre efficaces des offres de formation en santé
  • Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word)
  • Aisance avec l’utilisation des différents outils/systèmes pour effectuer ses tâches quotidiennes
  • Connaissances et expérience des stratégies et des outils d’engagement numérique, et capacité démontrée à se connecter et à interagir efficacement au sein de paysages numériques, un atout important

AbbVie s'efforce d'offrir un milieu de travail français à ses employés au Québec. Bien que, dans le cadre de son programme de francisation, AbbVie ait pris toutes les mesures raisonnables pour éviter d'imposer l'exigence suivante, le degré de connaissance de l'anglais et la maîtrise de l'anglais est de niveau avancé, ceci estune exigence essentielle pour le poste de Chef, Formation en santé, notamment, mais sans s'y limiter, pour les raisons suivantes :

  1. Bassin d’employés uniquement anglophone à l’extérieur de la province du Québec.
  2. Client uniquement anglophone à l’extérieur de la province du Québec.
  3. Région uniquement anglophone à l’extérieur de la province du Québec.

AbbVie est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances et s'engage à agir avec intégrité, à stimuler l'innovation, à transformer des vies et à servir notre communauté. Égalité des chances pour les employeurs, les anciens combattants et les personnes en situation de handicap.

About AbbVie

AbbVie a pour mission de découvrir et d’offrir des solutions et des médicaments novateurs pour répondre à des besoins importants en matière de santé aujourd’hui et relever les défis médicaux de demain. AbbVie met tout en œuvre afin d’avoir un impact remarquable sur la vie des gens dans divers secteurs thérapeutiques clés, dont l’immunologie, l’oncologie, les neurosciences et les soins oculaires, de même que dans le domaine de l’esthétique, avec les produits et services d’Allergan Aesthetics. Pour en savoir plus sur AbbVie, visitez le site www.abbvie.com. Suivez AbbVie sur LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X et YouTube.

raw.description:
Job Title: Healthcare Operations Coordinator – Medical & Aesthetics

Position Type: Full-Time
Work Schedule: Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EDT / 9:00AM - 6:00PM EDT with (1hr unpaid lunch break)

Location: Remote – Philippines

Pay Rate: $6–$7 USD/hour, depending on experience

About the Client and Role

Our client operates two U.S.-based healthcare practices specializing in internal medicine, primary care, preventive health, longevity, and medical aesthetics.

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Healthcare Operations Coordinator to oversee daily administrative operations and coordinate approximately 10–15 staff members across both practices.

In this role, you'll work closely with physicians, staff, and external service partners to keep operations running smoothly, monitor performance, resolve concerns, and ensure important tasks are completed on time.

The position focuses on practice operations, staff coordination, AthenaHealth reporting, and encounter management, rather than independently handling specialized billing or credentialing functions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Practice Operations & Team Coordination (Primary Focus)

  • Oversee daily administrative operations across two healthcare practices.
  • Coordinate daily workflows and provide operational oversight for approximately 10–15 staff members.
  • Monitor staff schedules, responsibilities, and task completion to ensure efficient operations.
  • Communicate physician feedback, address operational concerns, and coordinate workflow improvements.
  • Support staff training and ensure established procedures are followed.
  • Identify operational issues and proactively follow up on outstanding tasks.

2. AthenaHealth, Reporting & Encounter Management

  • Generate and review AthenaHealth reports to monitor practice performance and identify outstanding issues.
  • Review daily patient encounters and verify or enter procedure codes provided or confirmed by physicians.
  • Identify missing or incomplete encounter information and coordinate corrections with physicians.
  • Monitor billing reports, accounts receivable, and claim denials, coordinating follow-ups with the external billing team.
  • Coordinate with external credentialing partners regarding outstanding requirements and updates.
  • Support healthcare quality initiatives by coordinating with staff and the CIN coordinator on HEDIS-related activities.

3. Administrative, Vendor & Staff Management

  • Coordinate staff scheduling, attendance monitoring, routine PTO approvals, and payroll preparation.
  • Address day-to-day staff concerns and escalate matters requiring executive approval.
  • Communicate with vendors, monitor inventory, and prepare purchase orders for approval.
  • Handle patient concerns escalated by front-office staff.
  • Provide regular operational updates and communicate unresolved issues to practice leadership.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 2–3 years of experience as a Medical Office Manager or in a healthcare management role involving practice operations, reporting, billing, and accounts receivable/accounts payable (AR/AP) management.
  • At least 1 year of recent hands-on AthenaHealth experience, ideally in the most recent role, specifically involving reporting and encounter management.
  • Proven experience overseeing healthcare staff, coordinating daily medical practice operations, and working closely with physicians.
  • Solid understanding of healthcare administrative workflows, billing processes, and operational reporting.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, leadership, and follow-up skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work independently.

Please note: This role requires actual medical office or healthcare operations management experience. General supervisory experience alone, without relevant healthcare operations, reporting, and billing/AR/AP exposure, will not meet the requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting internal medicine, primary care, preventive medicine, or longevity-focused practices.
  • Experience coordinating operations across multiple healthcare practices or managing teams of 10–15 staff members.
  • Familiarity with medical billing reports, denial tracking, and external billing coordination.
  • Exposure to HEDIS initiatives, healthcare quality metrics, or CIN-related reporting.
  • Experience with vendor management, inventory tracking, staff scheduling, and payroll preparation.

Training & Support

The client will provide training on practice-specific AthenaHealth templates, reports, encounter review procedures, and internal workflows.

Dedicated external teams handle specialized billing and credentialing functions, allowing you to focus on operational oversight and coordination.

Direct aesthetics experience and prior HEDIS or CIN program management are not required. Medical procedure codes will be provided or confirmed by physicians, and final hiring, disciplinary, and payroll decisions remain with executive leadership.

Basic Requirements

  • Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
  • Must have relevant work experience.
  • Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

raw.description:
Traild: Who are we? 

Traild is a high-growth SaaS company redefining how finance teams operate, combining AI, automation, and payments infrastructure to power the future of B2B finance.

Every year, businesses lose billions to fraud, errors, and mistakes. Traild exists to solve this at scale, helping finance teams move faster, stay in control, and operate with confidence.

With rapid customer growth, global expansion across APAC, North America and EMEA, and continued investment in product innovation, we are at a defining stage of our journey.

This is an opportunity to help shape the next category leader in finance automation, control and security, building technology that transforms how businesses manage, move, and protect money. At the core of this is a powerful AI-driven platform, enabling finance teams to deploy intelligent agents that do the work, surface risk in real time, and continuously improve how financial operations run.

Traild is building the infrastructure behind modern finance, protecting and powering meaningful volumes of the world’s B2B transactions.

If you’re excited by high growth, real ownership, and building something that matters, Traild is the place to do the most impactful work of your career.

Hear how Traild customers speak about us here.

The Role

    As Traild scales, our clients are getting bigger and more strategic. We already have an Enterprise Implementation role, and now we need an Enterprise Customer Success Manager to care for these accounts after go-live. This is the first role of its kind here, so you will help shape how it works as we learn what our largest customers need.

    You will own a portfolio of high-value accounts, acting as trusted advisor and advocate for client leadership and day-to-day teams. You will build long-term success strategies, protect and grow revenue, and turn happy clients into public references. Expect ambiguity, change, and plenty of room to make your mark.

    This is a full-time, remote and open to candidates across North America. Some early morning or evening calls will be needed to work with our development teams in APAC and EMEA.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of strategic and enterprise-level accounts as their primary point of contact and advocate.
  • Develop long-term success strategies with each customer, aligned to their goals and desired outcomes.
  • Drive revenue retention and expansion, partnering with Sales on upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Manage churn - Spot at-risk accounts early using health, usage, and sentiment signals. Lead save plans with cross-functional support, and track churn reasons to feed back to Product, Support, and Sales.
  • Plan and deliver Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), building the value narrative for client leadership.
  • Manage escalations end to end: pull in Engineering and Product, turn client concerns into action, and keep stakeholders updated.
  • Follow up on roadmap commitments and interim fixes with Product and Engineering.
  • Monitor usage, health, and support activity daily to spot early escalation risks.
  • Spot trends across the customer base and share them with Product, Support, and Sales.
  • Turn successful clients into references
  • Contribute to documentation and mentor junior team members

Who You Are

    You are a proactive and customer-obsessed professional who thrives on building relationships, solving problems, and driving customer value. You understand the customer journey end-to-end and excel at helping clients succeed post-onboarding. You are confident engaging with stakeholders at all levels and enjoy working in a fast-moving, scaling environment. You are at ease with executives, you think commercially, and you thrive in a start-up where the role is still taking shape and the path is not always clear.

    Must have

  • 2+ years of experience in a start-up or scale-up, ideally in fintech or payments.
  • Experience managing high-value accounts ($100K+ ARR) in a customer success, account management, or similar client-facing role.
  • Strong relationship and stakeholder management skills, including executive presence and C-suite fluency.
  • Commercial acumen, with a track record of driving retention and expansion.
  • Data-driven storytelling: you can turn usage and health data into a clear value narrative for EBRs.
  • Project management and cross-functional orchestration across Support, Product, Engineering, and Sales.
  • Comfort working independently, managing your own time, and adapting as the role evolves.
  • The ability to de-escalate clients and own mistakes rather than assign blame.
  • Flexibility to take occasional early morning or evening calls with global teams.

    • Nice to have

  • Experience in the ERP, accounts payable, or payments space.
  • Familiarity with Zendesk, HubSpot, Jira, Slack, Confluence, Omni, and Claude.

    • We know great customer success people come from all sorts of backgrounds. If you have transferable skills from other project management, onboarding, consulting or delivery roles, we'd still like to hear from you, please apply and use the relevant/transferable skills question in the application to tell us how your experience maps to this role.

Salary Range

    The base salary range for this position is:

  • U.S. Candidates: $100,000 - $140,000 USD per year
  • Canadian Candidates: $100,000 - $140,000 CAD per year

    • Compensation is determined based on experience, education, and geographic location. The final offer may vary within the stated range to reflect the candidate’s qualifications and market conditions in their area.

The Perks of Working at Traild  

  • Flexibility: we offer a range of remote, hybrid and flexible working options. 

  • Global team: we are growing across APAC, NA and EMEA and have team all across the world. 

  • We are growing at an exponential rate, this is an opportunity to get involved with a true rocketship with all the excitement and opportunities that comes with it 

  • Our team genuinely loves working at Traild: our eNPS score is 68, where anything above 50 is considered world-class.

Please note that the final applicants for this job will be asked to consent in writing to a police check / criminal background check to the extent permitted by law in your jurisdiction of employment. Please note that Traild is an E-Verify employer.

About the role

As Senior Product Owner for Risk Tools & Applications, you will define and deliver the product vision, roadmap and backlog for internal and partner-facing solutions used to monitor activity, identify risk and manage investigations. These products may include alerting, case-management, surveillance, reporting and player-protection capabilities.

You will work closely with Risk Operations, Engineering, Data, Architecture, QA and other product teams to turn complex operational challenges into secure, scalable and intuitive products. You will also explore how automation and AI can improve detection, decision-making and operational efficiency.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can combine product strategy with hands-on delivery in a complex, data-rich environment.

What you will do

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Live Casino risk tools and applications.
  • Translate risk, surveillance, game-integrity and player-protection needs into clear product outcomes.
  • Manage and prioritize the product backlog based on user value, risk impact and technical feasibility.
  • Lead product discovery with internal users, partners and subject-matter experts.
  • Define workflows for monitoring, alerts, investigations, case management and reporting.
  • Create clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Partner with Engineering, Data, Architecture and QA throughout discovery, development and release.
  • Use dashboards, operational metrics and user feedback to guide product decisions.
  • Evaluate opportunities to apply automation, machine learning and AI-assisted decision-making.
  • Balance detection quality, operational efficiency, false positives and user experience.
  • Ensure products support appropriate access controls, auditability and data protection.
  • Coordinate releases and confirm that new capabilities are operationally ready.
  • Track product performance and demonstrate measurable improvements after launch.
  • Communicate priorities, decisions, progress and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Identify dependencies, resolve delivery blockers and keep cross-functional teams aligned.

What you bring

  • At least 5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager working closely with software development teams.
  • Proven ownership of complex software products from discovery through delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Hands-on experience delivering complex digital products, platforms, internal systems, or partner- and operator-facing tools
  • Ability to translate business, operational, user, and technical needs into clear, scalable product solutions.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering reporting systems, dashboards, workflow tools, or other data-driven products.
  • Excellent analytical skills, with experience using data and metrics to drive prioritization and product decisions.
  • Ability to understand complex workflows, identify dependencies and edge cases, and turn them into clear functional requirements.
  • Proven experience working with cross-functional and distributed teams in an Agile environment.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to align and influence diverse stakeholders.

What sets you apart

  • Experience with Live Casino products, operations, platforms, or ecosystems is a significant advantage.
  • Experience delivering Live Casino risk management, surveillance, game integrity, fraud prevention, player protection, or investigation tools is a strong advantage.
  • Experience working on AI-powered or machine-learning-enabled products, particularly solutions involving detection, monitoring, classification, prediction, or operational decision support, is a significant advantage.
  • Understanding of how AI-powered solutions are evaluated, including data quality, accuracy, false positives, explain ability, operational usability, and continuous improvement.
  • Understanding of access-control models, permissions, auditability, and role-based systems.
  • Experience designing tools for internal users, external partners, or operators with varying levels of technical maturity.
  • Experience working with regulated, compliance-driven, or operationally sensitive products.

ARRISE is a global leader in software development and services for the iGaming industry, bringing together more than 2,500 professionals operating across more than 12 locations worldwide.

From concept through to delivery, we combine technical expertise, creativity and industry knowledge to develop products, platforms and services that shape player experiences and support some of the industry's leading brands.

raw.title: Principal Architect, System Software - Orbital Data Center
raw.excerpt: Space-1 is NVIDIA's first Orbital Data Center (ODC) module — a Vera Rubin–class compute platform engineered for low-Earth orbit mission.
raw.description:
Space-1 is NVIDIA's first Orbital Data Center (ODC) module — a Vera Rubin–class compute platform engineered for low-Earth orbit mission. It is the first step in a multi-generation orbital roadmap to speed up AI adoption. We are looking for a strong technical architect to own end-to-end system software architecture for Space-1 and successor orbital platforms. You will architect the full stack — application to libraries, from data center stack to BMC and BIOS firmware, manageability, and telemetry through the host OS, GPU and CPU drivers, and CUDA — to deliver a production-ready inference platform that operates reliably in the radiation, thermal-cycling, and remote-operations environment of LEO. You will partner closely with the orbital hardware system architecture team, drive customer use cases with constellation operators, align architecture with mission requirements, and bring the best orbital AI products to market. Join us at the forefront of technological advancement.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own system architecture for inference stack and other applications running on this class of products and make it resilient to any fault happening in space.

  • Co-architect with the orbital hardware system architecture team to define interfaces, partitioning, and trade-offs across silicon, board, firmware, OS, and AI workload layers for 5-year LEO missions.

  • Own end-to-end system software architecture for Space-1 and successor Orbital Data Center modules — covering data center stack, BMC firmware, BIOS, host OS, GPU/CPU drivers, CUDA, DCGM, and manageability telemetry as a single integrated stack.

  • Define the manageability architecture for an unreachable, autonomous data center: remote bring-up, in-orbit firmware update, dual-module redundancy, fault containment, recovery from SEU/SEFI events, and telemetry for fleets ranging from tens to millions of nodes.

  • Architect rad-tolerant system software behaviors — ECC handling, memory scrubbing, latch-up mitigation, deterministic recovery, and graceful degradation through 5 years and up to ~8,000 thermal cycles in dawn–dusk sun-synchronous orbit.

  • Drive Redfish, MCTP, PLDM, and constellation-level management protocols across BMC, BIOS, and host software so customers can operate orbital fleets with the same tools they use on the ground.

  • Define minimum BMC feature set, pin budget, boot architecture (rugged M.2 / VPX-class options), and dual-module redundancy strategy in partnership with platform and mechanical engineering.

  • Partner with cloud and constellation customers (SpaceX, Blue Origin, Starcloud, Planet, Cowboy Space, and others) to translate mission requirements — orbit, duty cycle, NSA PHIPs security, post-quantum networking (CX9), inference SLAs — into actionable platform software architecture.

  • BS, MS, or PhD in EE/CS or related field of education (or equivalent experience).

  • Working experience in building AI infrastructure and systems in space. Proven record of architecting and delivering platform software for large-scale data centers or mission-critical embedded systems.

  • Strong knowledge of server architecture, data center manageability, and full-stack integration of firmware with OS and accelerator software. Hands-on experience with data center health management workflows, telemetry, and fault management at scale.

  • Solid understanding of hardware management interfaces (USB, SMBus/I2C, PCIe) and proficiency with modern management protocols including Redfish, MCTP, and PLDM.

  • Strong and demonstrable skill in C/C++ and Python.

  • Experience programming and debugging server platforms, including pre-silicon and platform bring-up environments.

  • Experience in SCM (e.g. Git, Perforce) and project management tools like Jira.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, good work ethics, high sense of team-work, love to produce quality work, and commitment to finish your tasks every single day.

  • You are a self-starter who loves to find creative solutions to complicated problems and hands on with coding.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience architecting platform software for space, aerospace, defense, or other radiation, thermal, and vibration-constrained environments — including SEU/SEFI mitigation, ECC strategy, TID/SEE qualification, and rad-hard design partitioning. Being a part of a start up or initiative directly related to space data centers.

  • Hands-on experience with autonomous, remote, or unreachable data center operations — in-orbit or in-field firmware update, dual-module redundancy, and recovery without physical access. Hands-on with x86 or ARM (Grace/Vera) system architecture and the NVIDIA AI software stack (CUDA, DCGM, DOCA/OFED, GPU drivers, DGX OS).

  • Proven technical leadership driving large complex programs with 50+ engineers across firmware, OS, driver, and AI stack teams.

  • Skilled in reviewing hardware schematics and PCB layouts for debugging, design verification, and collaboration with hardware engineers.

NVIDIA's invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern deep learning — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Today, we are increasingly known as “the AI computing company.” We're looking to grow our company and establish teams with the most thoughtful people in the world. Our invention serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is seeking exceptional individuals like you to help us drive the next wave of artificial intelligence.

REF: #001

ADGA is currently looking to hire 3 Consultants to support current and future platform initiatives. Our government client requires Project Management resources capable of leading large-scale enterprise transformation projects, departmental onboarding activities, platform enhancement initiatives, enterprise data and integration projects, cybersecurity and compliance initiatives, and service modernization efforts.

Project Management resources may be assigned to one of three delivery streams:

The requirement supports three distinct project management streams (1) SAP S/4HANA Transformation and Departmental Onboarding; (2) Workday Template Development and Departmental Onboarding; and (3) Enterprise Data, Security, and Integration Services. Resources may be assigned to any stream based on operational requirements and may be required to support cross-stream initiatives where dependencies exist.

1) SAP Transformation Stream

  • Responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering SAP S/4HANA-related projects, platform enhancements, integrations, and departmental onboarding activities.

2) Workday Template Development and Onboarding Stream

  • Responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering Workday-related onboarding initiatives, template development activities, change readiness efforts, and departmental implementation projects.

3) Enterprise Data, Security, and Integration Services Stream

  • Responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering enterprise data, security, integration, and technical engineering initiatives supporting the Digital Comptrollership Enterprise Platforms (DCEP). Activities may include data migration and conversion projects, enterprise reporting and analytics initiatives, identity and access management enhancements, cybersecurity and compliance activities, application and platform integration projects, cloud and platform modernization efforts, technical architecture implementation, and cross-platform engineering initiatives.
  • Resources may be required to coordinate activities across SAP, Workday, and related Government of Canada enterprise systems to ensure alignment with departmental onboarding and platform transformation objectives.

Tasks will include:

Project Management

  • Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and closure of enterprise transformation projects;
  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules, work plans, and project governance documentation;
  • Define project scope, objectives, assumptions, constraints, and success criteria;
  • Monitor project progress and manage schedule, cost, scope, and quality performance;
  • Coordinate project resources and dependencies across multiple teams and stakeholders;
  • Escalate project risks, issues, and decisions to appropriate governance bodies.
  • Governance and Reporting

  • Support project gating, executive reviews, and governance activities;
  • Prepare executive briefings, presentations, dashboards, and reporting materials;
  • Maintain project documentation and records within approved Microsoft 365 and SharePoint environments;

Work Package and Delivery Management

  • Support the definition of work packages, deliverables, dependencies, and acceptance criteria;
  • Facilitate complexity assessments and level-of-effort estimations;
  • Support budget planning, forecasting, and costing activities;
  • Monitor delivery against approved work packages and project baselines.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Coordinate activities between business stakeholders, technical teams, service providers, and project governance bodies;
  • Facilitate project meetings, workshops, working groups, and steering committees;
  • Support departmental onboarding activities and readiness assessments;
  • Manage stakeholder communications and engagement plans.

SAP-Specific Activities (when assigned)

  • Coordinate SAP platform enhancement, implementation, and onboarding initiatives;
  • Support SAP roadmap delivery and cross-functional project activities;
  • Coordinate activities involving SAP business processes, integrations, reporting, analytics, and enterprise services;
  • Support interoperability with broader Government of Canada digital initiatives.

Workday-Specific Activities (when assigned)

  • Coordinate Workday onboarding programs and implementation projects;
  • Support development and maintenance of standardized service templates;
  • Coordinate departmental readiness, training, user adoption, and transition activities;
  • Support interoperability with broader Government of Canada digital initiatives.
  • Must have a PMP Certificate and previous experience managing similar projects with Shared Services Canada considered a strong asset.
  • Ability to demonstrate a minimum of 10 years performing similar tasks (listed above)
  • Ability to demonstrate a minimum of 2 projects with a value of greater than $5 million and a team of 20 or more resources.
  • Ability to demonstrate experience providing project reporting to senior management, steering committees, or executive governance bodies.
  • Ability to demonstrate some of the following: (part of the Rated Requirements)
    • Leading complex, multi-faceted projects and is well versed in Agile methodologies.
    • SAP Financial Systems experience.
    • SAP S/4HANNA experience
    • Financial Transformation experience leading enterprise financial info initiatives involving business process redesign and modernziation.
    • Data migration and integration experience managing SAP mrpeojcts
  • Ability to demonstrate a minimum of 2 projects involving the implementation, transformation, upgrade, migration or modernization of enterprises financial management systems. Projects must have included 1 or more of:
    • Financial Reporting
    • Planning and Budgeting
    • Financial Controls
    • Cost Management
  • Remote work. Must be located in Canada.
  • Must currently hold a valid Secret Government Security Clearance. (held with PSPC)
  • Contract to start ASAP to March 31, 2027 with possibility of renewal.

*Unless otherwise stated, all job postings reflect a current vacancy at the time of publication.

Work-Life Balance

We strongly support a healthy and productive work-life balance. This starts with a flexible approach to work, and policies designed to support employees through their day-to-day routines and major life events. For example, we offer a Maternity/Parental Top-Up (up to 52 weeks) and a Reservist Leave Top-Up (up to 180 days).

ADGA continuously strives to integrate advanced Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) approaches and practices into our work culture. Our employee-based DEI Committee explores activities and invites discussions that foster an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and heard.

Compensation

Above and beyond our commitment to offer a competitive base salary, ADGA has a company-wide profit-sharing plan for all full-time and part-time employees.

Comprehensive Benefits and Total Rewards

We offer a comprehensive benefit program, providing employees with the choice between base or enhanced plans. Depending on the plan, ADGA pays for Health & Dental, a Health Spending Account, Short-Term Disability, an Employee Assistance Program, and a Telemedicine service. You’ll own the full new business lifecycle, from first outreach to signed contract.

You’ll connect Nutrient’s platform to real business problems, combining strong outbound instincts with the ability to articulate a technically complex product to senior stakeholders. Who Thrives Here...

Job Summary:

The Global VP of In Vitro Scientific Operations will lead Crown Bioscience’s global in vitro operations across the US, APAC, and Europe, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, decision-enabling data for oncology and immunology drug discovery programs. This role oversees global assay platforms, multi-site scientific teams, operational strategy, and capability expansion across cell-based, immunology, imaging-based, and translational in vitro systems.

The VP will drive scientific excellence, standardize operations, harmonize workflows across regions, and partner closely with Commercial, R&I and cross-functional scientific groups to ensure operational reliability, scientific rigor, and client satisfaction. This leader must be able to connect in vitro science with in vivo, biomarker, and translational workflows to support integrated project delivery—consistent with Crown’s end-to-end service model.

Responsibilities:

Global Operational & Scientific Leadership

  • Lead all global in vitro scientific operations across Crown’s sites.
  • Ensure consistent and high-quality execution of in vitro studies, maintaining strong scientific rigor, reproducibility, and translational relevance.
  • Drive operational efficiencies through standardized workflows, SOP harmonization, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Operational Excellence & Delivery

  • Oversee end-to-end operational workflows, including study design support, resource planning, execution, QC, reporting, and on-time delivery.
  • Drive improvements in productivity, reproducibility, cycle time, and cross-site alignment.
  • Establish and track operational KPIs (quality, timeliness, resource utilization, client satisfaction).

Platform Expansion & Scientific Capability Development

  • Identify opportunities to expand and modernize in vitro capabilities.
  • Lead implementation of new technologies, automation, and translational assays supporting MoA, PK/PD linkage, and IND-enabling studies.
  • Partner with biomarker, in vivo, and translational science leaders to ensure integration across platforms.

Client Engagement & BD Support

  • Act as a senior scientific representative for key client meetings, supporting proposal development, study design, troubleshooting, and data interpretation.
  • Support BD strategy with strong scientific storytelling, customer retention insights, and expansion of strategic partnerships.
  • Guide teams in translating client program objectives into actionable in vitro study plans.

Cross-Functional Scientific Collaboration

  • Ensure alignment between scientific operations, project management, quality, and commercial teams.
  • Support cross-site initiatives, including platform harmonization and global capability mapping.

Global Leadership, Talent Development & Culture

  • Build a high-performance culture emphasizing scientific rigor, innovation, accountability, and client-centricity.
  • Provide strategic mentorship, succession planning, and competency development across assay platforms.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Oversee global in vitro budgets, headcount planning, capital equipment strategy, and site capacity allocations.
  • Support revenue planning, operational forecasting, and margin optimization.
  • Partner with finance and senior leadership to drive operational efficiency and scalability.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Ph.D. in cancer biology, immunology, pharmacology, molecular/cell biology, or related discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in oncology/immunology preclinical research with deep expertise in in vitro assay platforms.
  • 7+ years of leadership experience managing scientific teams, ideally across multiple global sites.
  • Demonstrated track record in CRO scientific operations, with strong understanding of client expectations and data delivery requirements.
  • Extensive experience designing, executing, and interpreting mechanistic in vitro assays, immune effector studies, co-culture systems, and imaging-based platforms.
  • Proven ability to manage operational workflows, introduce new capabilities, and ensure high-quality scientific output.
  • Excellent communication skills, with experience in client-facing scientific roles.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience leading multi-site or global scientific operations within a CRO or service-based company.
  • Expertise with advanced or emerging in vitro technologies.
  • Deep understanding of oncology, immuno-oncology, and translational biology.
  • Strong program or portfolio management exposure within scientific operations.
  • Strong commercial partnership history with BD teams and biotech/pharma clients.
  • Cross-cultural leadership experience and ability to manage teams across time zones.

Description

About ITS:

Do you have the CHOPS? IT Solutions lives its values: Client Success is Our Success, Hungry for the Journey, Ownership Thinking, Passionate Problem Solving, and Surrender the Ego. If your values align, we want you to be a part of a fast-growing Managed Service Provider specializing in providing high-end technology solutions to small and mid-market businesses. IT Solutions is a nationally recognized leader in the IT space, with over 25 years of experience and thousands of satisfied clients. Join and grow with us, as we continue to innovate new ways to help businesses Experience Excellence.

Job Summary: The Director, Financial Planning & Analysis provides strategic leadership for the organization’s financial planning, forecasting, performance management, and decision-support capabilities. Reporting to the CFO, this role serves as a trusted financial partner to executive leadership and translates business strategy into measurable financial and operational plans. The Director leads the annual budget, long-range planning, and recurring forecasting processes; establishes scalable financial models and management reporting; and delivers forward-looking insights regarding growth, profitability, cash flow, capital allocation, and business performance. The position strengthens financial discipline across the organization, identifies emerging risks and opportunities, and enables leaders to make informed, data-driven decisions.

This role also builds and develops the FP&A function by establishing clear standards, strengthening business partnerships, improving systems and processes, and leading a high-performing team capable of supporting the organization’s continued growth.

Requirements

Responsibilities:

Financial Strategy and Executive Partnership

  • Serve as a strategic financial advisor to the CFO, executive leadership, and business leaders.
  • Translate organizational strategy into financial priorities, operating plans, performance measures, and resource-allocation recommendations.
  • Provide objective financial perspectives on growth opportunities, operational investments, organizational capacity, and business risks.
  • Develop executive-level financial narratives that connect results, operating performance, assumptions, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Lead scenario planning and sensitivity analysis to evaluate alternative strategies and potential business outcomes.
  • Support leadership discussions concerning organic growth, new offerings, market expansion, pricing, investments, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Present financial analyses, forecasts, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership and other key stakeholders.

Enterprise Planning, Budgeting, and Forecasting

  • Own and continuously improve the organization’s annual budgeting, recurring forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes.
  • Establish planning calendars, methodologies, assumptions, templates, governance standards, and accountability across participating business units.
  • Partner with functional leaders to develop financially sound operating plans aligned with organizational goals.
  • Consolidate departmental plans into an integrated company forecast covering revenue, profitability, operating expenses, cash flow, and capital requirements.
  • Assess forecast accuracy, identify significant deviations, and implement improvements to assumptions, methodologies, and planning practices.
  • Ensure financial plans reflect operational drivers, workforce requirements, investment priorities, and anticipated business conditions.
  • Maintain multiple financial scenarios that enable leadership to respond effectively to changing performance or market conditions.

Financial Analysis and Performance Management

  • Establish an enterprise performance-management framework that connects strategic priorities with financial and operational measures.
  • Lead monthly and quarterly analysis of actual performance compared with budget, forecast, prior periods, and strategic expectations.
  • Identify the underlying drivers of financial performance and convert findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Oversee profitability and margin analysis by service, offering, client segment, business unit, or other relevant dimensions.
  • Evaluate revenue performance, cost structure, operating leverage, working capital, cash flow, return on investment, and capital requirements.
  • Develop leading indicators and early-warning measures that identify emerging financial risks and opportunities.
  • Partner with Finance and business leaders to define corrective actions when performance differs from plan.

Reporting, Analytics, and Business Intelligence

  • Lead the development of accurate, timely, and decision-oriented management reporting.
  • Establish consistent definitions, methodologies, and governance for financial and operational performance measures.
  • Develop executive dashboards and reporting packages that highlight results, trends, risks, opportunities, and required decisions.
  • Advance the use of automation, financial systems, analytical tools, and business intelligence within the FP&A function.
  • Reduce manual reporting and increase the team’s capacity for forward-looking analysis and strategic support.
  • Collaborate with Accounting and other data owners to reconcile management reporting with underlying financial records.

Capital Allocation, Investment, and Transaction Support

  • Develop financial frameworks for evaluating capital deployment, strategic investments, business cases, and competing resource priorities.
  • Lead financial modeling and due diligence support for potential acquisitions, integrations, investments, and partnerships.
  • Evaluate expected returns, cash requirements, financial risks, sensitivities, and strategic alignment.
  • Monitor the performance of approved investments against the original business case and recommend corrective actions as needed.
  • Support post-transaction planning and performance tracking, as applicable.

Financial Governance and Risk Management

  • Establish and maintain appropriate FP&A policies, controls, documentation, and review practices.
  • Ensure financial models, forecasts, and management reports use consistent assumptions and reliable source information.
  • Identify financial, operational, and market risks and develop mitigation recommendations for executive consideration.
  • Partner with Accounting to support alignment with GAAP, financial reporting requirements, and internal control expectations.
  • Maintain appropriate confidentiality over financial, employee, client, and transaction-related information.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build strong partnerships with leaders across the organization and serve as the primary FP&A point of contact for strategic financial planning.
  • Increase financial understanding and accountability by helping leaders interpret performance and evaluate trade-offs.
  • Facilitate planning and performance discussions that generate clear decisions, owners, and follow-through.
  • Constructively challenge assumptions while maintaining productive, solutions-oriented relationships.
  • Coordinate with Accounting, Operations, Sales, Human Resources, and other teams so plans and forecasts reflect current business conditions.

People Leadership and Functional Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop the FP&A team, establishing clear expectations for performance, quality, responsiveness, and business partnership.
  • Determine team priorities, allocate resources, and balance recurring deliverables with strategic projects.
  • Build team capabilities in financial modeling, forecasting, analytics, executive communication, and business partnership.
  • Provide meaningful feedback, professional development, and career-growth opportunities.
  • Establish succession and capability plans that support the long-term needs of the FP&A function.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, curiosity, continuous improvement, collaboration, and ownership thinking.

Experience

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: 

  • Advanced knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and corporate finance.
  • Strong understanding of financial statements, working capital, GAAP, key financial ratios, and performance measures.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect financial analysis with business strategy and operational execution.
  • Executive-level communication, presentation, and influencing capabilities, both in person and virtually using Microsoft Teams.
  • Ability to convert complex financial information into focused insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Strong business partnership skills, including the ability to constructively challenge assumptions and facilitate decisions.
  • Strong understanding of profitability, pricing, scenario modeling, investment analysis, and capital allocation.
  • Experience improving financial systems, reporting tools, automation, and data quality.
  • Ability to lead through change, ambiguity, growth, and competing priorities.
  • Demonstrated people-leadership, coaching, performance-management, and talent-development capabilities.
  • High standards for accuracy, integrity, confidentiality, and accountability.

Experience: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or strategic finance
  • 3+ years of formal people-leadership experience, preferably leading financial analysts or an FP&A function
  • Demonstrated experience owning enterprise budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and long-range planning
  • Experience partnering directly with executive leaders and presenting financial recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Experience improving financial processes, reporting, systems, automation, or business intelligence capabilities
  • Preferred: experience in a growing, multi-entity, or acquisitive organization, ideally in technology services or a Managed Service Provider environment
  • Preferred: experience supporting acquisitions, due diligence, integration planning, or investment evaluation

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:  

  • CPA, CMA, CFA, ACA/ACCA/CIMA, or equivalent professional finance or accounting qualification preferred
  • MBA or other relevant graduate degree preferred

Compensation Package

ITS offers a full benefits package, including:

  • Rich Medical and prescription plans
  • Dental & Vision
  • Paid Holidays and Flexible Paid Time Off
  • 401K/401K Roth with Safe Harbor matching
  • Stock Appreciation Rights
  • Company-paid life insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • Company-paid mental health support & financial wellness services
  • FSA for medical and dependent care
  • HSA option with compatible medical plan
  • Company-paid training, materials, and exams
  • Performance-based bonuses

raw.description:
Présentation de l'organisation

  • Gestion des infrastructures IT, notamment les réseaux, la sécurité, les data centers et le cloud
  • Développement d'applications métiers sur mesure
  • Accompagnement des projets digitaux, dont l'analyse fonctionnelle, l'UX/UI et la gestion de projet
  • Cybersécurité et protection des données
  • Support aux utilisateurs et formation

Mission

Le/la Product Owner assure le suivi opérationnel d'un ou plusieurs projets ou domaines métiers et facilite la mise en œuvre des évolutions fonctionnelles, en particulier dans le cadre des solutions IT de l'AGMJ.

Il/elle prend en charge les sujets qui lui sont confiés, depuis la clarification des besoins jusqu'à la validation métier et à l'accompagnement de la mise en œuvre.

Dans l'exercice de sa fonction, le/la Product Owner agit dans le respect de la gouvernance en place au sein de l'AGMJ. Les orientations stratégiques, arbitrages, priorités, règles métier structurantes et décisions fonctionnelles majeures sont validés par les instances compétentes. Le/la Product Owner prépare les éléments utiles à ces décisions, en assure le suivi opérationnel et veille à leur bonne exécution.

Activités

  • Recueillir et analyser les besoins des utilisateurs
  • Étudier les processus et pratiques métier, identifier les difficultés et proposer, avec les utilisateurs, des améliorations ainsi que des processus cibles
  • Contribuer à la rédaction des user stories, des critères d'acceptation et des spécifications fonctionnelles
  • Veiller, avant la prise en charge des sujets par l'IT, à ce que les objectifs, règles métier, cas particuliers et critères d'acceptation soient suffisamment définis, puis coordonner la résolution des questions ouvertes
  • Structurer, maintenir et prioriser le backlog en préparant les propositions de priorisation
  • Préparer les éléments nécessaires aux arbitrages, notamment les options possibles, leurs impacts et les points à trancher
  • Organiser les décisions et validations métier, identifier les interlocuteurs, préparer les sujets à arbitrer et assurer la traçabilité des décisions et de leurs impacts
  • Organiser la revue métier des analyses fonctionnelles, maquettes et propositions produites par les équipes impliquées, vérifier leur adéquation aux besoins et suivre le traitement des remarques
  • Assurer le suivi fonctionnel des évolutions et la coordination avec les équipes de développement
  • Suivre l'avancement des développements et remonter les points d'attention, risques ou dépendances
  • Assurer le suivi des engagements entre les parties prenantes, tenir à jour les actions, responsables et échéances, effectuer les relances et préparer les points nécessitant un arbitrage ou une escalade
  • Organiser et coordonner les tests métier, notamment la préparation des scénarios, la mobilisation des testeurs, le suivi de l'exécution, la qualification des anomalies et la vérification des corrections
  • Faciliter les échanges entre les équipes métier, les utilisateurs finaux et l'équipe IT afin de garantir une compréhension claire des besoins
  • Préparer et accompagner l'adoption des évolutions, identifier les utilisateurs concernés, contribuer aux consignes et supports, organiser les démonstrations et suivre les difficultés après mise en service
  • Recueillir les retours des utilisateurs et proposer des pistes d'amélioration
  • Capitaliser et maintenir les connaissances métier utiles aux projets, telles que les règles métier, processus, décisions et scénarios de référence, en s'appuyant sur la documentation existante
  • Définir avec le métier des indicateurs simples et suivre les résultats des évolutions livrées afin d'en évaluer l'utilisation, les bénéfices et les priorités suivantes
  • Contribuer au suivi d'avancement et à la communication auprès des parties prenantes
  • Contribuer à la définition et à la mise en œuvre des orientations stratégiques de son périmètre, en cohérence avec les décisions validées
  • Préparer les éléments nécessaires aux arbitrages, formuler des recommandations et suivre leur mise en œuvre après décision
  • Préparer et documenter les décisions fonctionnelles structurantes, veiller à leur cohérence avec les besoins métier et assurer leur application après validation
  • Contribuer à la formalisation, à l'évolution et à la cohérence des règles métier structurantes avec les experts métier et les instances concernées
  • Assurer le suivi des engagements liés à son périmètre, alerter sur les risques identifiés et proposer les mesures nécessaires à leur maîtrise

📝 Votre profil

  • Expérience confirmée en tant que Product Owner
  • Bonne maîtrise des méthodes Agile
  • Capacité à modéliser et analyser des գործընթաց métier, notamment avec BPMN
  • Expérience en Data Management
  • Maîtrise du Design Thinking
  • Expérience en UX Design & Research
  • Capacité à traduire les besoins métier en user stories, critères d'acceptation et priorités de backlog
  • Français requis

⚠️ Ce poste est proposé en tant que rôle freelance à temps partiel (60%).

Technical Assistance Representative/Chemist - Composite Resins

About Polynt Composites USA:

Polynt Composites USA is a global leader in the manufacturing of composites, coatings, and chemical intermediates, serving key industries such as industrial, transportation, construction, marine, medical, and consumer goods.

At Polynt, Technical Assistance Representatives work closely with other Polynt functions including commercial, operations and R&D to assist existing and new customers in using Polynt Products. This role participates in product recommendations, product testing/benchmarking, training, product trials, process review, and troubleshooting. Technical Assistance provides customers with formal or informal training and is an interface for investigation and communication concerning product complaints. This role directly contributes to Polynt’s commercial success through achieving product approvals, customer satisfaction, and customer loyalty. Technical Assistance also provides direction for product development efforts.

The Technical Assistance Representative works under the direction of a TA supervisor or mentor and Polynt Account Manager. Assignments typically focus on a specific technology area with exposure to other areas, depending on organizational needs, performance, etc. This role will serve the western United States and western regions of Canada including Southern & Northern California, Washington, Oregon, Nevada, Arizona, Utah, New Mexico, Colorado, Wyoming, Edmonton, and Alberta. The salary range for this position is $90,000 - $120,000/annum. Candidate must be living in the Western region of the US in a close proximity to an airport. This position does not provide sponsorship and candidates must be authorized to work in the US for any employer.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Health, Safety and Quality
    • Performs work in accordance with local, state and federal regulations including OSHA, DOT and EPA and the appropriate Polynt Chemical Hygiene Plan (CHP) ensuring personal and team safety
    • Recognizes personal and legal responsibility regarding compliance with rules and regulations, standards and Polynt’s ISO 9001 Quality Management System
    • Maintains housekeeping in individual and shared workspaces
    • Conducts inspections as assigned
    • Ensures that others meet health and safety standards. Provides guidance when needed
    • Leads safety topic(s) in weekly safety meeting
    • Participates in the following as needed:
      • Health and Safety Committee
      • Review of chemical hygiene plan
      • Job safety analysis (JSA)
      • Risk assessments
      • Incident investigation
      • Management of change (MOC)
  • Product Line Knowledge/Product Recommendations
    • Conduct process reviews and gather information from customer including processing parameters, end use requirements including required certifications and usage information (volumes, batch sizes, etc.)
    • Reviews existing products for potential technical fit and considering costs, manufacturing site/logistics, minimum order quantity
    • Communicates recommendation to customer
    • If no existing product meets the requirements, enters development project as appropriate based on commercial opportunity.
  • Training - Provides training to customers (either at the customer's location or at Polynt), or Polynt personnel (junior team members, R&D members from other groups, commercial personnel, etc.). Able to do demonstrations as appropriate.
  • Product Trials
    • Follow trial product through the customer process and document product performance.
    • Report product performance to appropriate commercial and R&D personnel.
    • Follow up with customer on post-production part testing and provide feedback to appropriate commercial and R&D personnel
  • Process Review/ Troubleshooting
    • Identify best practices and poor practices.
    • Communicate strengths and opportunities for improvement to customer
    • Diagnose routine issues with Polynt products
    • Execute field adjustments to Polynt products or recommend changes to customer formulations
  • Reporting
    • Write call reports covering customer visits
    • Write customer letters covering findings of customer visits
  • Specialization - Developing knowledge of a business unit in one or more chemistries, applications/market areas or processes. Making contacts with other Polynt functional groups, suppliers, and customer bases. Learning industry organizations, standards and certifications.
  • Organizational Knowledge
    • Able to find/view test methods, work instructions, forms and other documents in Polynt DMS
    • Able to find technical documents in the Polynt App and Host 2 Bulletin System
    • Able to enter a project on the Host 2 Project System/RADAR
    • Able to request physical or analytical testing
    • Working knowledge of Microsoft applications including Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams and Word
    • Able to book travel and report expenses
    • Order raw materials and finished goods with supervisor approval as applicable
    • Order lab supplies with supervisor approval as applicable
    • Able to find basic information in SAP including, BOM's, inspections plans, inventories, orders, etc.
    • Able to search Host2 Project System Archives

Education and Experience

  • B.A. or B.S. in chemistry, chemical engineering or related science/engineering field
  • Minimum of 2 years related industry experience in polyester and vinyl ester thermoset resins, other thermoset resins and/or gel coats.

Work Environment Considerations

This job is not appropriate for individuals with chemical sensitivity. Employees who display sensitivity to the chemicals present at the site despite using standard required safety measures may be subject to reassignment or termination of employment.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Polynt fosters a culture of innovation, teamwork, and professional growth. Employees have opportunities for career progression and development. If you are a hands-on problem solver who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.

Why Join Us?

At Polynt, we believe our employees are our greatest asset. We offer a stable, growth-driven work environment with competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and Sick Leave
  • 401(k) with Company Match and Profit Sharing
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (PPO, HSA, FSA)
  • Company-Paid Life Insurance and Short-Term Disability
  • Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Paid Holidays
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • This position is eligible for annual incentive program

Equal Opportunity Employer

Polynt Composites USA is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). We celebrate diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local laws.
