raw.excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLE:Intertrend is looking for a curious, proactive and analytically minded Media Planner who can help turn audience insights, cultural understanding and media opportunities into effective communications plans.
raw.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:

Intertrend is looking for a curious, proactive and analytically minded Media Planner who can help turn audience insights, cultural understanding and media opportunities into effective communications plans.

This role goes beyond building tactical media plans. The Media Planner will contribute across the planning process, from understanding audiences and identifying media opportunities to developing cross-channel recommendations, executing campaigns, optimizing performance and translating results into actionable insights.

We are looking for someone who brings ideas to the table, asks questions, explores new partners and solutions, and actively contributes to stronger work. You will collaborate with Media, Strategy, Creative, Account, Analytics and external partners to help develop campaigns that connect paid media with broader owned, earned and cultural opportunities.

This is a hands-on role with exposure to media planning, client interactions, partner meetings, custom programs, campaign execution, optimization and reporting.

REPORTING TO:

This role reports to the Associate Media Director and works closely with Media Directors and cross-functional agency teams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Media & Communication Planning

● Develop strategic, cross-channel media recommendations based on client objectives, audience insights, cultural behaviors, competitive intelligence, historical performance and syndicated research.

● Understand the roles of paid, owned and earned media and contribute media and audience perspectives to broader communication planning.

● Recommend appropriate audiences, channels, partners, KPIs, budget allocations and activation approaches.

● Collaborate with Strategy, Creative and Account teams to connect media thinking with the broader campaign idea and consumer journey.

● Participate in ideation and actively bring forward media-led opportunities that can strengthen the campaign.


Curiosity & Innovation

● Stay curious about emerging platforms, consumer behaviors, cultural trends and changes in the media landscape.

● Proactively identify new media partners, technologies, targeting opportunities, content integrations and custom programs.

● Build relationships with media partners and bring relevant opportunities back to the broader team.

● Share trends, insights and examples that can inspire new thinking across Media and other disciplines.


Campaign Execution & Stewardship

● Manage campaign execution from plan approval through launch, including media authorizations/IOs, trafficking coordination, partner communication and campaign delivery.

● Monitor pacing, delivery and performance and proactively flag issues before they become problems.

● Work with media partners and internal teams to troubleshoot discrepancies and ensure campaigns deliver against objectives.

● Maintain accurate media budgets and oversee monthly reconciliation in partnership with Finance and Accounting.

Optimization, Insights & Storytelling

● Monitor campaign performance and identify optimization opportunities in partnership with Analytics and media partners.

● Interpret campaign data to understand what happened, why it happened and what we should do next.

● Connect insights across channels to provide a holistic view of campaign performance.

● Translate data and media performance into clear, actionable recommendations and compelling client-facing stories.

● Apply campaign learnings to future planning and optimization.

Client & Cross-Functional Collaboration

● Participate in client meetings and progressively take ownership of presenting sections of media plans, recommendations, and campaign results.

● Build productive relationships with clients, media partners and partner agencies.

● Bring a media and consumer perspective to cross-functional conversations while remaining open to perspectives from other disciplines.

● Ask questions and seek clarity when objectives, priorities, or direction are unclear rather than waiting for others to resolve them.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Minimum of 2 years of experience in media planning, including campaign strategy, media research, and performance analysis

Curious and proactive. You don't wait to be told everything to explore. You look for opportunities, ask questions, and bring ideas forward.

Resourceful and solutions-oriented. When challenges arise, you investigate, propose solutions, and help move the work forward.

Accountable. You take ownership of your work, deadlines, budgets, and campaign details.

Analytical. You are comfortable working with data and can turn information into insights and recommendations.

A storyteller. You can communicate not just what the numbers say, but what they mean for the client and what should happen next.

Collaborative. You actively contribute while respecting different perspectives across Media, Strategy, Creative, Account, and Analytics.

Nimble. You are comfortable learning new things and stepping outside a narrowly defined task list when the work requires it.

WHAT’S IT LIKE WORKING AT INTERTREND:

  • Work with fun, loving yet hard-working individuals! Our biggest values center on dialogue, cross-functional collaboration, curiosity, and respect.
  • Got a furry friend at home that you’ll miss? Bring them to work with you! We have multiple four-legged ambassadors at our offices to welcome you both.
  • We’re a multi-cultural agency focused on the Asian American community, so if you’re passionate about the latest Asian American trends, culture, and media, openly share it!
  • Want to give back to the community? Intertrend is not just about making a profit; we are also here to make a difference! Join us on our various volunteering programs and opportunities. Be an agent of change!
  • Like to branch out to different tasks to learn and grow? We always have projects on hand seeking volunteers; you can seek out challenges that’ll help shape you!

Pay Range$70,000-$80,000

We recognize that every candidate brings a different combination of experience and expertise. As a result, compensation is determined individually, taking into account job-related skills, relevant experience, education, training, and other factors that contribute to success in the role.

raw.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100979

Position Overview


We are seeking an experienced product and technical marketing professional with a mechanical design and engineering background to support and expand the Fusion design portfolio in EMEA. Autodesk Fusion brings CAD, CAM, CAE, PCB, PDM, and PLM together on one cloud platform at a price that puts professional tools within reach of every engineer and every shop. EMEA is home to some of the world’s most demanding design and manufacturing customers, and they don’t buy generic messaging. They buy from people who understand their workflows, their tools, and their constraints.

You will own messaging and positioning for Fusion design in the region, develop technical assets, and produce enablement content that empowers our go-to-market teams to win against entrenched incumbents such as SolidWorks, Inventor, Onshape, NX, and Creo. This role requires someone who has worked as an engineer or designer, understands how products are modeled, simulated, documented, and released to manufacturing, and can translate technical capabilities into compelling business value. Ideal candidates will bring an experimentation mindset and continuously find ways to use AI to scale themselves and the team.

Responsibilities

Product Marketing

  • Own the Autodesk Fusion design story and point of view for EMEA, including AI-enabled design workflows, adapting the global narrative to regional segments, industries, and competitive dynamics, and feeding what you learn back into the global story.
  • Define and articulate messaging and positioning for Fusion design across parametric and direct modeling, assemblies, simulation, generative design, electronics, data management, and the connected design-to-manufacture workflow.
  • Spend real time with customers. Run discovery conversations with mechanical engineers, industrial designers, and shop owners across the region, then turn their pain points, language, and objections into messaging, campaigns, and enablement.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape and build competitive intelligence and positioning, including win/loss signal that you bring back to product, global PMM, and regional sales.
  • Develop go-to-market strategies in collaboration with product management, sales, and Campaigns, Demand Gen, and Growth Marketing teams to drive adoption. Co-own the outcomes: you succeed when their funnels convert.
  • Lead regional launches end to end: localized messaging, field and partner enablement, events, and post-launch adoption. Turn each release into a demand-generating moment, not just an announcement.
  • Create enablement materials including presentations, solution one-pagers, competitive comparisons, battlecards, and case studies.
  • Partner with the channel and strategic partner ecosystem across EMEA to drive adoption and awareness.
  • Partner with industry strategy and product management teams to ensure alignment with market needs.

Technical Marketing

  • Build technical assets such as demos, reference workflows, videos, and blogs showcasing Fusion’s design capabilities, from first sketch through simulation, drawings, and handoff to manufacturing.
  • Run hands-on competitive evaluations. Build the same part or assembly in Fusion and in competing tools, and document where Fusion wins, where it doesn’t, and what that means for positioning. Turn the results into comparison assets that hold up to engineering scrutiny.
  • Validate new workflows and features before release to ensure accurate technical storytelling, and give product management a clear read on how each feature will land with EMEA customers.
  • Develop out-of-the-box, ready-to-run technical demos that field teams and partners can deliver without you.
  • Deliver and support technical presentations at internal and external events, such as Autodesk University and regional industry conferences.
  • Collaborate with product teams to highlight differentiators and competitive advantages.

AI-Driven Workflows


  • Build and maintain AI-powered workflows that scale product and technical marketing, such as call-transcript and win/loss analysis, competitive release monitoring, messaging testing pipelines, and research synthesis.
  • Maintain the custom GPTs, Claude projects, and skills your team uses day to day. Show us what you built and what it changed.

Qualifications

  • A degree in mechanical engineering or a closely related field, or equivalent hands-on experience as a practicing engineer or designer.
  • 5+ years of experience in mechanical design or engineering roles, such as product design, design engineering, or applications engineering, with hands-on use of a CAD tool in real projects.
  • Strong technical experience with Fusion or another major CAD platform (SolidWorks, Inventor, NX, Creo, CATIA, Solid Edge, or Onshape). You understand parametric versus direct modeling and can explain why the difference matters to a customer. Ideal candidates will have knowledge of competitive CAD tools.
  • Familiarity with simulation, generative design, electronics design, CAM, or PDM/PLM is a plus, along with the curiosity to learn the rest.
  • Proven experience in product marketing and technical marketing within software or engineering technology. If your background is in solutions engineering, applications engineering, or technical sales, show us the positioning, enablement, or launch work that demonstrates product marketing aptitude and ambition.
  • You’ve shaped positioning and messaging, tested it with real customers, and iterated until it resonated. You don’t ship copy you haven’t validated.
  • Strong ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and business audiences.
  • Skilled in creating engaging multimedia content (video, demos, infographics).
  • Demonstrated experience building AI workflows beyond the chat window, such as agents, automated analysis, or custom GPTs and skills your team relies on.
  • Fluent in the EMEA market and comfortable with multi-country, multi-language GTM. English is required; German, French, or another major European language is a plus.

How We’ll Measure Success

  • Messaging that resonates with EMEA customers, is adopted by field and partners, and shows up in win rates.
  • Technical content, demos, and comparisons that field teams use and that hold up when customers test them.
  • A steady flow of customer insight that changes global positioning, campaigns, or roadmap priorities.
  • Regional launch and campaign outcomes (activation, adoption, and pipeline influenced), measured jointly with Campaigns, Demand Gen, and Growth.
  • AI-driven workflows that shorten the time from customer or competitor signal to updated positioning and enablement.

Why Join Us?

Fusion is a strategic growth area for Autodesk, and EMEA is a market we’re actively building. In this role, you will shape how we tell the story of connected design and manufacturing workflows and help customers move from first concept to finished product on one platform.

Learn More


About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.


We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.


When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

raw.description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.
With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit:
At the heart of our mission is an unwavering commitment to safety. Behavior Verification answers one question: is the driver's on-road behavior good enough to release, and how can we prove it even further? We are seeking a rigorous and decisive systems engineer to build the evidence behind that answer. You will define the scenario and test set content that various Software releases are measured against and that enable the development of new capabilities and features, establish the validity checks that keep those test sets trustworthy, and act as the gatekeeper for what enters the release pipeline. Your work directly informs whether autonomy software is promoted.

You will…

  • Design and document the scenario and test sets that establish on-road behavior performance, from minimum to comprehensive.
  • Own what enters the release pipeline: define and run the scenario validity checks, and approve or refuse test sets before they are used to judge a release.
  • Maintain continuous quality feedback of the artifacts test sets depend on — scenarios, taggers, graders and the taxonomy behind them.
  • Turn behavior requirements into testable criteria, working with Behavior Requirements on targets and acceptance criteria that someone will sign.
  • Investigate behavior deficiencies: find further instances, establish what exposure we have to them, and return them to the pipeline as test escapes.
  • Distinguish genuine behavior failures from simulation artifacts, and raise simulation fidelity gaps with the corresponding teams.
    Work across the organization — motion planning, simulation, evaluation, operations, safety methodology and platform — and hold the interfaces between them.
  • Align verification phases and cadence with the organization: what runs on a daily release, and what a significant step in exposure requires.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in a relevant engineering or related field (e.g., Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, Advanced Controls, Aerospace, etc.).
  • Experience verifying safety-critical systems, ideallyin autonomous vehicles.
  • Demonstrated experience designing test cases from requirements, and assessing what a test set covers and what it misses.
  • Applied statistics: sample size, confidence, and what a result does and does not support.
  • Proficiency in Python and the ability to navigate a large codebase.
  • Familiarity with autonomous vehicle requirements, behaviors and design methodologies.
  • Strong ability to structure, document and prioritize a large number of test sets and test strategies.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a diplomatic way, across teams that do not always agree.
  • A drive for commitment and accountability, for yourself and for others.

Bonus/nice to have:

  • Trucking or heavy-vehicle exposure.
  • Machine learning experience, particularly model evaluation and false-positive / false-negative trade-offs.
  • Exposure to regulatory frameworks: NHTSA, ISO 26262, SOTIF.
  • Familiarity with the tooling required to extract coverage and exposure from large driving-log sets.
  • Comfortable working in a newly formed team, where the process has to be built rather than followed.

The salary base range is reflective of the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US and Canada locations. Perks/Benefits:

The EDI Integration Analyst is responsible for the design, development, implementation, support, and continuous improvement of Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) integrations that enable the secure and accurate exchange of business transactions between Mizkan and its customers, suppliers, logistics providers, and other trading partners. This role partners with business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and external partners to deliver scalable integration solutions that support critical business processes within Microsoft Dynamics 365 and related enterprise applications.

Position Overview

Job Title: EDI Integratio Analyst

Location: Remote - United States

Department: Information Technology

Reports to: Associate Director, IT Applications



About Mizkan


Mizkan America, headquartered in Schaumburg, Illinois, is a part of the Mizkan Group, a global, family-owned company that has been Bringing Flavor to Life™ for more than 220 years. We're one of the leading makers of vinegars, condiments and sauces in the U.S., with manufacturing facilities across the country serving retail, foodservice, and food ingredient customers. Our portfolio covers Meal Solutions, Flavor Enhancers and Inspired Mixology. It includes trusted brands such as RAGÚ®, BERTOLLI®, BORN SIMPLE®, HOLLAND HOUSE®, NAKANO®, MIZKAN® and ZING ZANG®, and we're the exclusive North American importer and distributor of ANGOSTURA®.


Why Join Mizkan?


We combine the resources and brand power of a major food company with the speed and agility of a smaller company. That means fewer layers, faster decisions and real ownership of work you can see on store shelves. Two principles guide everything we do: offer customers only the finest products and continuously challenge the status quo. We're investing in what's next, including tools and training to use AI responsibly so it strengthens human judgment rather than replacing it. Whether you work in operations, innovation, commercial or a corporate function, your work makes an impact, and we're invested in your growth.


Work Location & Schedule

Work Location: This remote position is open to candidates residing in the United States.

Work Arrangement: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely from a home-office location.

Schedule: This role is scheduled for at least eight (8) hours per day and 40 or more hours per week. Core hours are 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Central Time, Monday through Friday, to support meetings and team collaboration. Start and end times may be flexible between 6:00 a.m. and 9:00 p.m., as long as core hours, team needs, and project deadlines are met.

Additional Requirements: The position may require occasional travel and onsite attendance for meetings, training, projects, or other business needs. Any exception or change in work schedule requires supervisor approval.


What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain EDI maps, integrations, transaction sets, and related documentation.
  • Monitor inbound and outbound EDI transactions to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data exchange with trading partners.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve EDI-related issues, including transaction failures, data discrepancies, and communication errors.
  • Configure and maintain trading partner profiles, communication settings, and business process workflows.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, vendors, and external trading partners to onboard new EDI connections and support ongoing integration requirements.
  • Support the integration of EDI solutions with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and other enterprise business applications.
  • Analyze existing EDI processes and recommend improvements that enhance system performance, operational efficiency, and data quality.
  • Develop and execute testing plans to validate EDI transactions, workflows, and integrations.
  • Perform data analysis and reporting activities using SQL and other tools to support troubleshooting, validation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain compliance with EDI standards and internal data governance requirements.
  • Provide technical support, user guidance, and training related to EDI processes and integrations.
  • Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, implementation projects, and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Perform regular reviews or audits to support data accuracy, integrity, and compliance with applicable EDI standards and requirements.
  • Perform other duties assigned that support the overall success of the team, department, or organization. This may include participating in cross-functional initiatives, contributing to process improvements, or assisting with special projects as needed.
  • This list is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. This is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities required for this role.


What You'll Bring

  • EDI implementation and maintenance, EDI mapping, X12 transaction sets, EDI communications protocols, SQL queries, interface support, ERP integration, and data accuracy review.
  • Microsoft ERP/D365 environments, AX2009/AX2012/D365 concepts, IBM Sterling B2B Integrator, IBM Sterling File Gateway or comparable tools, Direct, VAN, AS2, FTP, SFTP, HTTPS, and other EDI partner solutions such as OpenText, TrueCommerce, SPS/Data Masons, Staedean, and Boomi.
  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving.
  • Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Effective verbal and written communication.
  • Organization and project coordination.
  • Collaboration across cross-functional teams.
  • Customer service and stakeholder management.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously

Education/Experience/Qualifications/Certifications



  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology. Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
  • 3+ years of experience with EDI implementation and maintenance, including integration development tools for EDI mapping and business process modeling.
    3+ years of experience with EDI communications, including Direct, VAN, AS2, FTP, SFTP, HTTPS, or similar protocols.
  • 3+ years of demonstrable EDI experience, preferably developing and supporting X12 maps such as 850, 855, 856, 810, 940, 943, 944, 945, 947, and related transaction sets.
  • Demonstrated EDI configuration experience, including partner profile setup and business process modeling.
  • Experience writing SQL queries.
  • Advanced experience with EDI inbound and outbound interface functionality and developing and supporting interfaces for different business processes.
  • Strong knowledge of ANSI X12 standards and EDI best practices.
  • Experience in a CPG or manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Preferred or bonus experience: solid understanding of standard manufacturing business processes, including Order to Cash, Concept to Market, Procure to Pay, Pick to Ship, Plan to Production, and Post to Close; X++ development skills; Boomi EDI platform experience; and Staedean ISV Solution experience, formerly ToIncrease.


Physical Requirements & Work Conditions

  • Ability to remain seated at a workstation for extended periods (up to 8 hours per day).
  • Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing, writing, and handling office equipment.
  • Ability to view computer screens and read printed materials for prolonged periods.
  • Occasional standing, walking, and reaching within the office environment.
  • Ability to lift and carry office supplies or equipment weighing up to 10–15 lbs.
  • Adequate hearing and speech to communicate effectively in person and via phone/video.
  • Regular, predictable attendance during core business hours in a remote work environment is an essential function of this position. Employees are expected to be responsive, accessible, and actively engaged throughout the workday.

Compensation & Benefits



Compensation: The annual salary range for this position is $100,000 - $150,000 per year. This position is not eligible for overtime pay.

Actual compensation may vary based on relevant experience, skills, education, internal equity, market data, and geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

Benefits eligibility and plan provisions are subject to the terms of the applicable benefit plans.

raw.title: UX Designer
raw.excerpt: RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional UX Designer.
raw.description:
RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional UX Designer.

About RainFocus

RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market — it will be challenging, fun and exciting.

About the Role

You’ll play an important part in the entire product development process, from brainstorming to launch. You’ll be part of a UX team where each designer is responsible for different areas of our product and integrated into individual scrum teams. They work closely with the Product Manager and Developers to create elegant solutions to problems our customers are facing. The product team also includes front-end developers who share our passion to deliver a great user experience throughout our platform.

What You'll Do:

  • Shape ideas into testable bets

  • Partner with stakeholders and executives to capture strategic ideas and turn them into clear hypotheses

  • Define the problem, the target customer, the business case, and the evidence that would change our minds

  • Push back constructively when an idea lacks a clear problem or buyer

    • Lead discovery research

  • Plan and run high-volume discovery with customers and prospects, including interviews, workshops, concept tests, and usability sessions

  • Work with Stakeholders, Sales, and Customer Success to find the right participants quickly

  • Synthesize findings into short, decision-ready insights

    • Build proof-of-concept prototypes

  • Create interactive prototypes, from clickable concepts to functional PoCs, using AI-assisted tools

  • Apply sound UX judgment to flows, information architecture, and interaction design

  • Work with your developer counterpart to draw a clear line between prototype-grade and production-ready, and hand off cleanly

  • Use PoCs to confirm understanding, not to deliver solutions

    • Validate against the market

  • Test willingness to adopt and pay, not just whether people like the idea

  • Define success signals before each validation cycle and track them

  • Present recommendations to leadership with the evidence behind them

    • Protect the integrity of the process

  • Frame every prototype clearly as exploratory so customers never hear a commitment

  • Work with Sales and Legal on NDAs, disclosure, and expectation-setting

  • Keep Sales informed of what you're learning and what is, and isn't, safe to say to customers

    • Lead the pod

  • Set priorities, rhythm, and working agreements for a small cross-functional team

  • Share frequent, brief readouts instead of big-bang reviews

  • Build reusable templates, scripts, and prototype patterns that make each cycle faster

    • What this role does NOT do

  • Build or customize solutions for a specific customer

  • Help customers integrate, configure, or implement our software

  • Make roadmap or delivery commitments based purely on a PoC

  • Ship production code (engineering reviews and rebuilds PoCs before anything goes to market)

What Success Looks Like:

    Success is measured by the quality of the decision, not by whether an idea moves forward. A well-evidenced "stop" is a win.

  • Ideas reach a go/no-go decision in weeks, not quarters

  • Ideas the business funds are backed by clear problem definitions, working prototypes, and customer proof

  • Leadership and Sales trust the evidence and understand why ideas advanced or stopped

  • Fewer fully built features fail to find demand

What You Bring:

    Core skills

  • Strong business thinking: markets, buyers, pricing, and ROI, not just usability

  • Demonstrated rapid prototyping ability, including fluency with AI-assisted building tools

  • Hands-on discovery research experience and comfort talking directly with customers and prospects, including senior stakeholders

  • UX and product design fundamentals, with a portfolio or examples of shipped work

  • Product management experience or equivalent: scoping, prioritization, and stakeholder management

    • Also valuable

  • B2B SaaS experience, especially enterprise software

  • Comfort working in or alongside a live codebase

  • Experience leading small teams without formal authority

  • The confidence to tell senior leaders "the evidence doesn't support this"

    • How this role is different

  • From a traditional PM: less roadmap ownership, more hypothesis testing, and you build the artifacts yourself

  • From a UX Designer: you own the business case and market validation, not just the experience

Location

This remote role can be located anywhere in the United States of America.

Why work at RainFocus?

At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.
As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities.
What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!

raw.description:
Respage | Full-time | Fully remote | Must live in PA, NJ, DE

Role Summary

Respage is hiring a Customer Success Associate for a high-ownership, fast-moving Customer Success role. This is not a “light support” position—this is a demanding, accountability-driven role where you will manage a constant flow of client requests and take initiative head-on every day.

You will be the frontline owner of our Support Inbox and website/dashboard chat, responding to clients, triaging issues, documenting requests, and driving them to resolution. You will also be accountable for a small portfolio of clients, supporting weekly maintenance and proactive communication. You’ll partner closely with our Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to ensure client services are fully set up and supported—especially when new orders come in.

Alongside these Customer Success responsibilities, you’ll help create and manage social posts for Respage’s clients, support their reputation management, and complete special projects with our marketing manager as needed.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

1) Support Inbox + Chat Ownership (Primary Responsibility)

  • Own the daily flow of incoming support emails and client chat messages from our website and dashboard.
  • Respond quickly and professionally, gather details, and provide clear next steps.
  • Triage requests: determine if the issue is user error, setup gap, product limitation, or a possible defect—and route accordingly.
  • Track requests through to completion with consistent client updates and follow-through.

2) Assigned Client Portfolio (Weekly Maintenance + Communication)

  • Be accountable for a small group of assigned clients to support ongoing maintenance and weekly touchpoints.
  • Maintain consistent communication cadence (weekly check-ins/status updates as appropriate).
  • Track open items, requests, and follow-ups to ensure nothing slips and clients feel continuously supported.
  • Proactively surface risks, recurring issues, or upcoming needs to the CSM team.

3) Setup Support + Proactive Order Assistance

  • Partner with CSMs to ensure client services are set up completely and launch requirements are met.
  • When new orders come in, proactively start your portion of the work immediately—no waiting to be told.
  • Ask smart questions early (internally) to avoid delays, prevent rework, and keep rollouts moving.
  • Maintain accurate documentation so internal teams can act fast and clients get consistent answers.

4) Issue Investigation + Problem Solving

  • Research and troubleshoot client issues using available tools, internal documentation, and product context.
  • Identify patterns and recurring issues, document them, and escalate when needed.
  • Recognize potential bugs and work with technical teams to provide strong notes, reproduction steps, and impact.

5) Communication + Execution Discipline

  • Deliver consistently strong written communication—clear, calm, and action-oriented.
  • Manage multiple requests at once with strong organization, prioritization, and time management.
  • Maintain a “finish the job” mindset: you own outcomes, not just responses.

Client Social Posts, Reputation Management + Marketing Projects

    • Help create and manage social posts for Respage’s clients.
    • Support reputation management for Respage’s clients.
    • Complete special projects with our marketing manager as needed.

What This Role Requires (Must-Haves)

  • Strong accountability and initiative: you take ownership, you don’t wait, and you see tasks through.
  • Ability to thrive in a high-volume, request-driven environment where the work is always moving.
  • Excellent customer-facing communication skills (email + chat): professional, clear, and empathetic.
  • Strong judgment and problem-solving: you can quickly gather facts, diagnose, and decide what to do next.
  • Strong organization and time management: able to prioritize competing requests and hit deadlines.
  • Comfortable learning detailed services quickly and explaining them clearly to clients.
  • Comfortable using Google Workspace (G Suite) and working daily in Slack, Teamwork Projects, and Teamwork Desk.
  • Comfortable using ChatGPT as an ongoing productivity tool in daily workflows (drafting, summarizing, organizing, troubleshooting).

Preferred / Nice-to-Haves

  • Prior experience in Customer Success, Support, or Account Services (especially in a fast-paced environment).
  • Experience working with property management clients and/or familiarity with PMS systems like Yardi, RealPage, AppFolio, or similar.
  • Comfort troubleshooting software workflows and translating issues into clear internal notes.

Core Traits for Success

  • Ownership: takes responsibility for results and doesn’t drop balls.
  • Urgency: moves quickly and keeps requests moving.
  • Work ethic: consistently shows up ready to execute and improve.
  • Adaptability: learns fast and stays calm under pressure.
  • Initiative: looks for ways to help every day and asks “what’s next?”

Tools You’ll Use

Google Workspace (G Suite) | Slack | Teamwork Projects | Teamwork Desk | ChatGPT | Respage Dashboard | Zoho

Why You'll Love It Here:

Join an award-winning team that's reshaping the future of multifamily operations! Respage offers a fast-paced, fully remote environment that fosters career growth and advancement. We've been recognized as one of the Best Places to Work in Philadelphia and the multifamily industry, with 6 appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of Fastest-Growing Private Companies in America. We offer a competitive compensation package that includes a base salary, generous PTO, comprehensive healthcare, and a 401K with a generous match. This is your opportunity to make a real impact with us!

raw.description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

About the Role

As a Senior UX/CX Designer, you’ll join our client’s U.S.-based Experience Strategy & Design Studio. It’s a small, horizontally structured team that brings strategy, design, and research together around customer experience. The team is building an internal AI experiences hub for about 10,000 enterprise users. You’ll design end-to-end experiences for it, from early concepts to working prototypes.

The team uses user-centered design as its core methodology, so you’ll already know it well. You’ll work in a fast, iterative environment with direct executive engagement, and you’ll partner with stakeholders across the organization. Success here means taking an ambiguous problem, setting a clear design direction, and delivering work at the level your portfolio shows, with minimal oversight.

What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end experiences for internal AI tools, from early concepts and task flows to high-fidelity, working prototypes
  • Build and iterate quickly in Lovable using AI-assisted and vibe-coding workflows, moving work into VS Code and merging it with existing projects when needed
  • Apply user-centered design methods to frame problems, identify the right questions, and connect user insights to design decisions
  • Create design artifacts at different levels of fidelity, including storyboards, wireframes, journey maps, task flows, scenarios, and personas
  • Use and contribute to an established design system, including UI controls, content templates, icons, form design, and navigation models
  • Plan and facilitate remote and live design thinking workshops with stakeholders and users
  • Present design direction and future-state concepts to stakeholders, including executives, in a clear and compelling way
  • Validate work with peers, stakeholders, and users through lightweight research and usability checks, then iterate based on what you learn

What You'll Bring

  • Training or certification in user-centered design or design thinking from a recognized program such as IDEO, IBM, Stanford, LUMA, or Forrester
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Design, Product Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field and 8+ years of product or service design experience; a Master’s degree and 6+ years of experience; or equivalent experience
  • Strong UX/UI design skills demonstrated through a portfolio of shipped work
  • Hands-on experience designing and prototyping in Lovable
  • The ability to gather user context independently and turn it into design strategy and execution without detailed direction
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, including presenting complex concepts to executive audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of shipping products or delivering to customers through an end-to-end design process
  • 3+ years of hands-on primary UX research experience, including planning and conducting 1:1 user interviews
  • 5+ years of designing, planning, and facilitating live and virtual design thinking workshops
  • 3+ years of experience in the technology sector with enterprise (B2B) customers
  • Experience with VS Code, GitHub, Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, or Sketch

Portfolio Requirements

A portfolio is required to be considered for this role. It should show your design process, your role on each project, and examples of shipped or delivered work.

Compensation

At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market.

For candidates based in Romania, the anticipated gross compensation range is $2,083 to $2,917 USD per month, with a midpoint of $2,500. Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final compensation and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications.

Location and Employment Structure

This is a full-time, remote position open to candidates based in the Philippines. This role works a full U.S. Mountain Time shift, Monday through Friday. In Philippine time, that's an overnight schedule.

The selected candidate will be employed through Blueprint's applicable local Professional Employer Organization (PEO) or Employer of Record (EOR) partner and assigned to support a client engagement expected to last 18 months.

Benefits, statutory entitlements, and any additional required payments will follow the applicable local employment requirements.

Benefits

Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Competitive paid time off
  • Parental leave
  • Professional growth and development opportunities

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Blueprint Technologies, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicant Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please contact .

Description

Location: Can be based in either Madrid or London/ Manchester

Accelerate Your Career in Cybersecurity

Pentera is the market leader in AI-native Security Validation, equipping enterprises with the platform to proactively test their defenses against the latest cyber attacks. Pentera proves which exposures are truly exploitable across the entire attack surface and drives remediation workflows that reduce real risk. Anchored in real-attack validation, the Pentera platform powers the full Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) cycle, from exposure discovery through prioritization, validation, and mobilization. Thousands of security teams around the world trust Pentera to close their security gaps before threat actors can exploit them.

With over 350 team members and 1,300 customers in more than 60 countries, Pentera is a growing company supported by top investors such as Insight Partners, K1, and The Blackstone Group.

If you want to grow your skills, make an impact, and be part of an innovative team, Pentera is the place for you.

About the role:

This is a unique opportunity to build a new function from the ground up for Pentera in EMEA. We're looking for someone deeply technical who can raise the bar on how our teams sell and demonstrate Pentera across the region.

As an individual contributor, you'll be the go-to technical leader for every Sales Engineer in EMEA- shaping how they grow, what "excellent" looks like, and making sure they're set up to win. You'll also work closely with our Channel partners' sales teams to sharpen their technical game.

We're looking for someone who's come up through Sales Engineering or a similar pre-sales technical path in cybersecurity, and brings credibility, hands-on expertise, and a passion for coaching others to a very high technical bar.

Responsibilities:

  • Own technical excellence and enablement for all Sales Engineers across the EMEA region, in a matrix capacity (no direct reports)
  • Design and drive enablement programs, certifications, and technical onboarding for SEs and Channel technical/sales teams
  • Partner closely with Channel Account Managers and partner-side sales teams to raise their technical fluency and ability to position and demo Pentera effectively
  • Act as a technical thought leader and escalation point for complex, strategic, or multi-stakeholder deals across the region
  • Identify skill gaps across the SE and Channel population and build targeted training, playbooks, and best-practice content to close them
  • Partner with Sales Leadership, Product, and Marketing to ensure technical messaging and positioning are consistent and up to date across EMEA
  • Track and report on technical enablement KPIs (certification completion, technical win rates, ramp time, etc.) to EMEA leadership
  • Represent the voice of the field to Product and R&D, feeding back market and competitive technical insights
  • Stay current on the cybersecurity threat landscape, competitive technical positioning, and emerging attack techniques relevant to Security Validation/CTEM

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in technical, pre-sales, or Sales Engineering roles within cybersecurity vendors
  • Deep, hands-on technical expertise in cybersecurity (e.g., offensive security, penetration testing, exposure management, network/security architecture)
  • Experience working with and enabling Channel partners' technical/sales teams
  • Strong ability to influence and drive outcomes without formal authority (matrix leadership)
  • Excellent presentation, demo, and technical storytelling skills
  • Strategic thinker with strong program-building and organizational skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, comfortable working across EMEA and with global leadership
  • Willingness to travel across EMEA (up to 50%)

We are an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to building a diverse and talented workforce. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, religion, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, disability, or any other class or characteristic protected by applicable law. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join us!

Position: Sr. Manager, Trial Experience

Level: M4

Exempt/Non-Exempt: Exempt

Location: USA(Remote)Reports To: Director, Trial Experience

Shift: Sat-Wed, 8am - 4pm CST Hours


Who We Are:

HighLevel is a cloud-based, all-in-one white-label marketing and sales platform that empowers marketing agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. With a focus on streamlining marketing efforts and providing comprehensive solutions, HighLevel helps businesses of all sizes achieve their marketing goals. We currently have 1000+ employees across 15 countries, working remotely as well as in our headquarters, which is located in Dallas, Texas. Our goal as an employer is to maintain a strong company culture, foster creativity and collaboration, and encourage a healthy work-life balance for our employees wherever they call home.


Our Website -

YouTube Channel-

Blog Post -

Who You Are:

As the Senior Manager of the Trial Experience Team, you will collaborate with customer-facing teams and managers to create win-win scenarios for stakeholders. You will lead, develop, and grow your team, bringing strategic thinking and organization to the role. You will monitor and drive your team’s KPIs, thriving in a high-accountability environment and leveraging your senior-level expertise in managing individuals and teams.

As a strategic leader, you will develop scalable business processes and empower a team dedicated to guiding prospective customers toward their goals with the HighLevel platform. You will ensure exceptional engagement from the start of trials and foster a results-oriented, collaborative environment. By building a team of subject matter experts, you will provide customers with strategic insights, ensuring their success and alignment with business strategies.

  • Support the organizational goals and participate in business planning activities such as staffing, goal setting, and resource planning.

  • Lead and ensure your managers and teams are successful by coaching, developing, inspiring and holding them accountable against established KPIs, policies and procedures - measure and provide detailed analysis on success against team’s growth KPIs and metrics.

  • Identify and implement process improvements and alternative solutions to drive team efficiency, productivity and engagement.

  • In partnership with the Director, Trial Experience, design and recommend sales targets & KPIs to optimize trial to paid efforts, and establish short & long term strategies. Measure and provide detailed analysis on success against team’s growth KPIs and metrics.

  • Conduct consistent and impactful performance conversations, conflict management, constructive/subjective feedback, and coaching with team members, leads, and managers while fostering a high-performance culture that inspires the desire to succeed.

  • Effectively build the morale of a group in a team setting that fosters the successful completion and achievement of team goals.

  • Own the identification and implementation of automation and AI-driven solutions to improve team productivity, streamline workflows, and enhance the trial experience. Establish scalable operating practices, standardize processes, and drive continuous improvement to support business growth and operational efficiency.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

DEVELOPING TEAMS

raw.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Google Ads Manager to join a performance-driven digital marketing agency. This is a fully remote, senior individual contributor role focused on managing and optimizing Google Ads campaigns for clients across the U.S. and Canadian markets.

You will oversee multiple client accounts, drive measurable business results, and contribute to improving campaign strategies, quality assurance processes, and operational standards. This opportunity is ideal for a strategic, analytical, and results-oriented professional who thrives in a collaborative agency environment.

Duties / Task to Perform

  • Google Ads Campaign Management: Plan, launch, manage, and optimize Search, Performance Max, Shopping, and Display campaigns across lead generation and e-commerce accounts.
  • Budget Management: Oversee monthly advertising budgets, monitor spending, and ensure campaigns remain aligned with established media plans and performance targets.
  • Campaign Performance Optimization: Analyze and improve key performance indicators, including Cost Per Qualified Lead (CPL), Cost Per Acquisition (CPA), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and conversion rates.
  • Conversion Tracking & Quality Assurance: Conduct weekly audits of conversion tracking, campaign performance, and lead quality. Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues proactively.
  • Reporting & Performance Insights: Prepare monthly client performance reports, communicate actionable insights, and recommend strategies for continuous improvement.
  • Landing Page Optimization: Identify conversion rate optimization opportunities, develop landing pages from design files, and collaborate with web developers on improvements and testing.
  • Client Account Growth & Retention: Identify growth opportunities, monitor account performance, and collaborate with account managers to strengthen client relationships.
  • Process Improvement: Contribute to the development and optimization of standard operating procedures (SOPs), campaign architecture, media planning frameworks, and quality assurance processes.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with paid media, SEO, creative, CRO, and account management teams to support integrated digital marketing strategies.
  • Documentation & Accountability: Maintain accurate campaign documentation, complete regular QA checklists, and track activities according to established workflows.

Requirements

  • 7–10 years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns for service-based and e-commerce businesses, preferably within a digital marketing agency.
  • Proven experience managing campaigns targeting the U.S. and Canadian markets.
  • Advanced knowledge of Google Ads, including Search, Performance Max, Shopping, and Display campaigns.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage monthly advertising budgets ranging from $20,000 to $150,000+ while delivering measurable performance results.
  • Strong proficiency in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), conversion tracking implementation, and tracking verification.
  • Experience evaluating lead quality beyond conversion volume to measure meaningful business outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience building landing pages, implementing conversion tracking, and conducting conversion rate optimization (CRO) tests.
  • Strong understanding of CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rates, and funnel performance metrics.
  • Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously in an agency environment.
  • Ability to prepare performance reports, communicate findings, and present strategic recommendations.
  • Experience working with quality assurance checklists, SOPs, and structured campaign management processes.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing or improving Google Ads campaign frameworks, quality assurance processes, and agency SOPs.
  • Google Ads certifications in Search, Display, or Measurement.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Ads, DV360, Amazon DSP, or other programmatic advertising platforms.
  • Experience using AI-powered tools for keyword research, campaign analysis, automation, or reporting.

Schedule & Availability

Remote Full-time | Monday–Friday | 09:30 AM - 05:30 PM (EST)

Benefits

  • Fully remote work environment for professionals based in Latin America.
  • Stable, long-term collaboration.
  • Opportunity to manage substantial advertising budgets and diverse client portfolios.
  • Direct involvement in shaping Google Ads strategies, campaign frameworks, and performance standards.
  • Collaboration with experienced professionals across paid media, SEO, CRO, and creative disciplines.
  • Clear scope of responsibilities and structured workflows.
  • Exposure to automation, AI-enhanced workflows, and modern digital marketing tools.
  • Supportive, collaborative, and performance-driven work culture.
  • Opportunity for continuous skill development and professional growth.
  • Meaningful autonomy and the opportunity to contribute strategic recommendations that influence business outcomes.

raw.excerpt: ABOUT HTIHuman Trafficking Institute (HTI) is reshaping the landscape of the fight against human trafficking and child exploitation, deploying a high-impact model that is stopping traffickers and protecting victims in record numbers.
raw.description:
ABOUT HTI

Human Trafficking Institute (HTI) is reshaping the landscape of the fight against human trafficking and child exploitation, deploying a high-impact model that is stopping traffickers and protecting victims in record numbers. HTI has already made significant strides in decimating trafficking across the globe. As HTI enters a phase of significant growth, this position offers the right person a unique opportunity to play a pivotal role in expanding this proven model domestically in the United States and driving historic impact, sustainable transformation, and changed lives in the battle against trafficking.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Senior Data & MERL Specialist - Texas plays a central role in strengthening Human Trafficking Institute’s (HTI) data and monitoring, evaluation, research, and learning capacity across the Texas Program. This position helps shape and execute HTI’s Texas data strategy, manage existing data systems, and inform future investments so they are scalable and capable of supporting program expansion.

The Senior Data & MERL Specialist - Texas develops and maintains high-quality datasets and dashboards, leads survey and indicator tracking, and translates data into actionable insights for internal learning and external reporting to inform strategic decision-making, program effectiveness, accountability, and continuous improvement across HTI’s work in Texas. This position ensures all data processes align with HTI’s Theory of Change, log frame, and data governance standards, including the protection of sensitive and victim-related information. This position is ideal for someone with strong experience in data analytics and MERL who is passionate about leveraging data to drive learning, monitoring, and impact in the anti-trafficking field.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Data Management and Quality

  • Develop and maintain structured databases and data dictionaries, including standard indicator and KPI definitions, to ensure consistency across contexts.
  • Ensure Texas KPIs and performance indicators are backed by verifiable, regularly collected data sources for grant, donor, and organization-wide reporting.
  • Collect, clean, and consolidate data from external partners, external sources, and internal program activities.
  • Coordinate with external partners and internal teams to ensure timely data submissions and quality assurance.
  • Partner with county leads to build and maintain strong working relationships with external stakeholders to support reliable data sharing and coordination.
  • Manage public information requests, including tracking requests, standardizing responses, and documenting sources.
  • Identify opportunities to automate workflows and improve data processes within existing tools.
  • Conduct periodic data quality reviews and produce analytical summaries for leadership and donors.
  • Ensure compliance with HTI’s data governance, privacy, and security standards when handling sensitive information.

Data Analysis and Visualization

  • Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends and support program decision-making.
  • Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and visualizations in Power BI or similar tools.
  • Apply descriptive and exploratory analytics to identify emerging patterns and inform program strategy.
  • Conduct statistical analyses appropriate to program data, such as pre/post comparisons and comparisons across counties, roles, and time, and communicate results and their limitations clearly.
  • Produce analytical summaries for leadership and donors.

Building the Texas Program MERL Function

  • Assess current operations and data practices and compare them to the needs of programs.
  • Partner with Global MERL Manager to ensure the Texas data program aligns with organizational data and MERL strategy.
  • Manage existing MERL systems identify and recommend new systems & tools as needs evolve.
  • Manage consultants and vendors in the development of relevant systems & tools.

Learning and Reporting

  • Design and maintain monitoring tools for Texas trainings and capacity-building activities, including pre- and post-training surveys, aligned with program learning objectives and Global HTI MERL standards.
  • Coordinate Texas learning cycles, including after-action reviews and quarterly reflection sessions, in partnership with the Global MERL Manager.
  • Produce accessible visual and narrative summaries for internal learning, donor reporting, and planning discussions.
  • Translate findings into actionable recommendations for the Texas team and leadership, and ensure timely responses to reporting, grant, and partner data requirements.
  • Present data and findings to external audiences, including partners, county stakeholders, funders, and leadership.

Coordination and Research Assistance

  • Collaborate with the Global MERL Manager and Texas team to ensure data activities align with program goals and Theory of Change.
  • Contribute Texas data to organization-wide reporting, including the Global KPI Sheet, ensuring consistency with global indicator definitions.
  • Provide light assistance to applied research initiatives, including data preparation, descriptive analyses, documentation, and support commissioned evaluations through data provision and partner coordination.
  • Identify new data sources, such as public court data and academic partners, to strengthen the Texas evidence base.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING - REQUIRED

  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, computer science, economics, social sciences, or a related field.
  • 5-7 years’ experience in data management or analysis.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience cleaning, matching, and managing messy data from multiple sources, with clear documentation of methods.
  • Working proficiency in at least one of SQL, R, or Python for repeatable data cleaning and analysis.
  • Experience handling confidential or sensitive data in line with privacy and security requirements.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING - PREFERRED

  • Experience integrating data across multiple systems or sources
  • Experience working with criminal justice-sector, county/municipal, or social-impact data.
  • Familiarity with monitoring, evaluation, research, and learning (MERL).
  • Experience with PowerBi, Tableau, or similar data analytics platforms.
  • Experience with SalesForce or similar CRM.
  • Experience with inferential or multivariate statistical methods, or evaluation design
  • Experience with qualitative methods such as key informant interviews or focus groups.

HOW YOU’LL SUCCEED

  • Analyze and synthesize complex quantitative and qualitative data from multiple sources to identify trends, root causes, and actionable solutions.
  • Communicate complex information clearly and effectively to diverse audiences through written and verbal presentations.
  • Manage competing and changing priorities to deliver high-quality results with minimal supervision while ensuring timely follow-up and team success.
  • Build strong collaborative relationships across departments and with external stakeholders to achieve organizational objectives.
  • Maintain exceptional attention to detail to ensure accuracy, compliance, and quality in documents, data, and deliverables.
  • Quickly learn and apply new concepts, tools, and processes in fast-paced, evolving environments.
  • Support organizational goals through a service-oriented mindset, professionalism, humility, and commitment to mission-driven values.

WORK AND TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

This is a full-time, remote position based in Texas. Meetings may occur outside the local 8am – 5pm. The position requires prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer, and you must be able to lift up to 10 pounds at times. You may travel up to 30% within Texas.

BENEFITS

HTI offers a wide range of health and welfare benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being to qualified employees:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • 401k with up to 5% match
  • Generous PTO program
  • Life and accident coverage
  • Voluntary income protection benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program

At this time we are only able to consider candidates who are legally authorized to work in the United States and do not require sponsorship.

HTI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

This position will operate on a remote basis within the U.S.

About Pocket-lint

Pocket-lint is a leading authority on consumer tech, digital entertainment, and personal hardware, reaching millions of readers worldwide. As part of the Valnet Publishing Group, Pocket-lint operates at a fast pace to deliver expert coverage across the modern consumer technology landscape.

About the Role

We are seeking a sharp, creative Freelance Tech Writer to produce feature stories and feed content. In this role, you will focus exclusively on feature-driven editorial including deep dives, industry analysis, opinion pieces, and feature stories across consumer devices (smartphones, tablets, laptops, Smart TVs), A/V gear, physical media (4K Blu-ray, vinyl), and apps.

Working closely with our editorial team, you will pitch and write thought-provoking content that explores tech trends, examines hardware ecosystems, and offers fresh perspectives on everyday consumer technology.

Your Responsibilities

  • Write high-quality feed articles and feature stories covering consumer tech, hardware, apps, and entertainment setups.
  • Focus coverage on core categories: smartphones, tablets, laptops, Smart TVs, A/V gear, physical media, and apps.
  • Pitch original, practical feature concepts, opinion pieces, and device roundups regularly.
  • Turn around clean, engaging content quickly in a fast-paced environment.
  • Upload drafts directly into our custom CMS, format images, and follow house style guidelines.
  • Work directly with editors on assignments, pitch feedback, and content strategy.

What We Offer

  • Competitive per-story compensation.
  • Flexible schedule.
  • Remote position to work from a location of your choice.
  • Exposure to Pocket-lint’s massive audience, providing you an exciting opportunity to make a genuine impact.
  • Long-term growth paths, including training workshops and potential for fixed base roles.

Experience and Skills

  • Proven experience writing tech features, consumer guides, or hardware content in English.
  • Strong familiarity with smartphones, laptops, Smart TVs, A/V hardware, physical media formats, and major app ecosystems.
  • Ability to break down specs and tech trends into clear, engaging, human-sounding advice for everyday readers.
  • Basic understanding of SEO practices and comfort working within a digital CMS platform.
  • A self-starter attitude with a drive to pitch relevant, timely feature topics independently.
  • Strict adherence to Valnet’s Editorial Standards, including a zero-tolerance policy for Artificial Intelligence (AI) writing tools.

How to Apply

If you are interested in this role, please send us the following documentation by uploading it in the relevant fields below:

  • Your CV and a cover letter telling us why you want to write for Pocket-lint.
  • At least 2-3 tech articles you've written that demonstrate your writing abilities.
  • Links to your social profiles or portfolio.

Our hiring team will review your application and contact you if we believe that your experience could be a match for this role.

Pocket-lint is part of the Valnet Publishing Group. Valnet, founded in 2012, is a global digital publishing and media investment Company that owns and operates over 25 authoritative brands across diverse verticals, including entertainment, sports, technology, automotive, gaming, lifestyle and travel.

Valnet is committed to producing premium content, and we therefore require all our contributors to adhere to our Editorial Standards, including a prohibition on using Artificial Intelligence.

raw.description:
About the Role

The Medical Coder is responsible for independently reviewing, analyzing, and resolving all assigned front-end scrubs and denied claims to ensure accurate and timely claim payment. This position focuses on identifying and correcting coding-related issues prior to claim submission, resubmitting corrected claims or appealing denied claims, applying established coding guidelines, payer requirements, and organizational policies. The Coding Specialist works closely with revenue cycle partners to prevent claim rejections, support clean claim rates, and promote efficient reimbursement processes. This role requires strong attention to detail, foundational coding knowledge, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

A Day in the Life

  • Averages 10 front-end holds/denials per hour
  • Reviews coding and resubmits corrected claims to insurance
  • Creates appeal letters/forms with medical documentation
  • Maintains a minimum of 92% coding accuracy.
  • Assigns ICD-10-CM and CPT codes with appropriate modifiers for services provided in the professional fee environment.
  • Reviews medical records and all applicable documentation to determine appropriate codes for documented services and diagnoses.
  • Ensures all diagnosis codes meet local and national medical necessity guidelines.
  • Utilizes internal coding resources, payer guidelines, and other reference materials to ensure accurate and compliant coding for all assigned services.
  • Follows all HIPAA regulations and upholds the highest standards of privacy and confidentiality.
  • Maintains current knowledge of laws, regulations, payer policies, and industry guidance impacting compliant coding practices.
  • Independently reviews and resolves all assigned front-end claim holds.
  • Actively participates in department meetings, one-on-one meetings, and mentorship meetings with the assigned Coding Team Lead.
  • Escalates identified client trends to the assigned Coding Manager.
  • Escalates all coding-related questions to the assigned Coding manager for guidance and clarification.
  • Maintains and completes all CEU requirements.
  • Performs other duties or tasks as assigned

What You Need

  • Must hold a current AAPC or AHIMA Coding Certification for a minimum of 3 years.
  • Minimum of 3+ years of professional coding experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of CPT, ICD-10-CM, medical terminology, anatomy and physiology, and state and federal Medicare reimbursement guidelines.
  • Prior experience in reviewing front end coding errors before submitting to insurance
  • Prior experience in reviewing and correcting coding from insurance denials.
  • Prior experience in submitting corrected claims and appeals.
  • Prior experience with insurance guidelines and EOBs.
  • Familiarity with proper English grammar, usage, and professional documentation standards.
  • Ability to research and analyze data, draw logical conclusions, and resolve coding or documentation issues.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and apply policies, procedures, laws, and regulations.
  • Ability to accurately read and interpret medical documentation, clinical terminology, and documented procedures.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent judgment in coding and claim resolution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare reports, clarify documentation needs, and maintain collaborative working relationships with physicians and staff.
  • Strong commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding protected health information.
  • Prior experience working in a medical billing environment with strict adherence to HIPAA compliance requirements.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams).

AllTrails is the app for exploring the outdoors. We help people spend more time outside by connecting them to their next adventure. Home to the world’s largest outdoor community, with members and trails around the globe, you can find AllTrails in the Apple App Store, Google Play Store, and at alltrails.com.

Every day, our team works to get more people outside and help our members have better experiences on the trail. We lead with our values–positivity, innovation, humility, adaptability, inclusivity, and stewardship–in everything we do. Join us!

This is a U.S. based remote position. While this role does not require in-person attendance, we have a strong preference for candidates based in or near one of these cities: San Francisco CA, Portland OR, Seattle WA, Denver CO, and New York NY. Being in one of these cities creates opportunities to connect with teammates through Trail Days, co-working sessions, and local gatherings while still having the flexibility to work remotely. San Francisco employees are highly encouraged to come to the office one day per week. Please note that, at this time, we’re unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

About the role

We’re looking for a Creative Lead, Brand Design who can set the tone for what brand design and creative development looks like at AllTrails. Brand creative isn't just aesthetic work at AllTrails, it connects millions of people to the outdoors. This role is an opportunity to shape a brand that genuinely matters to its audience.

This role is equal parts maker and mentor: someone who executes creative with impeccable craft and insight, while raising the bar and modeling best practices for the team around them. You’ll lead by example—producing best-in-class brand creative and campaigns that resonate strongly with our audience, all while building a team culture of creativity and meticulous execution.

Due to high candidate volume and to ensure our hiring team has sufficient time to give every application the attention it deserves, we have set a closing date of November 6th for this position.

What you’ll be doing

  • Act as a Creative Leader on the Brand Design team, setting an example, continually raising the bar while generating original and highly crafted creative that is grounded in thoughtful insights.

  • Lead the development of evergreen assets that shape our brand visual language - including overall art direction, expressive graphic treatments, color and typographic application, illustration, photo/video, and motion

  • Partner with Design Leadership to push the continual development and evolution of the AllTrails visual brand, defining how we show up in the world at scale

  • Concept and execute global integrated campaigns across various channels and surfaces including digital, social, lifecycle, OOH, film, experiential, and in-product

  • Work in collaboration with Creative Leadership, marketing leads, and cross-functional stakeholders to create campaigns that build love for the AllTrails brand and product

  • Make design decisions confidently and quickly, ensuring they are based on a deep understanding of the project's goals, audience insight, and business context

  • Lead design exercises, workshops, and drive internal alignment on principles and ideas that elevate brand design at AllTrails

  • Think deeply about and research business problems to develop core creative ideas that translate into successful executions

  • Contribute to a respectful and collaborative team environment that cultivates a culture of creativity.

What you bring

  • Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience leading global brand campaigns, in either an agency or in-house studio setting, preferably for a SaaS company, app, or digital product

  • Experience leading projects in a senior creative role such as a Design Lead, Art Director, or Senior Designer

  • Extensive experience concepting and designing compelling creative across multiple mediums, formats, environments, and surfaces

  • Strong, precise execution of the core fundamentals of visual design, including typography, layout, color, form, and composition

  • Outstanding portfolio demonstrating highly crafted design work and demonstrated success in building unique and interesting creative that resonates deeply with audiences

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively articulate and sell creative decisions, as well as manage feedback from stakeholders

  • Exceptional conceptual and brainstorming skills, with a preference for a blue-sky, out-of-the-box approach to idea generation

  • Strong critical thinking skills, with the ability to self-edit, iterate, test ideas, and bring constructive feedback to work across the creative team

  • Extensive experience collaborating with copywriters, designers, and marketing strategists to develop campaigns and brand storytelling

  • Experience at a fast-paced remote-first company where autonomy and proactiveness are key contributors to success

  • A highly developed aesthetic sensibility and taste, and a deep knowledge of the current and historic creative landscape, with a solid understanding of design trends and culture

  • A deep knowledge of Figma, Adobe CC, and other creative platforms and tools

  • Strong grasp of design systems and how to deploy flawless creative at scale

  • Empathy for the customer and for individuals on a creative team

Bonus points
