  • Experience using AI tools such as Midjourney, Runway, Gemini and ChatGPT to improve efficiency, work at scale, and unlock new creative processes

raw.title: Director of Content
raw.excerpt: Fairmarkit is the #1 autonomous sourcing platform revolutionizing the way all organizations buy & sell.
raw.description:
Fairmarkit is the #1 autonomous sourcing platform revolutionizing the way all organizations buy & sell. Fairmarkit equips procurement teams with automation, AI, and GenAI so they can source more competitively at scale. Our solutions for tail spend and strategic sourcing help innovative procurement teams reduce cycle times, drive out costs, meet ESG/Diversity targets, and provide a better stakeholder experience to internal partners and suppliers. Fairmarkit has been recognized with awards by organizations such as Gartner and IDC, and is backed by strategic investors like Notable Capital, Insight Partners, , and Newfund.

About the Role

Fairmarkit is looking for a Director of Content Marketing to help shape how we show up in the market and build a content engine that makes us impossible to ignore.

At the heart of this role is great storytelling. We’re looking for an exceptional writer and editor who knows how to find a strong idea, sharpen it, and turn it into something people actually want to read, share, and talk about. But creating great content is only part of the job.

You’ll think just as much about how an idea travels. Across LinkedIn, search, AI answer engines, customer stories, executive voices, video, research, and whatever channel emerges next. You’ll help establish Fairmarkit and our leaders as trusted voices in procurement while finding new ways to reach the people we care about.

You’ll also help us rethink how content gets made. AI is changing the way people discover information and the way marketing teams work. We want someone who’s excited to experiment with that shift, build smarter workflows, and figure out where AI creates leverage and where human judgment still matters most.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll write. You’ll edit. You’ll experiment. You’ll build. And you’ll work closely with Brand & Design, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, our executives, customers, and outside partners to bring great ideas to life.

What You’ll Own

Content & Thought Leadership

  • Own Fairmarkit’s content strategy across all mediums (video + written), editorial direction, and the way our brand narrative comes to life in the market.
  • Write and edit exceptional content, while helping executives and subject matter experts turn their expertise into ideas and stories people care about.
  • Put customers, original research, data, executive perspectives, and strong points of view at the center of our content strategy.
  • Create repeatable content programs that build an audience, not just fill an editorial calendar.
  • Partner closely with Brand & Design to bring ideas to life across written, visual, video, and other formats.

Social & Executive Presence

  • Own our organic social strategy, with LinkedIn playing a major role in how we engage the procurement community.
  • Help Fairmarkit’s executives and employees become authentic, active voices in the market, extending our reach well beyond the company account.
  • Build the playbooks, training, tools, and habits that make it easier for people across Fairmarkit to participate.
  • Know what makes social content work. You’ll write, test, engage, learn, and continually refine our approach based on what resonates with the audience.

SEO, AEO & Distribution

  • Own how Fairmarkit gets discovered across traditional search and the growing world of AI-powered discovery.
  • Develop our approach to SEO and AEO/GEO across Google, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Reddit, YouTube, and whatever comes next.
  • Stay curious about how buyer behavior is changing and what that means for the way we create, structure, and distribute content.
  • Be hands-on enough to do the work yourself and experienced enough to effectively lead agencies and specialized partners when we need to scale.

AI-Powered Content Operations

  • Find practical ways to use AI across research, creation, editing, repurposing, distribution, optimization, and measurement.
  • Build workflows yourself where it makes sense, and know how to define the problem and requirements when more technical support is needed.
  • Experiment constantly, keeping what genuinely makes the work better and ignoring what doesn’t.
  • Use AI to give the team more leverage without sacrificing originality, quality, or the human judgment behind great content.

We’re not looking for someone who’s simply good at prompting ChatGPT. We’re looking for someone who’s curious about how AI can fundamentally change the way a modern content team works.

Measurement & Impact

Great content should ultimately create business impact. You’ll help us understand that journey from the earliest signals all the way through pipeline and revenue.

You’ll define what we should measure, establish the right leading indicators, and help us understand whether we’re gaining attention and authority with the audiences that matter.

That could include share of voice, procurement audience engagement, executive reach, organic and AI visibility, branded search, qualified traffic, target-account engagement, content influence, and pipeline.

Most importantly, you’ll use what we learn to make the work better.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years across content marketing, editorial, social, organic growth, or related disciplines, ideally within high-growth B2B SaaS.
  • You’re an exceptional writer and editor. You know what good content sounds like and have a portfolio that proves it.
  • You’re a builder. You’re comfortable starting with a blank page, figuring things out, and creating programs and systems that didn’t exist before.
  • You understand B2B social and LinkedIn deeply, ideally with experience helping executives or employees build their own presence.
  • You know SEO and are actively thinking about how AEO/GEO changes the organic discovery landscape.
  • You’ve done more with AI than generate copy. You’ve built or implemented workflows that made marketing meaningfully better, faster, or more effective, and you can tell us exactly what you built and why.
  • You’re comfortable with data and can connect creative work to audience growth, engagement, pipeline, and business outcomes.
  • You know how to work with executives and across teams without needing a big organization underneath you to get things done.
  • Experience with enterprise audiences, procurement, finance, supply chain, or AI is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

A year from now, Fairmarkit should have a stronger, more recognizable voice in the procurement market and a content engine built around ideas people actually care about.

Our customers, data, and executives should be generating stories and perspectives that travel. Our leaders should have stronger voices on social. We should be easier to discover through both traditional search and AI. And behind the scenes, AI-enabled workflows should help us produce and distribute better work with significantly more leverage.

We’ll also have a much clearer understanding of what’s working, why it’s working, and how those early signals eventually translate into pipeline and revenue.

Ultimately, success is pretty simple: we want Fairmarkit to become a company the procurement market reads, follows, references, searches for, and talks about.

Compensation / Location

For this role you need to reside in one of the following states: California (CA), Colorado (CO), Florida (FL), Georgia (GA), Illinois (IL), Indiana (IN), Maryland (MD), Massachusetts (MA), Montana (MT), New Hampshire (NH), New Jersey (NJ), New York (NY), North Carolina (NC), Ohio (OH), Pennsylvania (PA), Rhode Island (RI), Texas (TX), Tennessee (TN), or Washington (WA).

The annual compensation for this role is $162,000–$225,000 (including a bonus), depending on experience and location, plus equity and benefits. This range is provided in accordance with applicable U.S. pay transparency laws. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and location.

Headquartered in Boston, and backed by a $35.6M Series C co-led by OMERS, Highland, Notable Capital, Insight Partners, and ServiceNow. We are looking for exceptional candidates who want to help grow our company into a global enterprise and make their mark on the B2B tech industry. Come soar to new heights with us!
Fairmarkit is an equal opportunity employer, and selects individuals best matched for the job based upon job-related qualifications regardless of race, religion, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, age, ancestry, national origin, gender identity, genetic information, disability, pregnancy, veteran or military status or any other status or characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Campus Marketing Manager
description: CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country.

raw.title: Senior Campus Marketing Manager
raw.excerpt: CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country.
raw.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

About the Role

Location: Remote (US), with travel about once a month
Role Type: Full-Time
Reporting to: Head of Higher Ed
Compensation: $110,000 to $150,000 per year

More than 50 colleges and universities offer CodePath courses for credit, taught by their own faculty or by CodePath. For a student, a seat in one of those courses means industry-vetted learning and career support built into the degree they're already earning. The courses only change outcomes if students know they exist and sign up.

That's your job. Students find us through a professor who mentions the course before registration opens, an advisor who forwards a note, a club event, or a friend who took the course last term. Most of that reach happens through people on campus, so your work is making it easy for faculty, advisors, career services, club leaders, alumni, and Tech Fellows to carry the message for us. You'll build all of it: the toolkits and campaigns they share, the campus presence, and the student community that recruits the next cohort. You'll be measured on how many students enroll and stay through add/drop, because each filled seat is one more student getting the training we exist to provide.

You'll be a dedicated partner to our Higher Education partnerships team, who own the relationships with faculty and campus leadership, and you'll own the student side of every partner campus. Some weeks that means building a one-pager a department chair can forward on Monday, tuning an email sequence on a Wednesday, and representing CodePath at a hackathon on Friday. You'll be building this function from the ground up and you need to decide in advance how we show up and what we expect back.

What you'll own

Partner activation and campaign development

  • Build and run a term playbook for each for-credit partner, from awareness through add/drop
  • Equip faculty, advisors, career services, and club leaders to market CodePath courses with toolkits, talking points, and assets they can forward
  • Turn national for-credit applicants into enrolled students: find where they drop off and test what moves conversion
  • Run virtual info sessions and campus landing pages that end with a clear path to register
  • Own email and SMS to opted-in students: build the list, run the campaigns, and work with our lifecycle contractor so campus and direct touches land as one sequence

Student community building

  • Design how alumni, Tech Fellows, and instructors show up on campus and engage students, and build the online side of that community (Discord and similar)
  • Own relationships with student clubs, CS and AI organizations, hackathon organizers, and campus chapters of national organizations like ColorStack, NSBE, and SHPE
  • Plan the event calendar a term ahead, with a clear standard for which events we do and what each should return

Measurement

  • Tie every sign-up to a channel and a partner, test timing, message, and channel, and move time and budget to what works
  • Use AI to run the playbook at 50+ campuses without adding headcount: toolkits per campus, calendars and send dates, results in one view

What success looks like in your first year

  • Every partner runs a term playbook, and fill rate and melt improve at for-credit partners
  • National for-credit conversion is measurably higher
  • Every new partner launches with a full first section
  • A student advocate network is live at our largest partners
  • The opted-in student list grows, and every sign-up traces to a channel

This role may be right for you if

  • You've owned an enrollment, sign-up, or acquisition number and moved it. You set up the tracking and can show which efforts drove the result
  • You've gotten partners to market on your behalf: individuals who carried your message because you made it easy for them, and you can show what it produced
  • You've built a campus, ambassador, or community program from the ground up and can show what it produced
  • You’ve built campaigns from concept to launch, including copy and creative, and run email or SMS to a list you built, changing them based on the numbers
  • You've decided where to spend time and money (events, channels, sponsorships) based on expected return, and cut what didn't deliver
  • You've run a program across many sites at once (campuses, chapters, regions) on a fixed calendar, and kept it on schedule without a team under you
  • You’ve built AI into how you work to automate the repetitive parts, and you can show what it changed
  • You want your growth work to widen who gets into tech careers

Bonus

  • Experience in enrollment or admissions marketing in higher education
  • You’ve built or scaled a technical community (a student developer org, hackathon community, Discord, or dev rel program) and can show how it grew
  • Hands-on HubSpot experience
  • You're comfortable speaking at events and on panels on behalf of CodePath

Compensation

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position's level, no matter where you live. For this role, we're hiring for a Senior Manager level position at an annual salary of $110,000 to $150,000. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a remote position—work from anywhere in the US! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program
  • Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection
  • Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)
  • Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support
  • ​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt
  • Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings
Pay range
$110,000—$150,000 USD

raw.description:
As a Manager, Talent Development, you would be required to work with the BOD team to help advance employees’ skills and knowledge. Your responsibilities will begin with identifying the competency and skill needs of the different teams and individuals and creating customized learning plans for each. You will also be designing the learning modules with the help of subject matter experts and ensuring organizational compliance with the training schedule. You will be the point of contact for advising the leadership for the learning requirements of the company. You will lead in differentiating BOD Consulting from its competitors through the competencies of its human resources.

In the future, the role will evolve into a team management role. Talent Success Managers will be reporting to you who will in turn track the development of different employee teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identifying the skilling and learning needs of the individual employee and the organization as a whole.

  • Ideating and designing learning strategies and programs.

  • Developing customized learning plans for each individual and team.

  • Creating training schedules to upgrade the skills of employees and teams in a time-sensitive manner.

  • Designing the most suited way to impart knowledge on a case-by-case basis - gamified courses, e-learning courses, workshops, on-the-job training, etc.

  • Identifying and onboarding trainers (internal and external) for the various learning programs.

  • Designing and implementing assessment frameworks for learning programs.

  • Ensuring compliance with the learning charter.

  • Effectively using a learning management system to manage and track the learning lifecycle.

  • Planning and managing the budget for this function.

  • Developing and maintaining relationships with vendors and consultants as required.

Key Competencies

  • Adept at problem-solving and creative thinking.

  • Strong analytical skills, structured thinking, and incisive planning with a focus on detailing.

  • Communication skills in a clear, persuasive way.

  • Ability to build strong and trustworthy relationships with internal and external stakeholders and to effectively contribute to a highly collaborative environment.

  • Good judgment, strong integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people and confidential information.

  • Ability to work under pressure and in conflict situations – creative problem solving to find win/win solutions among stakeholders with different priorities.

  • Knowledge of effective learning and development methods and tools.

  • Persuasiveness to lead a project from its inception till completion.

  • Experience in project management and budgeting.

  • Commitment to excellence, personal and professional growth, and an eagerness to learn.

  • Ability to work independently, non-hierarchical, with a high tolerance for ambiguity.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3 years of experience in managing a learning center for talent focussed companies.

  • Experience in using Learning Management Systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Worked with a professional services company.

  • Setting up a learning and development center from scratch.

  • Postgraduate degree in business, human resources or other related fields.

BOD Consulting is a management consulting firm that solves big problems for emerging and mid-market enterprises to help them become large. BOD defines mid-market enterprises as companies with annual revenue between $20 million to $1 billion.

The team at BOD partners with clients to solve their most pressing business challenges, unlock value creation and implement transformative solutions to help them compete sustainably at the highest level. We work closely with the leadership team and at all levels of the client organization to bring about change. We work extensively with clients to help them carve out their growth road-map and vision, generate new sources of equity creation, steer organizational transformation and drive change through intensive stakeholder engagement & professional development. We are focused on generating key business outcomes for our clients – creation of valuable brand assets, cost reduction, enhancing shareholder value, business growth, market share growth and higher profits, all the while being mindful of the impact we are creating.

BOD believes in balance, and promotes the idea of building High Growth Impact (HGI) organisations – companies which are growing rapidly but also aim to leave behind a trail of positive impact. Our consulting process uses the mind to reason, analyse and divide but it also uses the heart to craft a solution that unites and brings more balance to the way work is done.

We follow the same philosophy of achieving balance inside our firm. BOD believes that work is only one of the important parts of our life journey and hence tirelessly works towards creating and sustaining a culture of life-work balance, prioritizing life with respect to work and not as an afterthought. We are consciously working towards building a culture of diversity and inclusion. As a key step towards it, we are pledged to build a safe space for all at BOD.

Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation. Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2,500 of the world’s largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain’s platform.

What We Need

NetBrain is looking for a Chief Information Officer to lead our global IT organization. Reporting to the CEO and serving as a member of the Executive Leadership Team, the CIO will set the vision for enterprise systems, information security, data, and will translate business priorities into scalable, secure, and cost-effective technology capabilities. We need a strategic, hands-on leader who can modernize our internal technology stack, partner closely with every function, and build a high-performing IT team.

What You'll Do

  • Define and execute a multi-year enterprise technology strategy aligned to company goals and growth plans
  • Lead the IT organization, including enterprise applications, infrastructure, end-user support, and IT operations; hire, develop, and retain top talent
  • Own information security and compliance strategy, partnering with Legal and Security to manage risk, support audits and certifications, and protect company and customer data
  • Oversee the enterprise application landscape, ensuring integration, reliability, and strong user experience
  • Partner with the CFO and General Counsel on technology budgeting, vendor selection, procurement, and contract negotiation to optimize spend and manage third-party risk
  • Establish data governance, analytics, and reporting capabilities that give leaders trusted, timely insight
  • Ensure business continuity, disaster recovery, and resilient infrastructure across a globally distributed workforce
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the ELT and Board on technology risk, investment, and opportunity
  • Lead major cross-functional initiatives, including system implementations, migrations, and process transformation

What You Bring

  • 15+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including 5+ years in a senior role leading enterprise IT at a software or technology company
  • Proven track record setting enterprise technology strategy and delivering large-scale transformation programs
  • Deep experience with information security, risk management, and compliance frameworks
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise platforms
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating and deploying AI and automation tools in an enterprise setting
  • Strong financial acumen, including budget ownership, vendor management, and contract negotiation
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence executives and explain complex topics to non-technical audiences
  • Experience leading distributed, global teams

What We Offer

Are you eager to develop your excellence in an inclusive, collaborative, and empowering community? Are you excited about joining a company that strives to make a difference – for its employees, clients, and society? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature?

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Sales and Tender team and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

Strategic Pursuits team. Building on strong research, writing, coordination and document management skills, the Pursuit Coordinator will help pursuit teams find, develop, organise and refine content needed for winning bids, tenders and proposals. The role will support all stages, from early client and competitor insight through submission, interviews and lessons learned.

At Ramboll, our ambition is to be The Partner for Sustainable Change, and we are committed to creating innovative solutions that will contribute to accelerating the ongoing sustainable transition. Working for Ramboll means working for a company that strives to make a difference for our employees, clients and society. Combining local presence with global reach, we offer you a strong platform for continuous professional growth. The successful applicant for this role will have the opportunity to contribute to our strategy to close the gap to a sustainable future. 

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Work with Pursuit Consultants across all phases of the pursuit process by researching, finding, developing and coordinating content for pre-tender materials, tender responses, interview materials and post-pursuit activities

Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at with such requests.

Overview

We are looking for a Client Success Manager (Performance Marketing) to join our growing global team.   • Real work-life balance: We value high performance, not overwork.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience as an Account Manager or Client Success Manager in a performance marketing or digital marketing agency (required).

Qualities

raw.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

About the Role

We're growing our world-class engineering team to usher our CRM platform into the next generation of software — and we're looking for a visionary Principal Full Stack Engineer to join our Core Platform Team

Most Lead roles at "Big Tech" companies involve maintaining a single microservice or acting as a small cog in a 100-person machine. At Steer, you aren't just a contributor; you are the architectof a platform aiming for 100% market dominance. This is a high-impact role for someone who doesn't just write great code, but who can see around corners, challenge conventions, and lead entire products from vision to launch.

We are actively refactoring our existing teams to be agentic-first — meaning our engineers don't just use AI as a tool, they architect systems around autonomous, AI-driven workflows. This is not a future initiative; it is how we build today.

We’re looking for builders who bring exceptional focus, ownership, and commitment to their work. At Steer, we want engineers who are “all in” on our mission, fully engaged with their work, and invested in our shared success. This means making Steer your primary professional focus and bringing the dedication and accountability needed to deliver exceptional results.

Why Steer?

  • True Ownership: You will lead massive products from start to finish within lean, high-velocity teams.
  • Hyper-Growth & Vision: We are currently at a fraction of our total addressable market in the automotive industry. The potential for scale is massive, and you will be a leading developer shaping this space
  • Freedom to Innovate: You don't need side projects to explore new techniques. We provide the autonomy and the platform to experiment with and implement the latest tech directly into our core product.
  • AI-First & Agentic Culture: We are refactoring our teams to be agentic-first. We prioritize high-level problem-solving and AI/LLM expertise, and we actively encourage the use of AI tools to accelerate coding across any language and to power autonomous production workflows.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Strategy & Ownership: Focus on the core components of the Steer CRM, specifically optimizing how we ingest and process data to revolutionize our automation tools.
  • Architectural Vision: Lead the design of reusable full-stack components and services that ensure our platform remains performant as we scale toward market dominance.
  • Adaptive Development: Pivot at a moment's notice based on evolving business needs, shifting focus between new integrations and core infrastructure to keep our ecosystem seamless.
  • Customer-Centric Engineering: Partner closely with Product to understand user pain points, ensuring every architectural decision adds tangible value to the auto repair shops we serve.
  • Code Excellence: Champion best practices in security, test automation, and maintainability. Conduct deep-dive code reviews that elevate the entire engineering organization.
  • Modern DevOps & Agentic Infrastructure: Influence our CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and IaC practices. Design and maintain AI-integrated, agentic-ready infrastructure that enables autonomous workflows.

What You Have

Must Have:

  • 7+ years of professional experience building complex, web-based SaaS products.
  • The “All-In” Mindset: A deep commitment to Steer’s mission and success. We look for engineers who take exceptional pride in their work, hold themselves to high standards, and demonstrate full ownership and accountability for their projects. They approach complex, seemingly impossible challenges with determination, proactively drive solutions, and are committed to delivering exceptional results in a fast-paced environment.
  • AI & LLM Integration: Hands-on experience working with LLMs and prompt engineering. You use AI to bridge gaps and accelerate development.
  • AI in Production: Proven experience deploying AI-powered features and autonomous (agentic) workflows in production-grade infrastructure.
  • AI-Driven CI/CD: Hands-on experience integrating AI tooling into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., automated code review agents, AI-assisted testing, or agentic workflow orchestration).
  • Database Expertise: Proficiency with both relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) databases, including schema design and query optimization.
  • Exceptional Communication: The ability to translate complex technical concepts into product outcomes and collaborate effectively with leadership.

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with our current stack: .NET, Node.js (TypeScript), and React.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Previous experience as a founding engineer or in an early-stage startup environment.
  • Experience building or integrating with Claude marketplace plugins (Anthropic ecosystem), including prompt chaining, tool use, or MCP integrations.

Position Overview

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. The sales leader you support will rely on you for insight into the number. Autodesk’s sales organization is measured every week on where the year will land. For Global Sales, you will explain that number: what moved, why, what the risk is and what to do about it. You are the Global Sales leader’s source of insight on their forecast, their pipeline and their performance. You work alongside the operations business partner who supports the same leader: they run the operating rhythm, and you bring the analysis and intelligence behind it. You are also the leader’s route into everything else the Forecasting & Revenue Intelligence team produces, from account intelligence to targets and reporting. You work inside their business day to day, using methods and standards shared across the whole sales organization, so results are comparable from one business to the next. This is one of four such roles, one for each major part of the sales organization.


Location: United States (remote). Eastern or Central time zone preferred.

Organization: Revenue Operations


Responsibilities

raw.excerpt: Who We Are Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at .

About Verve Retail Media

The biggest challenge for advertisers in physical retail is the lack of measurable proof of effectiveness. Brands invest millions in advertising at the point of sale, but they cannot demonstrate whether those investments actually generated purchases.

Verve Retail Media (VRM) solves this problem. We market and operate digital advertising screens across several thousand grocery, drugstore and convenience store locations, connecting them with digital coupons and retargeting campaigns on connected TV (CTV) and other offsite channels.

Brands don’t book isolated advertising formats; instead, they book 360-degree campaigns that start at home and continue all the way through to an in-store purchase. This enables closed-loop measurement based on actual point-of-sale transaction data.

VRM is the independent retail media division of publicly listed Verve Group SE. We operate like a rapidly scaling startup, with an AI-first strategy across all functions. We also have access to the infrastructure of an international ad tech company that delivers more than one trillion advertising impressions per year.

About the Role

AI needs data. While the digital world has been mapped, the vast, untapped data of human behavior and location intelligence remains the greatest challenge and the greatest opportunity. We are creating a robust data platform and sophisticated geo-targeting infrastructure that enables brands to understand shopper behavior and reach audiences effectively outside the physical store.

In order to build this platform, we are looking for a visionary Technical Product Manager to lead the development of our cutting-edge capabilities. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of AdTech, Location Data, and AI, building the infrastructure that allows brands and retailers to engage shoppers through off-site media and precise geographic targeting.

You will own the roadmap for our core data platform, advanced geo-targeting tools, and off-site ad integrations. Crucially, you will own the entire product lifecycle from initial discovery and scoping all the way through to commercial readiness. This end-to-end ownership requires tight collaboration with our Sales and Operations teams to ensure what we build is not only technically sound but also highly marketable and operationally scalable.

A critical focus of this role will be building products that scale globally, with a specific emphasis on spearheading our rollout and expansion into the US market. Your goal is to turn complex location and behavioral data into intelligent, monetizable media channels that drive measurable results.

Join a collaborative team of PMs dedicated to the holistic success of our Retail Media Platform. You won't build in a silo; you'll ensure a cohesive, unified roadmap across our data infrastructure and off-site touchpoints, driving a revolution in retail technology on a global scale.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy, Lifecycle Ownership & Global Roadmap

  • Own the end-to-end product development process from discovery and ideation to commercial launch and operational readiness.
  • Define and execute the product roadmap for our data platform, geo-targeting tools, and off-site media capabilities.
  • Spearhead product localization and scaling efforts for international expansion, with a primary focus on the US market rollout. Ensure compliance with regional data privacy regulations (e.g., CCPA, GDPR).
  • Translate business goals into technical specifications, working closely with Sales to validate market fit and with Operations to ensure seamless delivery and support post-launch.

Data Platform & Geo-Targeting Development

  • Architect the logic and infrastructure for our advanced geo-targeting tool, enabling precise audience segmentation based on location intelligence and behavioral data.
  • Oversee the development of robust data pipelines capable of processing and analyzing vast amounts of location and transaction data securely and efficiently.
  • Develop features for closed-loop campaign measurement and attribution, linking off-site ad exposure to online or offline transaction data.

AdTech & Off-Site Integrations

  • Lead integrations with external AdTech partners, including Supply Side Platforms (SSPs), Demand Side Platforms (DSPs), and Data Management Platforms (DMPs) to facilitate seamless off-site ad delivery.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards (e.g., OpenRTB, VAST) while adapting them for specialized location-based and off-site media environments.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Market Expansion

  • Partner intimately with Sales to understand client needs and define Go-To-Market strategies for new features, ensuring commercial viability.
  • Collaborate with Operations to build scalable processes for onboarding, campaign execution, and reporting.
  • Act as the primary technical liaison between our engineering team and external partners/brands, especially during international rollouts, translating complex constraints into clear value propositions.

The Ideal Candidate

Must-Haves:

  • Technical Fluency: Strong understanding of APIs, cloud architecture, and large-scale data pipelines. You are comfortable discussing JSON payloads one minute and global business strategy the next.
  • End-to-End Ownership: Proven track record of taking products from 0 to 1, managing the entire lifecycle from discovery to commercial rollout.
  • Data & AdTech Expertise: Proven experience building data products, audience targeting tools, or working extensively within the AdTech ecosystem (DSPs, DMPs, SSPs).
  • Expansion Mindset: Experience or strong interest in scaling products internationally; an understanding of the nuances and privacy landscapes of the US market is highly desirable.
  • Data-Driven: Ability to define success metrics (Match Rates, CPM, ROAS, Incrementality) and use data to prioritize features.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience with location intelligence or geospatial data analysis.
  • Background in retail media networks or off-site retail media strategies.
  • Familiarity with clean room technologies or advanced attribution modeling.
  • Domain specific expertise is a plus but we will onboard you in case you don’t have it:
  • Experience as a Product Manager or Technical Product Manager, with a specific focus on AdTech, MarTech, or Data Platforms.
  • Retail Media Knowledge: Understanding of the Retail Media landscape, specifically how off-site media budgets are allocated and measured.

Why You'll Enjoy Working Here

This role isn’t for everyone - and that’s intentional. We’re building Verve Retail Media from the ground up, reducing legacy structures, places to hide, and “passenger seats”. This is a place for people who want to build, take ownership, and see the direct impact of their work.

You won’t be one of many - you’ll be one of the few shaping how this company grows, decides, and wins. And every role counts - from Office Management to Chief of Staff to this role.

If you’re looking for comfort, predictability, or perfectly defined lanes, this probably isn’t your environment. If you’re looking for steep growth, real responsibility, and the chance to work with people who raise your bar - you’ll feel at home here.

What you can expect:

  • Real ownership from day one - take decisions, not just tasks
  • A steep learning curve - accelerated growth through real responsibility, not theory
  • High-performing peers - work with ambitious, driven people who challenge and support you
  • Direct impact - your work will shape products, processes, and outcomes in real time
  • Cutting-edge tools - including AI-powered workflows that multiply your output
  • Continuous development - training budget, internal learning formats, and language courses

This is a place where expectations are high - and so is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and build something meaningful.

Accounting Manager

Reporting line

Direct reporting towards: Assistant Controller

Purpose

The Accounting Manager at CFI contributes to achieving organizational efficiency by directly managing multiple Accounting sub-functions (Payables, P/L reporting, month-end reconciliations, etc.).

Ensures compliance with U.S. GAAP, internal controls, and company accounting policies.

The Accounting Manager oversees the day-to-day transactions, prepares and examines financial records, ensures records are accurate, and meets month-end close deadlines.

Maintains documented accounting procedures and supports audit readiness throughout the year

They provide overviews of the business's financial operations to help it run efficiently.

The Accounting Manager works in synergy with Finance, payroll, and other stakeholders to meet the business's overall goals.

Success in this role is measured by

Role Level

This role will be measured by an accurate month-end close cycle and meeting the 5-day close including being fully reconciled by Day 5.

Achievement of audit requirements with minimal adjustments, timely completion of reconciliations, and adherence to internal controls.

In addition, the role will be successful in identifying areas to standardize and streamline processes through system implementation and collaboration with related stakeholders.

Job Responsibilities

  • Prepare and/or review journal entries and supporting documentation.
  • Record and reconcile monthly P/L related processes to include but not limited to payables, prepaids, fixed assets, accruals, software capitalization, goodwill, and intangibles, etc
  • Perform a thorough monthly review of the P/L by department, account, and vendor, and investigate differences.
  • Partner with FP&A to review spend vs budget
  • Reconcile monthly bank and credit card statements.
  • Own payables and credit card processes
  • Cross-train accounts receivable billing and collection processes
  • Assist with year-end audits
  • Manage positive business relationships with both internal and external parties
  • Assist with other AdHoc processes and system implementations that streamline and improve accounting processes
  • Support internal control design, execution, and documentation.

Skills and Competencies

  • A bachelor’s degree is strongly preferred
  • 5-6 years of general ledger experience
  • 2-3 years of revenue recognition exposure is a plus
  • Intermediate skills with MS Office programs including Excel, Outlook, Word and GSuite
  • Experience with process automation, system implementations, or scaling accounting operations is preferred.
  • Knowledge of the SaaS industry required
  • Strong understanding of internal controls and audit requirements.
  • Knowledge of NetSuite or other major accounting software packages
  • Demonstrate critical thinking to identify potential solutions or new approaches for current operating procedures
  • Strong time management skills and the ability to multitask
  • Remote experience including communication using Slack, Zoom, Google Drive, etc.
Salary: 100-110k DOE

Job Title: Member of Technical Staff, Data Engineering

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

This is a Staff-level, hands-on engineering role for someone who has built data infrastructure from zero to production and knows how to turn fragmented operational data into reliable, accessible, and actionable systems.

You'll own the architecture and implementation of our data warehouse, ingestion pipelines, transformations, and product analytics foundations.

We're building an AI-native organization where both humans and autonomous agents need access to trustworthy, well-structured data. You'll design the systems that make this possible, enabling self-service analytics, automated decision-making, and increasingly intelligent workflows across the company.

What You'll Do

  1. Build our data platform from zero: Architect and implement our internal data warehouse, ingestion infrastructure, ETL/ELT pipelines, and core data models.
  2. Create agent-ready data foundations: Design reliable, well-documented datasets and interfaces that AI agents can safely discover, query, and use.
  3. Turn messy data into trusted systems: Transform fragmented operational and product data into consistent, high-quality sources of truth.
  4. Enable self-service analytics: Build the infrastructure that allows engineering, product, and business teams to answer questions independently without relying on manual data requests.
  5. Own product analytics infrastructure: Establish the event tracking, instrumentation, data models, and reporting foundations needed to understand product usage and performance.
  6. Automate data operations: Leverage AI coding agents and intelligent automation to accelerate pipeline development, data validation, documentation, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  7. Build for reliability and scale: Establish data quality standards, observability, governance, and scalable architectural patterns from the beginning.
  8. Raise the engineering bar: Mentor engineers, establish strong data engineering practices, and lead architectural decisions through hands-on execution.

What We're Looking For

  1. Staff-level engineering expertise with extensive hands-on experience building and operating production data platforms.
  2. Proven greenfield experience: You've personally led the design and implementation of a data platform from scratch, rather than exclusively maintaining or extending existing infrastructure.
  3. Deep understanding of data warehouses, ETL/ELT architectures, data modeling, orchestration, and distributed data processing.
  4. Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with the software engineering fundamentals needed to build reliable data infrastructure.
  5. Experience with modern data technologies such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, dbt, Airflow, Dagster, or equivalent tools.
  6. Strong understanding of data quality, lineage, observability, access controls, and production data reliability.
  7. Experience designing analytics infrastructure that supports product insights and operational decision-making.
  8. AI-native engineering habits: You already use AI coding agents as part of your daily workflow and actively automate repetitive development and data engineering tasks.
  9. Ability to make pragmatic architectural decisions, balancing scalability, simplicity, performance, and engineering velocity.
  10. Demonstrated technical leadership, including mentoring engineers and establishing engineering standards.

Nice to have

  1. You've been the founding or early Data Engineer responsible for building a company's first real data platform.
  2. You've designed data systems that support both traditional analytics and AI-powered applications or autonomous agents.
  3. You have experience building semantic layers, data discovery systems, or structured interfaces that make enterprise data accessible to AI.
  4. You've automated substantial portions of data pipeline development, validation, or maintenance using AI agents.
  5. You know how to avoid overengineering while building foundations that won't need to be replaced six months later.
  6. You're comfortable moving between data architecture, production pipelines, analytical modeling, and hands-on debugging.

Compensation & Benefits Notice

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $200,000 –$260,000. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

micro1 is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, reach out to .

Our hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.

The Role
We’re hiring our first Engineering Manager to lead Pythagoras AI’s engineering team. You’ll own delivery across customer implementations and core product work, keep projects moving, and be the bridge between engineering, customers, and the rest of the company.

This is primarily a leadership role. You’ll spend most of your time managing people, projects, and stakeholders, but you’re still an engineer, and you’ll jump in to build, debug, or review when the team needs it.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and grow the team. Manage, mentor, and support engineers. Run 1:1s, give clear feedback, help people grow, and help us hire as the team scales.

  • Own delivery. Plan and prioritize work across customer rollouts and product roadmap. Make sure projects ship on time, risks are surfaced early, and trade-offs are made deliberately.

  • Coordinate with customers and stakeholders. Work directly with customers, sales, clinical operations, and leadership. Set realistic expectations, communicate status, and turn customer needs into scoped, prioritized work.

  • Balance customization and product. Help the team decide what belongs in per-customer strategies and configuration versus what should become core product. Keep the platform from fragmenting as we grow.

  • Raise the engineering bar. Establish practices for code review, testing, deploys, incident response, and on-call. Make reliability and HIPAA compliance part of how the team works, not an afterthought.

  • Stay hands-on. Write code, review PRs, and debug production issues when needed. Expect this to be a smaller but real part of the role.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

  • 7+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years managing engineers or leading a team with direct reports

  • Track record of delivering complex projects with external stakeholders or customers involved

  • Hands-on with TypeScript/Node.js. You should be able to read and review code across the stack, and ship a fix when it matters

  • Strong written and verbal communication. Comfortable with engineers, clinical operations leaders, compliance teams, and customer executives

  • Good judgment on prioritization and scope. You know when to say no, when to say not yet, and how to explain why

raw.title: Vice President, Engineering
raw.excerpt: At Submittable, we are transforming how organizations create social impact.
raw.description:
At Submittable, we are transforming how organizations create social impact. Our platform empowers thousands of mission-driven organizations, from nonprofits to government entities, to make a difference in their communities and beyond. In 2024, our innovative software helped organizations worldwide run 30,000 programs, welcomed 1.2 million applicants, and facilitated the distribution of more than $10 billion in funding through our products on behalf of our clients.

We are on a mission to help organizations accelerate their impact, so we are proud to partner with organizations focused on Equity & Social Justice, Children & Education, Creative & Arts, Health & Wellness, Economic Justice & Opportunity, and Environment & Climate. At Submittable, technology and purpose converge, offering a unique opportunity to contribute to meaningful change.

About the Role

Submittable is hiring a Vice President of Engineering who is deeply technical, works hands-on, and builds with AI every day. You will report to the CTO and run engineering day to day: delivery, quality, reliability, cost, and the people who make them happen.

We want a different VP than the old SaaS playbook produced. That playbook grew output by growing headcount and adding layers of management. We believe AI coding tools now let a small team of strong engineers ship what once took a team several times its size. We intend to run engineering that way. You will keep the organization lean, keep layers few, and raise output per engineer rather than the number of engineers.

You cannot lead that change from a slide deck. You need to know firsthand what it is like to ship production software with AI agents, including where they fail. We expect you to have done this yourself in the last 12 months and to keep doing it here. Plan on roughly a fifth of your week going to hands-on technical work: reading and writing code, reviewing pull requests, working incidents, and building the tools your teams use.

We are choosing depth over span. This is a hands-on leadership role for a small, senior team, not a role leading a large organization through layers of managers. If you want to make architecture calls, contribute and ship code, and help a lean team deliver well beyond its size, we want to talk.

What You'll Do

  • Run engineering day to day. Turn the CTO's technical strategy and the product roadmap into plans, priorities, and shipped software.
  • Stay hands-on. Review pull requests, prototype, debug production issues, and write tools. You should be able to pick up a ticket and ship it. Teams should trust your calls because of your technical judgment, not your title.
  • Make AI the default way we build. Expect every engineer to work with AI coding agents (tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for design, coding, testing, and review. Show people how by doing it yourself, and remove whatever stops them.
  • Measure what AI changes. Track the four DORA metrics (how often we deploy, how long a change takes to reach production, how often changes fail, and how fast we recover), plus defects that reach customers and engineering cost per release. Report plainly on where AI helps and where it creates new problems, such as oversized pull requests, thinner review, or code no one on the team understands.
  • Keep the organization lean. Grow output faster than headcount. Keep management layers thin, expect managers to stay technical, and favor small teams with clear ownership over large teams that need heavy coordination. Before adding a person, ask whether better tooling or automation solves the problem.
  • Automate the toil. Use AI and automation for test generation, CI/CD checks, code review assistance, release notes, incident triage, and alerting, so engineers spend their time on the product.
  • Raise the technical bar. Set standards for architecture, code review, testing, CI/CD, release management, and incident response. Shipping more code, faster, raises the stakes for review, testing, and observability. Make sure speed does not cost us quality.
  • Own platform reliability, security, and cost. Our products are multi-tenant SaaS running on AWS and Azure, with Kubernetes. Work with infrastructure and security partners to meet uptime targets, pass SOC 2 audits, and keep cloud spend growing slower than revenue. Simplify our architecture where consolidation pays for itself.
  • Build AI into the product. Work with the CTO and Product to add AI to Submittable so customers can set up programs, review applications, and make funding decisions in less time. Help decide what to build and how to test it for accuracy and fairness, because real applicants' outcomes depend on it.
  • Hire and grow a small, strong team. Recruit engineers and leaders who already build with AI. Coach managers to stay close to the work. Build career paths that reward impact and technical depth, not team size.
  • Partner across the company. Work with Product and Design on scope and trade-offs among new features, technical debt, and platform health. Work with Customer Experience and Support to resolve escalations and reduce customer-facing defects.

What We're Looking For

  • You have shipped software with AI in the last 12 months. You personally built and shipped production code using AI coding tools within the past year. You can tell us what you built, which tools you used, what broke, and how it changed the way you work. This is a requirement, not a preference.
  • Deep technical skill. 15+ years in software engineering, with real depth in distributed systems, API design, data modeling, cloud infrastructure (AWS and Azure, Kubernetes), and DevOps. You can hold your own in an architecture review with our strongest engineers and spot the flaw in a design or a pull request.
  • You have run lean, high-output teams. 7+ years in engineering leadership, including at least 3 years leading other managers. You have raised a team's output without matching growth in headcount, and you can show the numbers: delivery metrics, team size, and cost, before and after.
  • B2B SaaS at scale. Experience building and running multi-tenant, cloud-based B2B SaaS products. Experience consolidating platforms or integrating acquired products is a plus.
  • Predictable delivery. A record of shipping complex software on predictable timelines without trading away quality, security, or reliability.
  • Distributed teams. You have led teams across multiple countries and time zones, including offshore or nearshore partners. You write clearly, because much of this work happens in writing.
  • Comfort with fast change. The norms for building software now shift every few months. You form a view, test it, and change your mind when the evidence says so.
  • A clear storyteller. You can explain technical trade-offs to executives and non-technical colleagues in plain language. You tell people where engineering is going and why, often enough that they repeat it.
  • A builder of strong teams. A track record of hiring, developing, and keeping strong engineers and building inclusive teams.
  • Nice to Have: Experience in a private equity-backed or high-growth SaaS company; familiarity with SOC 2 and GDPR; experience shipping LLM-based features to customers, including how to evaluate them.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Location: This is a remote, U.S.-based role — you must live and reside in the U.S. full-time.

Salary Details: The annual salary range for this position is $220,000 - $260,000. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. We also have a location-based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in other locations.

We are interested in every qualified candidate eligible to work in the United States; however, we cannot accommodate scholastic or employment visas at this time. In addition, we are not able to consider applicants who reside in the following states: Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Louisiana, Maine, New Mexico, North Dakota, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, Vermont, Washington, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

Fraudulent Recruitment Advisory: Submittable will NEVER request bank details, payment, or personal information during the hiring process, nor extend offers without an interview. All legitimate communications come from official email addresses. If you receive suspicious outreach, please report it to . (Please do not submit applications, resumes, cover letters, or other candidacy materials to this email address. Emails of this nature will not be reviewed or considered.)

Why Submittable?

Joining Submittable means becoming part of a forward-thinking, mission-driven company that values innovation, collaboration, and growth. We empower organizations working for social good with technology that accelerates their work, amplifies their impact, and drives meaningful change.

raw.excerpt: We're Proof, a high-growth startup in the legal tech industry, founded in 2017.
raw.description:
We're Proof, a high-growth startup in the legal tech industry, founded in 2017. We offer a best-in-class legal services platform used by thousands of law firms and property management companies. Our platform enables law firms and collections parties to access efficient, transparent, and accessible legal and document delivery services, traditionally out of reach. We are on a path to double our business this year and are building a team to help us scale rapidly.

We welcome individuals from all backgrounds who are eager to help build a future where legal services are readily accessible, affordable, and efficient. If you have curiosity, passion, and a collaborative spirit to drive change in an outdated industry, we want you on our team.

About the Role:

As a Risk & Compliance Specialist, you’ll review cases, gather evidence, take enforcement action, and keep compliance records accurate. You’ll also communicate with Proof’s users and support other teams across the company.

You’ll follow documented procedures to handle standard cases on your own, document your work thoroughly, and escalate unusual or high-stakes situations. Success in this role means resolving risks quickly, producing accurate, well-documented cases, and applying compliance rules consistently, even at high volume.

What You'll Do:

Investigations & Risk

  • Review incoming cases, decide which need attention first, and take action based on the type of case and the evidence.
  • Gather and document evidence; call, text, or email as needed to gather context and discuss irregularities or recurring patterns.
  • Follow documented procedures to handle standard cases independently, and escalate unusual, unclear, or high-stakes situations.
  • Keep a closer eye on accounts under review: follow up on open cases and record new findings on a regular cadence.
  • Execute compliance actions and assess coverage impact; alert cross-functional stakeholders as needed.
  • Handle escalation calls disputing investigation outcomes; communicate resolution actions clearly and professionally.

Signal Detection & Monitoring

  • Monitor and action daily alerts and signals indicating anomalies.
  • Surface pattern observations within cases and server behavior; escalate larger or recurring trends.

Compliance

  • Process identity document submissions for new applicants and document renewals; ensure documentation is complete and meets eligibility requirements.
  • Support weekly compliance document maintenance: action expired documents and send compliance outreach communications.
  • Support ad hoc internal requests and compliance-related projects.

Server Communications & Enablement

  • Handle inbound account update communications and outbound compliance outreach with contractors.
  • Contribute to the creation and maintenance of external-facing Help Center articles, ensuring content accurately reflects current processes and requirements.

Data, Reporting & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Track personal performance metrics.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally within the Marketplace Supply organization; participate in Product meetings and submit feature requests as needed.
  • Contribute to team process improvement efforts; surface observations and suggestions that support consistency and scalability.
  • Assist with account setup, compliance document collection, and activation processing.
  • Provide ad hoc support and contribute to marketplace projects as needed.

What You'll Bring:

  • 2-3 years of experience in risk and compliance, trust and safety, operations, or contractor management, preferably within a two-sided marketplace or technology platform.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct structured case reviews, including triage, evidence gathering, clear documentation, and sound enforcement judgment, while following established frameworks and playbooks.
  • Familiarity with compliance documentation, credentialing, and eligibility workflows; ability to apply rules consistently across varied cases.
  • Comfortable with data and business intelligence tools (SQL proficiency is a plus); experience tracking and owning personal performance metrics.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage a high volume of cases across multiple case types simultaneously while maintaining thoroughness and quality.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience drafting clear, professional user-facing communications and handling server escalation calls; experience with independent contractor communications preferred.
  • A collaborative, proactive mindset with a genuine interest in platform integrity, compliance, and operational excellence.

Compensation

  • Salary range $53,000 - $55,000 based on experience and location

Benefits

  • Full time, remote, salary position
  • Medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, and 401k available
  • Phone and Internet monthly stipend
  • Flexible time off (paid planned and sick time, and paid holidays)
  • Necessary equipment provided

E-Verify

This company participates in E-Verify, for more information view the Participation and Right to Work Posters.

Your way to impact

We’re not solving a small problem, and we’re not addressing a small market. We’re tackling returns—the part of the online shopping experience shoppers say they hate most. Our customers, i.e., top online retailers, use Happy Returns’ returns software and reverse logistics to offer shoppers a genuinely delightful return experience while at the same time reducing costs, retaining sales, and making their supply chains more sustainable. We’re making returns legitimately better for everyone, and we’re having fun doing it.

As the Engineering Manager for the Platform Team, you will lead a team responsible for shared services, reporting, data workflows, and tooling that support the broader engineering organization. You’ll combine people leadership, technical judgment, and delivery execution while also owning the team’s product direction—identifying high-impact opportunities, shaping the roadmap, and translating business needs into clear, actionable work.

This is a remote role, candidates may be based anywhere with in the United State of America. Candidates do not need to be local to Atlanta, Georgia.

Your day to day

  • Oversee the day-to-day operations of an engineering team.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop engineers through clear expectations, regular feedback, performance conversations, and career growth planning.
  • Define and maintain the Platform Team’s product vision and roadmap, ensuring priorities are aligned with business impact, stakeholder needs, technical health, risk, dependencies, and ROI.
  • Proactively identify project opportunities by understanding stakeholder pain points, operational gaps, technical debt, platform limitations, and company priorities.
  • Translate ambiguous business, stakeholder, or technical needs into scoped, actionable initiatives in partnership with technical leads and engineers.
  • Establish clear ownership, timelines, milestones, and follow-through for team commitments, while communicating progress, risks, blockers, and timeline changes early.
  • Maintain useful operating artifacts, including OKRs, roadmap updates, dashboards, project documentation, postmortems, and status updates.
  • Promote strong engineering practices around clean code, testing, observability, incident response, postmortems, and reduction of toil.

What you need to bring

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience managing, coaching, or leading technical teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to define direction, create clarity, and drive execution in ambiguous environments.
  • Strong product and strategic judgment, including the ability to identify project ideas, define outcomes, evaluate tradeoffs, and prioritize work.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and ensure engineering work delivers meaningful impact.
  • Experience working with data reporting, analytics, or business intelligence systems.
  • Strong delivery ownership, including the ability to establish timelines, manage dependencies, communicate risk, and hold teams accountable to commitments.

Bonus points if you have

  • Experience leading a platform, infrastructure, data, tooling, internal systems, or shared-services team.
  • Experience owning roadmap strategy or product direction for an internal platform or technical product.
  • Experience working in an environment where Engineering owns discovery, prioritization, and roadmap definition without a dedicated Product Manager.

This is a remote role, that can be based anywhere in the United States of America. Candidates do not need to be located in Georgia.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Cross-Cloud Architect
Location: 100% Remote (United States)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $175,000–$200,000 Annually
Experience: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Cross-Cloud Architect to design strategies, reference architectures, and platform capabilities that span multiple cloud providers — AWS, Azure, GCP, and selectively OCI — for enterprises operating on more than one cloud by deliberate choice. The role focuses on portability, abstraction layers, federated identity, cross-cloud networking, and platform offerings that hide cloud-specific complexity from product teams. The ideal candidate has architected meaningful multi-cloud capabilities, understands the trade-offs between portability and cloud-native depth, and brings strong opinions grounded in production experience.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in cloud architecture roles.
  • Hands-on architecture experience across at least two major cloud providers.
  • Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security across multiple providers.
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code across clouds.
  • Experience designing federated identity and SSO across cloud platforms.
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes, container platforms, and managed cloud services.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Multiple cloud certifications across providers.
  • Track record of leading multi-cloud architecture initiatives.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with abstraction platforms (Crossplane, Pulumi, Terraform CDK).
  • Familiarity with cloud-agnostic observability platforms.
  • Experience driving large-scale cloud-to-cloud migrations.
  • Exposure to regulated industries with multi-cloud mandates.
  • Public talks or writing on multi-cloud architecture.

raw.excerpt: In 1965, an engineer in Scotland was given a mundane task with a tricky problem to it - banks wanted to close on Saturdays and still serve customers, but they didn’t know how to solve authentication of the right user.
raw.description:
In 1965, an engineer in Scotland was given a mundane task with a tricky problem to it - banks wanted to close on Saturdays and still serve customers, but they didn’t know how to solve authentication of the right user. James Goodfellow, working at Smiths Industries, uncovered the insight that you needed something you have (a card) and something you know (a PIN). Because someone told him they could only remember 4 digits instead of his proposed 6, today over 3 million ATMs use a card+4 digit PIN over 60 years later.

Like the ATM, Mercury is building technology that pushes forward financial interfaces for the long term. Command is Mercury's LLM-powered financial assistant, launched to all customers in June 2026. It lets users understand their finances and take action in plain language, from asking about cash flow to sending payments, issuing cards, and managing invoices. With the product now in customers' hands, the work is to evolve it, extend its capabilities, and find new ways to leverage LLMs to give Mercury customers a more powerful banking* experience.

What You'll Do:

  • Ship new capabilities users love
  • Feel a strong sense of product ownership and actively seek responsibility – help design and ship new Command skills
  • Partner with product and compliance teams to define what "working correctly" means for each new capability, then build the tests that prove it
  • Join a small but mighty team of experienced product and AI engineers building the future of Mercury
  • This list is illustrative. Command is a product in motion and priorities will shift as we learn. The right person should be comfortable working in ambiguity, in a scrappy startup environment

The Ideal Candidate:

  • Has 1-4 years of backend or full-stack development experience, with knowledge of or excitement to learn Haskell, React, TypeScript, and Redux
  • Experience building LLM powered products
  • A builder who is passionately product-minded and has experience building and shipping new products
  • Empathizes with users and can channel their perspective to build lovable products
  • Can balance tradeoffs and find creative solutions to accomplish goals
  • Actively incorporates AI tools into their workflow and is excited about leveraging them to amplify their impact — whether that's accelerating development, improving code quality, or finding creative solutions to hard problems

If this role interests you, we invite you to explore our public demo at .
