raw.description:
Director Product Design

Europe / Remote
Reports to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer

About Velsera

Velsera builds software that turns complex biological data into research insight and clinical answers. Our platforms work across multi-omic and multi-modal data: genomics alongside proteomics, transcriptomics and other omics, together with imaging, clinical and real-world data, at the scale of some of the world's largest biomedical programs. Pharmaceutical companies, biotechs, public research initiatives and diagnostic laboratories use our products to advance precision medicine.

We run like a scale-up: small teams with real authority, fast decisions, and AI woven into how we work day to day. We measure ourselves on impact for our customers and, ultimately, for patients.

The opportunity

You'd be joining as the design authority for our Seven Bridges Platform and the leader of design at Velsera, just as we rebuild how we design, validate and ship. You report directly to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer, and decisions that take quarters elsewhere happen here in days. Our product managers have already started turning ideas into working, on-brand prototypes with AI and put them in front of customers within weeks. The design foundations that make that speed safe are yours to build and own: design tokens, a component library, and the patterns everyone works with.

That's the shape of your influence here. Product managers prototype with the system you build, you review what customers will see, and once a concept is validated, production design belongs to you: journeys that hold up across every state, edge case and installation. This is a product bioinformaticians, scientists and clinicians rely on every day, and you set its bar.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll manage our product designer working on the clinical side of our portfolio, you'll build the design function as it grows, and you'll keep doing the craft yourself. There's no large design team to inherit; there's one to create.

The product is changing as fast as the craft is. Our users increasingly work alongside AI in research and diagnostic workflows, with dense, high-stakes data from many sources. Someone needs to rethink the journeys, trust models and information design of software like ours for that reality. That is a key remit of this job.

This role won't suit everyone. If you're looking for a mature design organization with settled processes, you won't find that here yet. If you want to build the system a whole company designs with, lead design for products with real clinical stakes, and do it at scale-up speed, we should talk.

What you'll do

  • Own the user journeys, flows and interaction design of the Seven Bridges Platform: partner with product managers on problems, outcomes and scope, then own how the experience actually works, from structure and states down to the number of clicks.
  • Build our design system from the ground up: design tokens, a component library aligned with our front-end code, and the standards that bring our product surfaces together under one visual language. The whole organization will prototype with what you build.
  • Keep rapid prototyping fast and safe: maintain the foundations PMs build with, review prototype quality before customers see it, and take validated prototypes through to production-ready design.
  • Manage our product designer on the clinical side: set goals, develop their craft, give honest feedback, and answer for the quality of design across both businesses. As the team grows, you'll hire and shape it.
  • Design for AI in the product itself: assistant and copilot experiences, AI-generated results that scientists and clinicians can trust and verify, and workflows where automation and human judgment work together.
  • Work closely with front-end engineers so the design system lives in code, not only in Figma.
  • Use product analytics to see where users struggle, make experience debt visible, and give product leadership a clear case for what to fix first.
  • Bring design judgment into strategy conversations at the leadership level.

Your first few months

The first version of the design system is live, with tokens and core components in Figma and in code, and product managers are actually prototyping on top of it. You've reviewed working prototypes before they went in front of real customers, and what we shipped is better for it. You and the designer you manage have a real working rhythm, with clear goals and honest feedback, and it shows in the work. And your map of our experience debt is on the leadership table with a clear case for what to fix first.

Requirements

What you bring

You've spent seven or more years in product design, with senior ownership of user journeys on complex, data-heavy or scientific software.

  • You've built or led at least one design system that engineering genuinely adopted, and you know what it takes to keep one alive.
  • You've managed designers formally, not just mentored them, and the people you've managed got better and would work for you again.
  • You're comfortable having your biggest impact through a system other people build with, not only through screens you designed yourself.
  • You've chosen fast, ambiguous environments before, and you're looking for another one.
  • You already use AI tools to design, prototype and produce working software (we work with Claude, from design exploration through design-to-code), and you have well-formed opinions about where these tools help and where they mislead.
  • You've designed AI-powered product experiences, or you have a clear point of view on trust, transparency and human oversight in AI interfaces.
  • You're an expert in Figma, including variables and design-to-code workflows such as Code Connect.
  • You know enough front-end to collaborate credibly with engineers on components and constraints. You don't need to write production code, but you do need to understand how your designs become it.
  • You can operate as the most senior design voice in the company: comfortable with ambiguity, generous as a coach, and clear whether you're talking to executives, engineers or scientists.

Nice to have: experience with genomics, multi-omics, imaging, clinical or other life sciences data products, or another regulated domain; products delivered across multiple environments or installations; familiarity with component documentation tools like Storybook; experience establishing design practice in an engineering-led organization.

Why this position

You get real authority over a core product and the design function itself, from day one, with a direct line to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer. You join a company that works the way it's asking you to work: AI-assisted, fast and hands-on. The work ends in research results and patient outcomes, which makes the pace worth it. And you won't inherit a design practice here; you'll build the one everyone after you inherits.

Benefits

Our core values

People first. We create collaborative and supportive environments by operating with respect and flexibility to promote mental, emotional and physical health. We practice empathy by treating others the way they want to be treated and assuming positive intent. We are proud of our inclusive diverse team and humble ourselves to learn about and build our connection with each other.

Patient focused. We act with swift determination without sacrificing our expectations of quality. We are driven by providing exceptional solutions for our customers to positively impact patient lives. Considering what is at stake, we challenge ourselves to develop the best solution, not just the easy one.

Integrity. We hold ourselves accountable and strive for transparent communication to build trust amongst ourselves and our customers. We take ownership of our results as we know what we do matters and collectively we will change the healthcare industry. We are thoughtful and intentional with every customer interaction understanding the overall impact on human health.

Curious. We ask questions and actively listen in order to learn and continuously improve. We embrace change and the opportunities it presents to make each other better. We strive to be on the cutting edge of science and technology innovation by encouraging creativity.

Impactful. We take our social responsibility with the seriousness it deserves and hold ourselves to a high standard. We improve our sustainability by encouraging discussion and taking action as it relates to our natural, social and economic resource footprint. We are devoted to our humanitarian mission and look for new ways to make the world a better place.

raw.excerpt: Who We AreFlosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.

We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.

Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.

Why This Role Exists

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
  • Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
  • CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
  • Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with your experience and impact
  • Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
  • A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
  • The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world
  • Meaningful technical challenges: security, compliance, scale, and reliability at the intersection of Node.js and Salesforce
  • A culture that rewards ownership, speed, and craftsmanship over politics and hierarchy
  • Remote-first flexibility with a results-oriented work environment

description: DataVisor is the world’s leading AI-powered Fraud and Risk Platform that delivers the best overall detection coverage in the industry.

raw.title: Customer Success Manager - Fraud/AML Strategy
raw.excerpt: DataVisor is the world’s leading AI-powered Fraud and Risk Platform that delivers the best overall detection coverage in the industry.
raw.description:
DataVisor is the world’s leading AI-powered Fraud and Risk Platform that delivers the best overall detection coverage in the industry. With an open SaaS platform that supports easy consolidation and enrichment of any data, DataVisor's fraud and anti-money laundering (AML) solutions scale infinitely and enable organizations to act on fast-evolving fraud and money laundering activities in real time. Its patented unsupervised machine learning technology, advanced device intelligence, powerful decision engine, and investigation tools work together to provide significant performance lift from day one. DataVisor's platform is architected to support multiple use cases across different business units flexibly, dramatically lowering total cost of ownership, compared to legacy point solutions. DataVisor is recognized as an industry leader and has been adopted by many Fortune 500 companies across the globe.

Our award-winning software platform is powered by a team of world-class experts in big data, machine learning, security, and scalable infrastructure. Our culture is open, positive, collaborative, and results-driven. Come join us!

Job Summary

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), you will serve as a strategic partner to key enterprise clients, helping them drive ROI through advanced fraud detection, AML compliance, and operational optimization. You’ll lead customer engagements across a portfolio of Fortune 500 companies in FinTech, Banking, and E-commerce, providing expert guidance on how to maximize value from our industry-leading SaaS platform.

Your responsibilities include monitoring detection system performance, advising on best practices for using machine learning models, rules engine, and device intelligence signals, and identifying opportunities to reduce fraud or money laundering risks and streamline operations. You’ll work cross-functionally with Product and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and support ongoing innovation.

This role combines strategic consulting, data-driven decisioning, and hands-on product expertise to deliver measurable impact for our clients.

This is a remote-based position and will be located in Japan.

Requirements

  • Act as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned enterprise customers, ensuring successful onboarding, adoption, and long-term value realization
  • Understand client business models, fraud/AML risk exposure, and operational needs to define success criteria and shape tailored solution strategies
  • Partner closely with clients to align our fraud detection and AML platform capabilities to their goals, driving measurable improvements in fraud prevention, loss reduction, and operational efficiency
  • Coordinate with internal teams (including Modeling, Product, and Engineering) to ensure timely delivery of enhancements, issue resolution, and optimization of detection outcomes
  • Translate customer insights into actionable feedback for internal roadmap planning and product improvements
  • Monitor detection performance metrics, support quarterly business reviews, and proactively identify opportunities for expansion or deeper integration
  • Educate clients on best practices in fraud/AML strategies and platform usage to maximize return on investment
  • Represent the voice of the customer internally and the voice of our platform externally, including participation in industry events, customer workshops, and solution showcases

Skillset Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in fraud strategy, risk analytics, customer success, or fraud operations within fintech, banking, payments, or e-commerce industries
  • Deep understanding of fraud/AML use cases such as transaction fraud, account takeover, promotion abuse, synthetic identity fraud, or mule detection
  • Experience working with machine learning-based detection systems and/or rule engines for fraud prevention
  • Strong analytical skills; proficient with SQL, and experience in Python or R for data exploration and investigation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Confident in leading customer-facing discussions and executive presentations
  • Highly organized with strong project ownership and time management skills; able to manage multiple enterprise accounts simultaneously
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical, analytical, or business-related field; advanced degree a plus

Benefits

Base salary, bonus & PTO

Compensation: Annual salary range of JPY 5MM-9MM, commensurate with experience.

raw.title: Senior IFS Techno-Functional Consultant / IFS Platform Specialist
raw.excerpt: We are seeking a highly experienced IFS Techno-Functional Platform Specialist to support and optimize the IFS Cloud environment across configuration, extensibility, integrations, and platform administration.
raw.description:
We are seeking a highly experienced IFS Techno-Functional Platform Specialist to support and optimize the IFS Cloud environment across configuration, extensibility, integrations, and platform administration. This is not a core development role, but requires deep hands-on expertise with IFS configuration, workflows, security, upgrades, and troubleshooting within a complex enterprise environment.

Core Responsibilities

IFS Configuration & Platform Administration

  • Configure and support IFS Cloud platform (Aurena client, page designer, custom fields, custom actions)
  • Manage IFS extensibility framework (custom events, workflows, business process automation, projections)
  • Administer security model including users, roles, permission sets, and access control
  • Manage background jobs, scheduled tasks, report routing, and system configurations
  • Support IFS upgrades, service updates, environment readiness, regression validation, and rollback planning

Integrations & Technical Support

  • Support IFS Connect, queues, routing rules, and platform integrations
  • Troubleshoot application, workflow, data, and integration-related issues
  • Investigate logs, system behavior, and performance issues to identify root causes
  • Monitor system health, background processing, and platform performance
  • Support configuration and optimization of native and extended IFS functionality

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Partner with IT/IS teams and business stakeholders on prioritization and solution design
  • Coordinate platform changes, enhancements, and system improvements
  • Document configurations, integrations, workflows, and technical procedures
  • Support continuous improvement and automation initiatives

Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience with IFS Cloud / IFS Applications
  • Deep experience in IFS configuration, extensibility, and platform administration (not core code development)
  • Experience with Aurena, custom fields, custom actions, events, workflows, and projections
  • Strong knowledge of IFS security model (users, roles, permissions, access control)
  • Experience supporting IFS upgrades, maintenance, and troubleshooting
  • Experience with IFS Connect, integrations, queues, and routing rules
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills within ERP environments
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Strong communication skills and experience working with U.S.-based teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience in complex enterprise environments
  • Exposure to business process automation and system optimization
  • Familiarity with integration best practices and documentation standards
  • Experience with performance tuning and platform monitoring within IFS

Benefits

  • We offer health insurance for contractors
  • Holiday Extra Pay
  • The work hours generally align with standard business hours in the US, with some potential flexibility depending on the client's needs.
  • This is a 100% home-based position
  • We prioritize the mental health of our team members and offer mental health days to support their well-being.
  • In addition to the base salary, performance-based incentives are provided.
  • There is an annual review and appraisal process in place.
  • There are ample opportunities for professional growth and advancement within the company.

Our award-winning software platform is powered by a team of world-class experts in big data, machine learning, security, and scalable infrastructure. Our culture is open, positive, collaborative, and results-driven. Come join us!

Job Summary

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), you will serve as a strategic partner to key enterprise clients, helping them drive ROI through advanced fraud detection, AML compliance, and operational optimization. You’ll lead customer engagements across a portfolio of Fortune 500 companies in FinTech, Banking, and E-commerce, providing expert guidance on how to maximize value from our industry-leading SaaS platform.

You’ll work cross-functionally with Product and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and support ongoing innovation.

This role combines strategic consulting, data-driven decisioning, and hands-on product expertise to deliver measurable impact for our clients.

  • Translate customer insights into actionable feedback for internal roadmap planning and product improvements
  • Monitor detection performance metrics, support quarterly business reviews, and proactively identify opportunities for expansion or deeper integration
  • Educate clients on best practices in fraud/AML strategies and platform usage to maximize return on investment
  • Represent the voice of the customer internally and the voice of our platform externally, including participation in industry events, customer workshops, and solution showcases
  • EU Citizen, residence of Ireland

Skillset Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in fraud strategy, risk analytics, customer success, or fraud operations within fintech, banking, payments, or e-commerce industries
  • Deep understanding of fraud/AML use cases such as transaction fraud, account takeover, promotion abuse, synthetic identity fraud, or mule detection
  • Experience working with machine learning-based detection systems and/or rule engines for fraud prevention
  • Strong analytical skills; proficient with SQL, and experience in Python or R for data exploration and investigation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Confident in leading customer-facing discussions and executive presentations
  • Highly organized with strong project ownership and time management skills; able to manage multiple enterprise accounts simultaneously
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical, analytical, or business-related field; advanced degree a plus

Benefits

  • Compensation: Annual salary range of EUR 40,000-80,000, commensurate with experience.
  • Bonus

raw.title: Senior Node.js Developer (Belgium)
raw.excerpt: Who We AreFlosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.

We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.

Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.

Why This Role Exists

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
  • Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
  • CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
  • Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with your experience and impact
  • Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
  • A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
  • The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world
  • Meaningful technical challenges: security, compliance, scale, and reliability at the intersection of Node.js and Salesforce
  • A culture that rewards ownership, speed, and craftsmanship over politics and hierarchy
  • Remote-first flexibility with a results-oriented work environment

raw.description:
We're Vitality, improving people's health around the world through best-in-class evidence, science, technology, and most importantly our people. Vitality encourages changes in lifestyle that reduce health care costs, both in the short run and long term, by rewarding members for addressing their specific health issues. Vitality wellness programs serve companies in a wide range of sizes and industries, improving individuals' health and well-being as well as employers' bottom lines. Vitality brings a global perspective through successful partnerships with large employers and best-in-class insurers around the world, in countries including the United States, United Kingdom, South Africa, China, Singapore, and Australia. Join Vitality and transform health around the world.

Our Product Design team owns the strategy, ideation, design, and execution of every digital product and feature our members touch. As a Product Designer, you'll identify the pain points and challenges our members face, uncover opportunities, and ship solutions aligned with our business goals.

We're committed to improving the lives of our members and to building the best possible environment for the people who design for them. Come join a team of designers passionate about creating the very best product experience for Vitality's millions of members worldwide.

  • Own end-to-end Product Design thinking for key member experience flows.
  • Evaluate business requirements and define member needs in close collaboration with product, engineering, and research.
  • Create flows, prototypes, and other design artifacts — increasingly AI-assisted — needed to communicate features and functionality clearly and quickly.
  • Present designs and key milestones to peers and stakeholders, and lead the collection, synthesis, and integration of feedback.
  • Lead projects confidently to success through clear communication, decisive action, and strong craft.
  • Conduct usability testing, document results, and turn findings into concrete insight recommendations.
  • Champion a scalable design system, making consistent design decisions that keep deliverables on-brand and accessible by default while considering the wider impact and future system evolution.
  • Build curiosity around emerging technologies and how they can accelerate discovery. Explore agentic design process in Figma so exploration and production both move faster without sacrificing craft.

Salary Range: $100,000-$110,000

Requirements

  • Confidence thinking about high-level product vision, understanding constraints, and contributing to a fantastic member experience.
  • Solid grounding in design thinking, with a passion for shaping design strategy, not just executing it.
  • Very strong attention to detail and excellent visual and interaction design skills.
  • Cross-functional collaboration experience with Product on requirements, Research on user insights, and Engineering on seamless implementation.
  • Exploration using AI tools to accelerate rapid ideation, concept exploration, and interactive prototyping across the end-to-end design process.
  • Ability to present design solutions and supporting rationale to stakeholders at every level.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment across cross-functional teams.
  • Up-to-date understanding of best practices and trends across web, mobile, and platform design guidelines.
  • 4+ years of high-performance interface experience designing for mobile, web, and responsive platforms (account, member, or subscription experiences are a strong plus).
  • Professional-level Figma expertise — deep fluency with auto layout, variables, components/variants, interactive prototyping, and Dev Mode, used fast and cleanly.
  • Hands-on experience building agentic or automated workflows inside Figma — using Figma's AI capabilities, plugin-based automation, or connected agents to generate, iterate, or QA design work at scale — with a real before/after story to tell.
  • Experience designing for diverse audiences: international users, multi-language localization, and accessibility for people with disabilities, aligned with WCAG standards.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

Desirable

  • Experience designing membership, subscription, loyalty, or rewards-based platforms.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering for design and research use cases (synthesizing interviews, generating test copy, etc.).
  • Front-end development fluency and experience pairing with developers in platform-agnostic frameworks.
  • Experience scaling a design system used by multiple teams.

Benefits

Medical, Dental and Vision

401(k) with company match

Company paid Life, AD&D Short and Long term disability insurance
Generous PTO, Holidays and Summer Fridays
100% paid parental leave

Wellness Resources

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and adapt in fast-paced environments
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and ability to quickly learn new tools

Who You Are

Proactive — you anticipate needs and act before being asked

Solutions-driven — you find ways to make things happen

Highly organized — you keep multiple priorities and projects on track

Professional — you maintain confidentiality and clear communication

Adaptable — you thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments

  • Administrative support without direct C-level exposure
  • Project coordination without ownership or independent problem-solving
  • Roles where calendar management, stakeholder communication, or document prep were minimal

raw.description:
Kindly submit your application and CV in English to ensure it is successfully reviewed.

From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their clients to arrange 'me time' moments, Booksy is the business of elevating people - helping them to thrive and feel fantastic. Lifting others up can be hard, heavy work, and we passionately believe that the sense of purpose and personal satisfaction this brings are worth it.

What started in Poland is now an international, cloud-based marketplace that's scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.

Working in a rapidly growing, ever-changing scale-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.

Your responsibilities:

As a Senior International Tax Accountant reporting to the Global Head of Tax in our Finance team, your purpose will be to take ownership of international tax compliance, reporting, and transfer pricing workstreams across our growing global footprint. You will collaborate closely with accounting and business teams, research VAT and invoice compliance across European jurisdictions, lead monthly reconciliations, and help streamline external advisor relationships across markets including Spain, France, the UK, and the US.

What you'll own and impact:

  • Own non-Polish entity workstreams (covering markets like the UK, Spain, France, Brazil, South Africa, and Mexico) including managing relationships with external tax advisors in each jurisdiction.
  • Manage day-to-day international tax compliance, reporting, and transfer pricing workstreams.
  • Research invoice content and ensure VAT compliance across various European jurisdictions.
  • Navigate audit questions and tax-authority inquiries, collaborating on cross-functional product or business initiatives.
  • Perform monthly reconciliations with the accounting team and continuously improve tax process documentation.
  • Support tax planning, financial reporting, and internal controls - including tax provisions, legislation monitoring, and systems/process improvements (e.g., billing transformation) - to keep pace with the business as it scales.

The reality of the role: We operate as a small, close-knit global tax team in a scaling environment. Priorities shift quickly around tax deadlines, authority audits, and changing regional regulations across markets-so frequent context-switching and comfort with ambiguity are essential. In return, you’ll gain broad exposure to multiple European and US tax regimes and build true multi-jurisdiction ownership as the business scales.

Requirements

Essentially, to ensure you succeed in this role you’re going to need:

  • Professional tax or accounting certifications (such as CPA, ACA, ACCA or local equivalent).
  • Demonstrated expertise in tax compliance, monthly reconciliations, process documentation, and transfer pricing operations.
  • Solid understanding of Polish tax regulations combined with exposure to (or a strong appetite to learn) international tax compliance.
  • Hands-on proficiency with MS Excel and standard tax preparation/accounting tools.
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English, essential for daily communication across international markets and external partners.

It will also help you to have:

  • Prior experience working with ERP systems (such as Dynamics NAV) or managing external tax advisor networks.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Experience operating within a fast-moving technology sector or dynamic scale-up environment.

Benefits

Some of our Polish benefits are:

  • Fully remote position - We take pride in being a globally distributed team. All we ask is that you're based in the country/region this role is advertised in.
  • Subsidized Allianz private medical care with self-funded top-up options for dependents.
  • Flexible Multisport card options with Booksy's contribution based on the package you choose.
  • Fully covered, anonymous consultations with a Booksy Psychologist and a full Headspace subscription.
  • Company-funded UNIQA life assurance.
  • Access to Cleo - a global support system guiding you through fertility, expecting a newborn, parenting, eldercare, and menopause.
  • Additional life Insurance from PZU (unsubsidized, voluntary).

Our Diversity and Inclusion Commitment:

We work in a highly creative and diverse industry so it goes without saying that we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. We welcome people from all backgrounds and are committed to fair consideration in our hiring process. If you have any accessibility needs or require reasonable adjustments during the interview process, please contact us at , so we can best support you.

raw.description:
Sharetru has been in the Managed File Transfer (MFT) market for 25 years. Our product is trusted, our reputation is strong, and our customer base is real and growing. Now we're making a deliberate investment in dedicated sales.

You'll own the entire revenue cycle: prospecting, qualifying, running the deal, closing it, and handing off to our customer success team. You'll work primarily with SMB and mid-market accounts, with the occasional enterprise opportunity in the mix. You'll work closely with customer success, and at times, directly with our development and support teams.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just sell software — they're keen to understand it. You ask good questions, go deep on how things work, and get genuinely curious about the problems our customers are trying to solve. As we grow the sales function, there's a real path here into sales leadership for the right person.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience in SaaS
  • Proven track record closing SMB and mid-market deals
  • Deep intellectual curiosity about software — you want to understand how things work, not just what to demo
  • Strong HubSpot proficiency and a genuine commitment to CRM hygiene
  • Experience qualifying prospects through discovery calls
  • Comfortable holding both a strategic and technical conversation
  • Self-starter mindset — you thrive with ownership and know how to build a pipeline from intent
  • Comfortable with travel to conferences and industry events
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; you're clear, direct, and human

What You'll Do

  • Own and exceed a quarterly/annual sales quota — you'll have clear targets, the support to hit them, and the autonomy to get there your way.
  • Prospect, outbound, build, and follow up — work hand in hand with marketing to help define who our best customers are based on your conversations. You own Sales Accepted Leads (SALs) through to close
  • Qualify leads thoughtfully and move opportunities forward with a clear process
  • Run structured, consultative sales cycles tailored to SMB and mid-market buyers
  • Lead product demos and technical conversations with confidence -- and know when to bring in team members
  • Close deals, then hand off customers to our onboarding and success team
  • Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene in HubSpot — for yourself and for the health of the business
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with customer success, support, and development
  • Represent us at industry conferences and events — you'll travel to build relationships and generate pipeline.
  • Help shape how we build and scale a dedicated sales motion

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to government contractors
  • Familiarity with compliance or security requirements
  • Prior sales team management or mentorship experience
  • Background in secure data exchange / Managed File Transfer (MFT)

Benefits

  • Base Salary + Commission
  • Employer-paid medical — full healthcare coverage for the employee
  • Employer-paid vision & dental — fully covered
  • Parental leave — maternity & paternity leave
  • Short & long-term disability — employer-paid
  • 401k / Roth with employer match
  • Time off — vacation, medical leave, plus 10 paid company holidays
  • Company-provided technology — everything you need to work remotely
  • Employer-paid internet & phone stipend
  • Expense account — for travel, conferences, and client meetings
  • Fully remote

raw.description:
会社概要

弊社は、MITとStanford大学院の卒業生によって2021年4月に創業されたリーガルテック企業です。創業当初からプロダクトへの高い信頼度を武器に、これまでほぼ口コミ・紹介のみで顧客基盤を拡大し、約4年間にわたり外部からの資金調達を行わずに急激な成長を遂げました。

結果として、今では日本の5大法律事務所やLINEヤフー社、メルカリ社などをはじめとする、数百の優良顧客へ導入いただいております。また、既に米国や韓国をはじめとする国外へもプロダクトを展開しております。

会社概要

BoostDraftは現在50名規模となり、国内での強固な事業基盤を土台に、APACをはじめとするグローバル展開を本格化させる重要な転換期を迎えています。本ポジションには、COOの右腕として事業全体を俯瞰し、全社視点でのリソース最適化と非連続な成長を牽引する役割を期待しています。戦術的なオペレーションの枠を越え、「どこで、どう勝つか」という純粋な事業戦略を描き、その実行を主導する事業成長の要となっていただきます。そして、中長期的にはJapan Business Headとして、営業、マーケティング、カスタマーサクセスなどの各ビジネス部門を統括し、日本市場における事業成長のトップとして組織を牽引していただくことを想定しています。

想定業務:

  • 経営課題の特定と解決策の実行
    • 事業の成長を阻害している根本的な課題の特定と構造化
    • 各部門（営業、カスタマーサクセス等）を横断する業務プロセスの見直し、および改善プランの策定
    • 策定した戦略に基づく各現場への実行プランの落とし込み、および複数部門を巻き込んだプロジェクトの完遂
  • 日本事業の成長戦略および新規事業の立案
    • データ分析に基づく、既存事業の売上拡大に向けた最も効果的な打ち手の特定と検証
    • 市場調査や顧客へのヒアリングを通じた、新規事業や新機能におけるビジネスモデルの検討
  • 海外拠点との連携およびグローバル展開の支援
    • 韓国や北米のBizOps担当者との連携、およびメンタリング
    • 各国の市場動向や成功事例の統合を通じた、APAC市場への展開戦略の構築
  • 重要顧客・パートナーとの関係構築
    • 大手企業の意思決定層に対する、経営視点での直接的な提案や重要交渉
    • 事業拡大を目的とした他社との戦略的な提携、およびアライアンス交渉への参画
  • 経営の意思決定を支えるデータ分析体制の構築
    • 各部門に散在する事業データの統合、およびKPIの可視化
    • 経営陣が迅速かつ的確な意思決定を行うためのモニタリング体制の整備と運用

※上記はあくまで想定業務となります

BoostDraftの魅力:

  • 創業から約4年間資金調達を行わずに事業拡大をした稀有なスタートアップ環境
  • 優秀な人財に囲まれたチャレンジングな環境 (Microsoft, NTT, BCG出身者等)
  • インターナショナルなチーム環境 (従業員の約半数が外国籍のメンバー)
  • マネジメント層含め、小さなお子様を抱えているメンバーも活躍中

Requirements

必須経験/スキル -

  • ビジネスレベルの英語力、およびネイティブレベルの日本語力

また、下記のいずれか一つ

  • 戦略コンサルティングファーム、または総合系コンサルティングファームでの実務経験（マネージャー等、プロジェクトリードの経験を想定）
  • スタートアップ企業（数十名〜百名規模）における事業開発、経営企画、またはBizOps等の実務経験

歓迎経験/スキル

  • B2B ソフトウェア領域における事業成長の知見
  • グローバルチーム、または多国籍なメンバーとの協働・マネジメント経験

求める人物像

  • 「自ら手を動かすこと」を厭わず、カオスな環境を楽しめるハンズオン志向
  • 「第二創業期」のスピード感と変化を楽しみ、自ら課題解決に取り組める強いオーナーシップを持つ方。
  • 策定した戦略を、他部門を巻き込みながら粘り強く実行し、成果につなげる高いコミットメント力。
  • 自律的に高いパフォーマンスを発揮しつつ、グローバルチームへの貢献を欠かさない方。

Benefits

働き方:

  • フルリモート

※顧客先応報や出張を伴う対面業務が発生する可能性あり

  • フレックスタイム
    • フレキシブルタイム: 午前6時- 午前11時半 / 午後3時 - 午後10時
    • コアタイム:午前11時半 - 午後3時
  • バーチャルオフィス
    • バーチャル空間で自身のキャラクターを作成し、他社員との交流や会議が可能

その他:

原則自宅、その他自宅に準じる場所

※業務都合により会社が指定する場所への出社の可能性あり

完全週休二日制（土日祝日 / 年末年始(会社の定める日) /その他会社の定める日）

正社員・年俸制（固定残業代）

有り（6か月）

raw.description:
Role Title: Bilingual Mental Health Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

We are engaging bilingual mental health experts to contribute to a customer’s project focused on enhancing AI systems with nuanced expertise. In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Required Skills

  • clinical psychology

  • bilingual communication

  • ethical decision-making

  • cultural sensitivity

  • analytical evaluation

  • case study development

  • written and verbal communication

  • interdisciplinary collaboration

  • psychological assessment

  • documentation

Scope of Work

  • Analyze and evaluate AI-generated psychological content for accuracy, relevance, and ethical standards.

  • Develop and review data sets involving psychological case studies, assessments, and conversations for AI system training.

  • Craft detailed written feedback and verbal insights to refine AI responses in contexts such as clinical scenarios, research vignettes, and therapeutic dialogues.

  • Identify potential biases or inaccuracies within AI-generated outputs and propose evidence-based improvements.

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to integrate psychological concepts and frameworks into AI model training processes.

  • Ensure adherence to cultural, linguistic, and clinical best practices for diverse user scenarios.

  • Contribute to documentation and knowledge-sharing resources that guide ongoing AI development.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Completed Ph.D in Psychology or MD with completed psychiatry residency.

  • Native proficiency in at least one of: French, Malay, Russian, Mandarin, Japanese, Urdu, Swahili, Bulgarian, Tagalog, Polish, Marathi, Lithuanian, Georgian, Bengali, Vietnamese, or Indonesian, plus advanced English communication skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex psychological concepts clearly in both written and verbal formats.

  • Experience in clinical practice, research, or higher education in psychology or psychiatry.

  • Strong analytical and evaluative skills to assess psychological data and narrative content.

  • Awareness of cultural sensitivity and ethical considerations in global mental health contexts.

  • Previous experience collaborating on interdisciplinary or technology-driven projects is a plus.

raw.excerpt: Who We AreProminence is a healthcare technology strategy and implementation firm, focused on helping the nation’s leading healthcare organizations to do more with their data.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Prominence is a healthcare technology strategy and implementation firm, focused on helping the nation’s leading healthcare organizations to do more with their data. Founded by former Epic managers, we understand the technology landscape in healthcare and provide IT staffing, advisory services, and analytics solutions to create robust data ecosystems that support clinical workflows, automate operational processes, and expedite research. Whether it’s guiding a technology implementation, establishing governance principles, or developing leading edge analytics, we help our customers make sense out of the mountain of data at their fingertips in order to deliver higher quality care at a lower cost.

Ranked as a best place to work over 27 times (and counting!), Prominence’s culture provides consultants with a supportive environment that allows you to innovate and grow your career in healthcare IT. Additional information is available on our website.

Your Role

Our consultants guide our customers through complex data challenges to summit the task at hand. As a Data Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain pipelines and workflows that enable our customers to put their data to work. You will need to be able to create order out of chaos, transforming raw sources into clean, reliable, and scalable data streams.

Our ideal team members are humble, smart, and driven to ensure our customer’s success. This includes a passion to deliver high-quality results, while teaching our counterparts how to fish and grow the skills needed to support and expand upon the deliverables of our projects.

If this sounds like you, and you meet the requirements below, we encourage you to apply. If you know of someone else who would be a great fit, let us know.

Requirements

Prominence is looking for a Data Engineer with strong experience in SQL and Python to help us build and optimize data pipelines in partnership with some of the nation’s leading healthcare providers. Our ideal candidate has hands-on experience with cloud-based data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, AWS Redshift, or Google BigQuery.

You should be able to build scalable data pipelines that ingest, transform, and deliver data from diverse sources (EHRs, claims, APIs, CRM) into analytics-ready structures. More important than any single tool is the demonstrated desire and ability to tackle new and unfamiliar technical challenges.

This position is a full-time, salaried role with benefits. There is no relocation required. Candidates are required to have a suitable home office to operate from.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2–5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles
  • Strong SQL skills, including query optimization and debugging
  • Proficiency in Python (or another programming/scripting language such as Scala or Java)
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of the following:
    • Snowflake
    • Databricks
    • Azure Data Factory
    • AWS Redshift
    • Google BigQuery
    • dbt or similar transformation tools
    • Apache Airflow or other orchestration frameworks
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT principles, data warehousing, and data modeling concepts
  • Experience with cloud services (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

Desired Qualifications

  • Healthcare industry knowledge and experience (Epic, HL7, FHIR, claims)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and DevOps workflows
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation)
  • Experience with real-time/streaming data tools (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub)
  • Containerization experience (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Cloud or data tool certifications

Success Criteria

Successful team members at Prominence display the following:

  • High degree of professionalism; treats others with respect, keeps commitments, builds trust within a team, works with integrity, and upholds organizational values.
  • Highly organized; able to manage multi-faceted work streams.
  • Self-motivated; able to manage schedules, meet deadlines, and monitor your personal work product.
  • Highly adaptable; able to acclimate quickly to new project assignments and work environments.
  • Creative; not paralyzed by problems and able to work collaboratively to find novel solutions.
  • Clear communication skills; ability to convey messaging in clear and concise written and verbal communications.
  • Ability to anticipate issues before they arise and escalate effectively.
  • Passion to mentor and guide others.

Benefits

Prominence is dedicated to hiring the best and brightest minds in healthcare, and maintaining a culture that rewards our employees for following their passion. You’ll join a team of highly motivated and passionate people who do great work for the nation’s leading healthcare organizations, including 7 of the top 10 academic medical centers. In the past 5 years, we’ve received 20+ Best Places to Work Awards and are highly rated in KLAS, reflecting the quality work from our team of A-players who move mountains daily for our customers. We strive to create the best working environment with the best team, so that we can continue to drive innovation in healthcare faster.

  • Our 2 nodes of business: Analytics and Epic Services - offer you a diversified career path, stability in a rapidly changing market, and opportunities for growth within Prominence.
  • Prominence is a fully remote company, with no requirements on where you live or work within the US and flexibility to manage your schedule.
  • We offer 15 days PTO and up to 16 paid Holidays each year for full-time staff.
  • We offer a diverse healthcare offering, including low and high deductible health plans, HSAs, LTD/STD Insurance, Health and Dependent Savings Accounts, Vision, Dental, 401k offering, an annual Professional Development fund, and Signing Bonuses.

raw.description:
About Us

BTC Inc. is the parent company of Bitcoin Magazine, The Bitcoin Conference, and Bitcoin for Corporations. Our mission is Hyperbitcoinization, the global adoption of Bitcoin as the world's preferred monetary network. We believe Bitcoin opens the door to a global monetary network free from poor incentives, censorship, and government manipulation. Our journey to success involves decades of complex problem-solving, product development, and service creation in order to onboard billions of people into a future where money is more accessible, borderless, and inclusive. If you enjoy working on challenging problems, fast-paced sprints, and navigating ambiguity, you'll find our mission and type of work inspiring and rewarding.

The Role

We are seeking a product-minded Chief Technology Officer to architect and build the data platform that powers BTC Inc's next generation of products. You will lead the design and delivery of our core data infrastructure and consumer app architecture, own engineering standards across the company, and build the engineering organization behind them. You will report directly to the CEO and operate as a peer to product leadership, sharing one joint platform roadmap.

The ideal candidate has personally built, not just managed, a data platform that powers a revenue product. You are a senior IC at heart who has grown into leadership without losing your hands. You read an engineering plan and immediately want to redline it. You are wary of frameworks, transformation roadmaps, and any first-90-days plan that does not include shipping code. You have built or shepherded a modern data stack (BigQuery or Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, identity resolution, BI) and shipped data products that customers paid for. You are Bitcoin-literate or genuinely curious. You are comfortable being the first engineering hire and the last call on architecture.

The Work

Platform Architecture

  • Own the technical architecture of our data platform: warehouse, ingestion pipelines, identity resolution, and a unified data model across the business.
  • Make the early infrastructure calls: ETL tooling, dbt structure, BI layer, orchestration, and data governance posture.
  • Sequence the platform buildout to ship a working unified dataset within the first few months.

Consumer App & Data Connectivity

  • Define the technical relationship between our consumer app and our data platform: what gets captured, how identity flows, what gets enriched, and what flows back to the user.
  • Partner with the app engineering team (initially contractor, transitioning to FTE) on the consumer surface and event credentialing.
  • Ensure event credentialing is production-grade and survives tens of thousands of users on day one.

Engineering Leadership & Standards

  • Hire and develop the engineering team. Model constraint before headcount: automate, simplify, and ship before you hire.
  • Establish the engineering culture: code review, on-call, observability, technical writing, and a high IC bar.
  • Be the technical interviewer and bar-raiser on every engineering hire.
  • Set and enforce engineering standards company-wide, favoring shipped reference implementations over policy memos.
  • Own standards on day one; the broader technology portfolio consolidates under you as systems mature.
  • Surface technical constraints to the leadership team in plain language, and carry commercial constraints back into engineering planning.

Security, Compliance & Data Governance

  • Stand up SOC 2 readiness on a timeline that supports enterprise-grade commercial products.
  • Own GDPR, consent tiering, and right-to-erasure capability across the platform from day one.
  • Make vendor and tooling decisions that survive audit and scale.
  • Work with existing technology team to architect and enact future IT infrastructure and steward technical philosophies org wide.

Your Experience

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years as the senior-most technical leader at a startup, data-intelligence company, fintech, or media-intelligence business.
  • Personally architected and shipped a data platform that powered a revenue product.
  • Deep, current expertise in a modern data stack: BigQuery or Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran or Airbyte, an orchestrator (Airflow, Dagster), and a BI layer (Looker, Hex, Metabase).
  • Track record hiring and growing senior ICs in a small, high-trust environment; no preference for command-and-control management styles.
  • Comfortable making product and commercial trade-offs, not just technical ones; able to push back on commercial leadership when the engineering reality requires it.
  • Bitcoin-literate, or genuinely curious about Bitcoin as a monetary network, the Bitcoin treasury thesis, and the Lightning/x402 stack.
  • Strongly preferred: AI native with experience building consumer mobile, agent-facing APIs (MCP, x402), or research/intelligence data products at production scale.

Additional Benefits

In addition to working on a meaningful mission in a challenging environment, we also provide the following:

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Company MacBook
  • Health, Dental, and Vision
  • Remote First / Your Schedule
  • 100% Paid Life Insurance and Disability
  • Work alongside a talented, fast-paced team solving complex problems
  • The opportunity to connect and network with the Bitcoin industry and leaders in the space.

We're looking for a Sales Development Representative to drive outbound pipeline for a fast-moving B2B sales intelligence platform. You will prospect into SMB and mid-market accounts, conduct outbound outreach via phone, email, and LinkedIn, qualify leads, and book meetings for the sales team. You will also use AI tools as a core part of your daily workflow to research accounts, personalize outreach, and move faster than a traditional SDR.

This is a high-activity, execution-driven role with a clear playbook and defined metrics. If you are a confident communicator with strong English skills, know how to run a structured outbound motion, and use AI to work smarter rather than harder, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

What You'll Work On

Outbound Prospecting and Cold Outreach

  • Write clear, personalized cold outreach that generates responses without reading as spam
  • Handle objections confidently and keep conversations moving toward a booked meeting

Lead Qualification and Pipeline Management

  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads against defined ICP criteria
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all outreach and pipeline activity in the CRM
  • Track activity volume, response rates, and meeting conversion metrics consistently

AI-Enabled Outreach

  • Use AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT daily to research accounts, draft personalized messaging, and improve outreach efficiency

Meeting Booking and Handoff

  • Book qualified meetings for the sales team with full context and qualification notes

What You Bring

  • Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT as a daily part of your workflow for research, drafting, and outreach personalization

  • Confident phone presence with the ability to handle objections and rejection without losing momentum
  • Self-directed and disciplined with the ability to hit daily activity targets independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with defined metrics and clear expectations

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling into SMB markets including verticals such as HVAC, dental, restaurants, or similar
  • Familiarity with sales intelligence or data enrichment platforms
  • Experience with sales engagement platforms such as Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar
  • Background in B2B SaaS or GTM-adjacent roles

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your outbound sales experience, and walking through how you use AI tools to research a prospect and personalize your outreach before a call

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a confident communicator, know how to run a structured outbound motion, and use AI to move faster and work smarter, this role gives you the activity and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

EHS Support is a specialty environmental consulting firm that provides solutions to complex environmental, health, and safety challenges across a range of market sectors and industries. With experts located throughout the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, and South Africa, we form long-lasting partnerships with our clients through a culture of excellence, innovation, work ethic, and integrity. We focus on hiring and retaining talented, motivated people who enjoy collaborating with and delivering value to our clients. Our team does more than identify problems— we provide solutions.

Job Overview

This Project Scientist – Human Health Risk Assessor opportunity is for a flexible and self-motivated individual that is willing to learn and grow as part of a team while providing human health risk assessment expertise to projects at EHS Support. As a Project Scientist – Human Health Risk Assessor on the Sediment and Risk Assessment (SRA) service line, you will be joining a high-performance team of risk assessors, toxicologists, ecologists, scientists, and engineers that is focused on providing high-quality technical and strategic solutions to a variety of clients. Your primary responsibilities in the Project Scientist – Human Health Risk Assessor position will include leading human health risk assessments for routine and complex scenarios under federal, state and international programs. You will also be responsible for managing a team of talented professionals, cultivating client relationships, and providing mentorship to junior staff members.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and implementation of site-specific human health risk assessments conducted as part of remedial investigations, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements under CERCLA, RCRA, state or international regulatory programs.
  • Develop site-specific conceptual exposure models to characterize constituent fate and transport dynamics and identify human health receptors and exposure pathways.
  • Support remedial decision-making based on site conceptualization and project findings to derive remedial goals and assess protectiveness of remedial alternatives.
  • Advocate for technical findings and conclusions of investigations and negotiate with state and federal regulators to select novel solutions to support client needs.
  • Design and implement multimedia and multidisciplinary investigations to support human health risk assessments and vapor intrusion evaluations.
  • Assist in the preparation and review of toxicological profiles developed using USEPA and ATSDR guidance and databases and risk dossiers developed using OECD and REACH guidance and databases compatible with Australian Department of the Environment and Energy (DoEE) requirements.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, advancements, and emerging issues related to your core discipline. Participate in technical conferences or work groups to advance novel approaches and maintain a contemporary approach to consultancy.
  • Oversee multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely and successful completion within budget constraints.
  • Collaborate with clients and project team members in the development of allocation and litigation (both defense and plaintiff) strategies.
  • Support business development initiatives identified by senior leadership, including identification of growth opportunities with existing and new clients.
  • Review and interpret relevant regulations and guidance documents related to human health risk assessments within the U.S., Canada, UK, and Australia.
  • Implement and uphold rigorous quality assurance processes to maintain the highest standards in human health risk assessment methodologies and reporting.
  • Travel as needed, based on client and project needs (e.g., site visits, agency meetings).

Specific Experience and Skills

  • 8 + years of experience in consulting, with a strong track record of successful project outcomes and management.
  • Proven leadership and management skills, with experience in mentoring and developing staff.
  • Experience in business development building strong client relationships.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills.
  • Familiarity with relevant regulatory frameworks and environmental laws.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Education and Licenses

  • Master's or Ph.D. in biology, biochemistry, chemistry, toxicology, ecology, environmental science, or a related field.

Benefits

  • Generous Vacation Policy
  • Health Benefits (medical, dental, vision)
  • 401k w/matching options
  • Short- & Long-Term Disability
  • Life Insurance
  • Sick Time
  • Bonus Opportunities

  • Be open, honest, and direct
  • Assume good intentions
  • Trust coworkers, leadership, and clients
  • Listen to learn
  • Be accountable for our work
  • Foster teamwork
  • Demonstrate integrity
  • Take pride in one’s work
  • Live your personal values
  • Provide a safe and health work environment that promotes wellness
  • Have fun!

At CoVet, we're building AI-powered tools that help veterinary professionals spend less time on paperwork and more time caring for animals.

Veterinary teams are stretched thin. Long hours, administrative burden, and burnout are challenges across the industry. We're on a mission to change that. Our AI copilot helps veterinary professionals save time, improve workflows, and focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional patient care.

We're a globally distributed team united by a shared mission to support veterinary professionals through thoughtful technology. We move quickly, collaborate openly, and believe great ideas can come from anyone.

  • Understanding of security best practices in cloud-based environments.

Why Join Us

  • Competitive compensation
  • Generous vacation and time-off policies

Marketing

Remote (United States)

RightCrowd- Business Development Representative

Comp- $75,000 Base Salary / $25,000 Variable Commission against Performance MBO’s

US Based, Remote/ WFH

 

THE COMPANY

RightCrowd is a dynamic and rapidly expanding company in the Physical Identity and Access Management (PIAM) industry, focused on providing cutting-edge solutions to enhance security and streamline access control processes for a diverse range of clients. As we continue to grow and expand our presence in the market we are seeking a driven and proactive Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our team.

The Business Development Representative (BDR) is responsible for generating qualified pipeline by identifying, engaging, and qualifying prospective customers. This role works closely with marketing and sales to drive new business opportunities and support revenue growth. This is an individual contributor role. The BDR will report to the VP of Marketing.

 

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Identify and research target accounts within defined industries and ICP criteria

  • Execute outbound prospecting campaigns (email, phone, LinkedIn, events)

  • Follow up on inbound marketing leads in a timely and professional manner

  • Book qualified discovery meetings for Account Executives

  • Maintain consistent activity levels to meet pipeline creation targets

  • Provide feedback on messaging effectiveness and lead quality

  • Support Account-Based Marketing (ABM) outreach for priority accounts

  • Update HubSpot (RightCrowd CRM) with daily BDR activity

  • Attend regularly scheduled sales, marketing and technical meetings and trainings

  • Clearly articulate RightCrowd’s value proposition

 

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in business development, sales development, or lead generation (preferably in B2B SaaS or physical security/identity management industry)

  • Track record of success in cold outreach and lead qualification

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills; confident and persuasive in verbal and written communication

  • Resilient and self-motivated with a strong work ethic and desire to grow in sales

  • Experience using CRM tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar

  • Prior experience working collaboratively with sales and marketing teams

 

What We Offer

  • A fast-growing company backed by a strong private equity partner

  • A supportive, remote-first work culture with growth opportunities

  • Competitive base salary + commission

  • Health, dental, vision, and retirement benefits

  • The opportunity to work at the intersection of innovation, security, and technology
