raw.excerpt: EGNYTE YOUR CAREER.  SPARK YOUR PASSION. Egnyte is a place where we spark opportunities for amazing people.
raw.description:
EGNYTE YOUR CAREER. SPARK YOUR PASSION.

Egnyte is a place where we spark opportunities for amazing people. We believe that every role has meaning, and every Egnyter should be respected. With23,000 customers worldwide and growing, you can make an impact by protecting their valuable data. When joining Egnyte, you’re not just landing a new career, you become part of a team of Egnyterswhodoers, thinkers, and collaborators are who embrace and live by our values:

Invested Relationships

Fiscal Prudence

Candid Conversations

ABOUT EGNYTE

Egnyte is the secure multi-cloud platform for content security and governance that enables organizations to better protect and collaborate on their most valuable content. Established in 2008, Egnyte has democratized cloud content security for more than 23,000 organizations, helping customers improve data security, maintain compliance, prevent and detect ransomware threats, and boost employee productivity on any app, any cloud, anywhere. For more information, visit.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our customers trust us to move tens of millions of files and petabytes of data from on-premises file servers, network shares and other cloud storage providers into Egnyte.Thedatahas toarrive intact, withpermissionspreserved, inside tight cut-over windows,oftenfromoffices on several continents atonce.We'relooking for a senior engineer to own the technical direction of our migration platform. Ithas three parts:

  • lightweight agents that run on customer machines and do the copying
  • a cloud control plane that schedules and monitors those agents
  • the cloud-to-cloud migration services that connect us to other storage platforms

You'll set the architecture, take on the hardest reliability and performance problems, andraise the engineering bar across the team.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Own the architectureof the migration agents, control plane and cloud-to-cloud services. Set direction on scaling, fault tolerance and multi-region deployment, and write the design docs others build from.
  • Make large migrations fast and predictable. Improve throughput across long-distance, high-latency links. Tune concurrency, chunking and retries. Make sure a migration with millions of files finishes on schedule.
  • Guarantee data integrity.Design end-to-end checks (checksums, validation passes, reconciliation reports) so customers can prove every file and permission arrived correctly.
  • Build resilience into every layer.Handle throttling, gateway timeouts, flaky customer networks and unstable third-party storage gracefully, with safe retries and no duplicates or data loss.
  • Run it like a production service.Drive observability (structured logs, metrics, alerting) for agents spread across thousands of customer environments. Lead incident investigations and turn post-mortem findings into lasting fixes.
  • Shape how we ship. Improve release safety for software installed on customer machines (staged rollouts, version compatibility, upgrades), and for the control plane on Kubernetes withGitOps.
  • Partneracross functionswith Product, Professional Services and Support to turn real migration problems into roadmap priorities. Be the senior technical voice on escalationsinvolving our largest customers.
  • Multiply the teamthrough design reviews, code reviews, mentoring and clear technical writing.

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 7+ years building production software, including several years owning the design of distributed systems or data-intensive services.
  • Strong in Go, Intermediate in Java (or another systems language such as Python, plus willingness to work mainly in Go).
  • Deep understanding of file systems and storage: SMB/NFS shares, object storage (S3, Azure Blob/Files, GCS), metadata, permissions/ACLs, and why moving files at scale is hard.
  • Hands-on experience making systems reliable over unreliable networks:retries, timeouts, backpressure, rate limiting, idempotency and long-running resumable jobs.
  • Experience running services on Kubernetes in a major cloud (GCP, Azure or AWS), with solid habits around observability and incident response.
  • A track record of leading technical work across teams: writing designs, driving decisions, and delivering complex projects to production.
  • Clear communication with engineers, customers and leadership alike.

Nice to have

  • Experience with large-scale data migration, backup or sync products, or with tools likerclone.
  • Experience shipping software that runs on customer machines (Windows services, installers, auto-update, edge appliances).
  • Experience integrating with cloud content platforms' APIs (SharePoint/OneDrive, Box, Dropbox, Google Drive), including their throttling and pagination.
  • Experience with hybrid-cloud or customer-owned-storage setups.
  • Experience applying AI/LLM tooling to operations: log triage, automated diagnostics, support automation.

BENEFITS

  • Competitive salaries
  • Medical insurance and healthcare benefits for you and your family
  • Fully paid premiums for life insurance
  • Flexible hours and PTO
  • Gym reimbursement
  • Childcare reimbursement
  • Group term life insurance

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

At Egnyte, we celebrate our unique differences and thrive on our diversity for our employees, our products, our customers, our investors, and our communities. Our global Egnyte Employee Communities (EECs) support representation and inclusion across our diverse workplace. Egnyters are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work and to appreciate the many differences that collectively make Egnyte a higher-performing company and a great place to be.

Any employees with questions or concerns about equal employment opportunities in the workplace are encouraged to bring these issues to the attention of . Egnyte will not allow any form of retaliation against employees who raise issues of equal employment opportunity. If employees feel they have been subjected to any such retaliation, they should contact . To ensure the workplace is free of artificial barriers, violation of this policy including any improper retaliatory conduct will lead to discipline, up to and including discharge. All employees must cooperate with all investigations conducted pursuant to this policy.

raw.description:
Open to any location - Working EST timezone

We're the all in one agentic marketing platform. AI native from day one. We're not joining a category, we're defining it.

We're looking for someone who will own paid acquisition on Meta and Google, and run it with AI agents doing real work. If you want real ownership, move fast, and raise the bar every week, keep reading. If "set it and forget it" is your bidding strategy, this isn't the role.

What you'll own

  • Paid acquisition on Meta and Google against a trial CPA target. Structure, bidding, budgets and pacing, all within monthly caps.

  • Agent workflows that check performance daily, move budget from losing campaigns to winners, and cross check reporting across models. Plus the visual map of how it all runs.

  • What runs and where budget goes. You turn performance data into briefs for our creative strategists, who build the ads.

  • Paid landing pages and funnel CRO with design and dev. Every lander matches its ad, and every test moves CPA.

  • Tracking we can trust from first click to activation, and unit economics (CAC, payback, LTV) that new products launch on.

  • Launching ads for new products with zero history, across self serve and sales led funnels.

About half your week is media buying and analytics. The rest is split between building agents and running landing page tests.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of hands on media buying on Meta and Google, managing $100K+ a month

  • Deep Meta expertise. You know what ads work, how to structure them, and how to scale a winning concept.

  • Agency side experience

  • SaaS or B2B experience with free trial or book a demo funnels

  • You've built your own automation with LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, APIs, scripts, n8n, Zapier or similar) that you use on ads every week, like performance checks, budget moves or reporting. You can explain how it works.

  • Strong with GA4, PostHog, ad platform reporting and spreadsheets

  • A track record of landing page and creative tests that lowered CPA

Nice to have

  • SQL

  • LinkedIn ads

  • Launching sales led or book a demo funnels

  • HubSpot and Stripe

You'll thrive here if...

  • You know what's working, what's broken and what to do about it before anyone asks.

  • You've lived through Meta volatility and know when to touch things and when to leave them alone.

  • You can explain a CPA spike to a founder in one chart.

  • You don't wait to be told what to do. You see the gap and you move.

  • Deadlines don't rattle you. Ambiguity doesn't either.

  • You're an AI power user, not someone who's "open to learning it someday."

  • You have opinions and you're not afraid to bring them.

  • You can laugh at a chaotic week on Friday and mean it.

What working here actually looks like

High expectations. Real ownership. Things change fast and we don't apologize for it. You'll work with smart people who push you, a product that keeps getting better, and a team that's genuinely building something new.

We'll probably give you more to own than you expected. That's on purpose.

We use AI every day, across every function. That's just how we work.

About Search Atlas

We're the all in one agentic marketing platform, AI native from day one. Our tools help marketing teams move faster, make smarter decisions, and do more with less. We're defining a new category and we're looking for people who want to be part of it.

raw.description:
Vālenz® Health is the platform to simplify healthcare – the destination for employers, payers, providers and members to reduce costs, improve quality, and elevate the healthcare experience. The Valenz mindset and culture of innovation combine to create a distinctly different approach to an inefficient, uninspired health system. With fully integrated solutions, Valenz engages early and often to execute across the entire patient journey – from care navigation and management to payment integrity, plan performance and provider verification. With a 99% client retention rate, we elevate expectations to a new level of efficiency, effectiveness and transparency where smarter, better, faster healthcare is possible.

About Our Opportunity
As the VP Sales - TPA Markets (aka VP, TPA Markets), you will be responsible for driving new business growth by developing strategic relationships with third-party administrators (TPAs). You'll develop territory strategies, cultivate new opportunities, and position the Valenz Health platform as a differentiated solution that helps TPAs deliver greater value to their clients. With your assigned territory, you'll be responsible for meeting or exceeding revenue goals while expanding our presence across the TPA marketplace.

To be successful in this role, you'll bring experience selling healthcare, health benefits, or closely related solutions to TPAs and other organizations supporting self-funded employers. You understand the operational and strategic needs of TPAs and have experience building relationships that drive long-term growth.

Things You’ll Do Here:

  • Develop and execute a strategic territory plan to grow Valenz Health's presence within the TPA marketplace.
  • Build and strengthen relationships with executive leaders and key decision-makers at regional and national TPAs.
  • Drive a consultative sales process from prospecting through close by identifying client needs, presenting tailored solutions, negotiating agreements, and achieving or exceeding revenue goals.
  • Position the Valenz Health platform as a strategic solution that enables TPAs to better serve their clients through improved cost management, quality, and member outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing TPA partnerships while developing new relationships with regional and national third-party administrators.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the Valenz Health platform and clearly articulate our value proposition, competitive differentiators, and business impact.
  • Represent Valenz Health at industry conferences, association meetings, and networking events to strengthen market presence and generate new partnership opportunities.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Client Success, Operations, and executive leadership to develop winning strategies and support successful partner implementations.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline activity, forecasting, and opportunity management within the CRM while providing regular updates on territory performance and market insights.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential duties.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:
  • 5+ years of enterprise sales or business development experience selling healthcare, employer benefits, or closely related solutions within the self-funded healthcare market.
  • Demonstrated success developing relationships with regional and national third-party administrators and an understanding of the TPA sales landscape.
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales goals while managing complex, consultative sales cycles.
  • Strong understanding of third-party administration, self-funded employer health plans, and the operational challenges facing TPAs.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and executive relationship-building skills.
  • Highly self-motivated with the ability to independently manage a territory, prioritize opportunities, and drive results.
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.

Where You’ll Work:This is a fully remote position outside of the travel requirements, and we’ll provide all the necessary equipment!
  • Travel: Up to 50% to meet with prospective clients, partners, and industry organizations.
  • Work Environment: You’ll need a quiet workspace that is free from distractions.
  • Technology: Reliable internet connection—if you can use streaming services, you’re good to go!
  • Security: Adherence to company security protocols, including the use of VPNs, secure passwords, and company-approved devices/software.
  • Location: You must be US based, in a location where you can work effectively and comply with company policies such as HIPAA.

Why You'll Love Working Here

Valenz is proud to be recognized by Inc. 5000 as one of America’s fastest-growing private companies. Our team is committed to delivering on our promise to engage early and often for smarter, better, faster healthcare.With this commitment, you’ll find an engaged culture – one that stands strong, vigorous, and healthy in all we do.

Benefits

  • Generously subsidized company-sponsored Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance, with access to services through our own products, Healthcare Blue Book and KISx Card.
  • Spending account options: HSA, FSA, and DCFSA
  • 401K with company match and immediate vesting
  • Flexible working environment
  • Generous Paid Time Off to include vacation, sick leave, and paid holidays
  • Employee Assistance Program that includes professional counseling, referrals, and additional services
  • Paid maternity and paternity leave
  • Pet insurance
  • Employee discounts on phone plans, car rentals and computers
  • Community giveback opportunities, including paid time off for philanthropic endeavors

At Valenz, we celebrate, support, and thrive on inclusion, for the benefit of our associates, our partners, and our products. Valenz is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all associates and to providing associates with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Valenz are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social, or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.

SRA's mission is to level up every day to protect our clients and their customers. This begins with our team members and their experience. SRA prides itself on maintaining a culture where team members have a shared sense of support and belonging, consistent with our It's Personal company value. At SRA, we prioritize transparent career pathing, varied DEI programming and community groups, competitive benefits including mental health support, and an emphasis on a sustainable, healthy, and engaging work culture. SRA has twice been named a Best Place to Work by the Philadelphia Business Journal.

These Essential Functions, Requirements, and Skills are guidelines. If you are a candidate who does not meet this exact job description but can demonstrate excellent organization, attention to detail, professionalism, flexibility, and self-direction in your professional background, we hope you apply. SRA values a diverse workplace and strongly encourages women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, and veterans to apply.

Summary/Objective

The DevOps Engineer III will collaborate with SRA's teams across our entire product portfolio to enhance our consulting practice by building and deploying tools and infrastructure that serve our employees and our clients.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Maintain and deploy infrastructure across SRA's diverse product portfolio (VECTR, XDR, and others) across cloud environments (AWS, Azure) and on-premises servers using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform).
  • Assist Software Development team in defining best practices for operations and infrastructure to support internally developed tools and services.
  • Implement and maintain Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) tooling and pipelines using Azure DevOps (ADO) and GitLab, with fluency in both systems and ability to transition between them.
  • Design and manage build automation and dependency management using modern build systems (Moon, Maven, Lage, or equivalent) across multiple projects and technology stacks.

Supervisory Responsibility

N/A

Work Environment

This job operates in a professional office environment [or remotely as needed/required]. This role routinely uses standard office equipment.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee frequently is required to stand and walk. This is a largely sedentary role.

Candidates with disabilities are encouraged to apply and email with any questions. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable disabled individuals to perform the essential functions of this role.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position and hours of work and days are Monday through Friday 8:30am to 5pm. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

Travel

N/A

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

EEO Statement

Security Risk Advisors is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination or harassment of any kind. All employment decisions at SRA are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, disability, marital or family status, veteran status, medical condition, or any similar category protected under federal, state, or local laws.

Requirements

Required Education and Experience

  • Punctuality and timely attendance to external client and internal stakeholder needs.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent subject matter or experience.
  • 5+ years previous professional operations or DevOps experience working with cloud or virtualized installations of custom software.
  • Strong proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code, specifically Terraform.
  • Daily hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms; proficiency in both Azure DevOps (ADO) and GitLab with ability to work effectively in either environment.
  • Scripting and programming experience in Python.
  • Comfortable working with modern build systems and dependency management (Moon, Maven, Lage, or similar).
  • Knowledge and comfort using and administrating Linux.
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail.
  • Flexibility to accommodate changing schedules of client and project needs.
  • Willingness to work extended hours to meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and articulate progress of projects to management.
  • Experience patching production systems and monitoring dependencies for security vulnerabilities.

Preferred Qualifications and Experience

  • Residence in Eastern time zone preferred.
  • Experience with TypeScript.
  • Ability to lead cross-team infrastructure implementation projects and delegate tasks to junior team members.

Benefits

Work with Experts: Robust internal training program, plus Company-paid external training. SRA recognizes the value of professional development for employees. Therefore, we encourage our employees to pursue continuing education and role-specific training. Every SRA employee is eligible to attend one training per year paid for by SRA.

Mental Health Services: SRA has partnered with BetterHelp to provide SRA employees with free mental health support. BetterHelp connects individuals with licensed therapists for chat, video, and phone sessions.

Medical / Dental / Other (regular full-time employees only)

  • Possibility to work remotely or with a flexible schedule when needed and approved.

  • Other discounted, employee-paid benefits including pet insurance, legal support, and voluntary life insurance.

Full-Stack Software Engineer – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Full-Stack Software Engineer to design, build, and maintain modern web applications across frontend and backend systems.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone comfortable working across the full development lifecycle — from building user-facing applications and backend services to designing APIs, working with databases, troubleshooting production issues, and supporting cloud deployments.

You’ll collaborate with product, design, and engineering stakeholders while using modern development practices and AI-assisted engineering tools to ship reliable, scalable software.

What You’ll Own

Full-Stack Application Development

  • Develop and maintain frontend and backend applications
  • Build scalable, reliable, and maintainable application features
  • Translate product and technical requirements into working software
  • Write clean, well-structured, and reusable code
  • Improve existing applications as requirements evolve

Frontend Development

  • Build responsive and user-friendly web interfaces
  • Work with modern frontend frameworks and component-based architectures
  • Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and services
  • Troubleshoot frontend performance and functionality issues
  • Collaborate with product and design stakeholders on implementation

Backend, APIs & Integrations

  • Develop and maintain backend services and application logic
  • Build APIs and integrations with third-party systems
  • Design reliable data flows between applications and external platforms
  • Troubleshoot integration and backend issues
  • Ensure systems remain scalable and maintainable

Databases & Data Models

  • Design and work with application databases and data models
  • Work with SQL and/or NoSQL databases
  • Maintain data integrity and application reliability
  • Support database queries, application logic, and performance improvements

Testing, Debugging & Code Quality

  • Troubleshoot bugs and production issues
  • Implement testing and development best practices
  • Participate in technical planning and code reviews
  • Improve application reliability and maintainability
  • Help identify technical issues before they affect users

Cloud, Deployment & Development Workflows

  • Work with cloud infrastructure and deployment workflows
  • Support application releases and production deployments
  • Use Git and version-control best practices
  • Contribute to reliable development and deployment processes

AI-Assisted Software Development

  • Use modern AI development tools to improve engineering productivity
  • Apply AI-assisted workflows to coding, debugging, research, and development
  • Evaluate new AI development capabilities where they can improve execution
  • Maintain strong engineering judgment while using AI-assisted tools

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional software development experience
  • Strong experience with at least one modern frontend framework
  • Backend development experience using a modern programming language and/or framework
  • Experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases
  • Hands-on experience building or integrating APIs
  • Strong Git and version-control experience
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and deployment workflows
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and scalable code
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Professional working English
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools
  • Experience building production-grade full-stack applications
  • Experience with third-party API integrations
  • Familiarity with automated testing and CI/CD workflows
  • Experience working with cloud-native applications
  • Experience collaborating directly with product and design teams

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Enjoy building across both frontend and backend systems
  • Take ownership of features from development through deployment
  • Write code with scalability and maintainability in mind
  • Can independently troubleshoot technical problems
  • Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Are comfortable learning new technologies quickly
  • Use AI development tools thoughtfully to improve speed and productivity

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include developing frontend features, building backend services, integrating APIs, working with databases, reviewing code, and troubleshooting application issues.

You may also participate in technical planning, collaborate with product and design stakeholders, support deployments, and use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding and problem-solving.

In short: you build, improve, and maintain reliable web applications across the full technology stack.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Consistent delivery of reliable application features
  • Clean, maintainable, and scalable code
  • Stable frontend and backend systems
  • Reliable API and third-party integrations
  • Effective debugging and resolution of production issues
  • Strong code quality and testing practices
  • Smooth deployments and development workflows
  • Effective collaboration across product and engineering teams

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Technical / Engineering Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Full-Stack Software Engineer with hands-on experience across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and modern development workflows, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build scalable, reliable modern software products.

raw.description:
About the Company

Omilia is a leader in Conversational AI. Our cloud platform powers natural, human like customer conversations over voice and chat for some of the largest enterprises in banking, insurance, telecommunications and hospitality, handling hundreds of millions of interactions a year. We build our own deep tech across the stack, from speech recognition and natural language understanding to dialog management, and we integrate natively with the major CCaaS platforms. We are a company of roughly 500 people, distributed across Europe and North America, in the middle of an ambitious platform modernization program: Kubernetes everywhere, autoscaling for every service, a next generation observability stack, and AI woven through our own engineering lifecycle.


Role Purpose

The Solution Consultant a senior individual contributor who serves as the primary technical authority in Account Executive-led sales cycles within an assigned region or global segment. The role bridges commercial and technical disciplines — owning the pre-sales technical motion from discovery through to proof of concept and proposal, while acting as a trusted advisor to strategic prospects and customers within an assigned region or global segment. Operating in close partnership with Account Executives and Account Managers, the SC is accountable for technical win rates, solution quality, and the integrity of commitments made to customers before contract signature.

Accountabilities

  • Own the technical pre-sales motion for certain new-logo deals within the assigned region or global segment — from initial discovery and architecture assessment through solution design, proof of concept, High Level Effort Estimate, RFP/RFI response, and technical close.
  • Serve as the definitive technical authority on Omilia's platform for certain deals within the assigned region or global segment — ensuring that all solution proposals are architecturally sound, technically deliverable, and accurately scoped before commercial commitments are made.
  • Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with technical decision-makers and enterprise architects at strategic prospect and customer organisations, positioning Omilia as the platform of choice for contact centre AI transformation.
  • Drive technical win rates across the assigned region or global segment by developing and executing differentiated solution narratives that directly address each prospect's environment, constraints, and automation objectives.
  • Collaborate with Demo Engineers within the assigned region or Global Segment to ensure all solution narratives are substantiated by impactful demos
  • Ensure the integrity of RFP and RFI responses for certain opportunities within the assigned region or global segment — owning the technical sections end-to-end and coordinating cross-functional input from Product, Engineering, Security, and Professional Services.
  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of the competitive landscape — including legacy IVR platforms and emerging conversational AI vendors

Key Responsibilities

Technical Discovery and Solution Design

  • Lead structured technical discovery engagements with certain deals within the assigned segment or region — mapping current-state technical architecture, identifying automation gaps, quantifying business impact, and designing Omilia-based solutions that address the customer's specific environment, integration landscape, and regulatory constraints.
  • Conduct in-depth architecture assessments covering telephony infrastructure, CRM and backend system integrations, data flows, security and compliance requirements, and channel strategy — producing a technically grounded solution design that forms the basis for scoping, pricing, and contractual commitments.
  • Develop tailored solution proposals and technical response documents that map Omilia's platform capabilities (OCP, miniApps, Pathfinder, CoPilot, TalkGuard, OptimizeIQ) to each prospect's identified use cases, business outcomes, and technical environment.

Product Demonstrations and Proof of Concept

  • Collaborate with Demo Engineers to design, configure, and deliver highly customised product demonstrations and proof-of-concept (POC) engagements for strategic accounts — moving beyond standard demo scripts to build scenario-specific flows that reflect the prospect's actual customer interactions, industry context, and business language.
  • Own the full POC lifecycle for certain deals within the assigned segment or region — defining success criteria in alignment with the prospect and Account Executive, coordinating internal resources (Professional Services, Engineering) for POC delivery, and presenting results with a clear ROI and deployment readiness narrative.
  • Master the Omilia demo suite across the full product portfolio and maintain demo environments that reflect current platform capabilities, recent product releases, and the most common use cases across verticals (banking, insurance, healthcare, utilities, telecommunications).

RFP and RFI Management

  • Own the technical response to RFPs and RFIs for certain deals within the assigned segment or region — writing and structuring all technical sections, coordinating input from Security, Compliance, Product, and Engineering, and ensuring that responses accurately represent Omilia's capabilities and delivery commitments.
  • Critically evaluate the technical sustainability and delivery risk of each strategic sales opportunities prior to commercial commitment — flagging architectural mismatches, integration complexity, unsupported requirements, or resourcing risks to Sales and Professional Services leadership.
  • Maintain a library of reusable RFP response content, technical answer repositories, and solution templates for use cases common to the assigned region or global segment — continuously updating these assets as the platform evolves.

Technical Advisory and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the sales cycle — engaging IT architects, platform owners, security teams, and C-level technology stakeholders with credibility and depth, addressing objections with evidence-based responses and forward-looking platform context.
  • Proactively identify and address technical objections, integration concerns, and compliance questions early in the sales cycle — building the technical confidence and internal sponsorship necessary to accelerate deal progression and reduce late-stage risk.
  • Conduct technical benefits assessments that quantify the value of Omilia's platform in terms directly relevant to the prospect's business — call deflection rates, AHT reduction, CSAT improvement, agent cost savings, and compliance risk mitigation.

Competitive Positioning

  • Maintain current, detailed knowledge of competing platforms across IVR, CCaaS, and conversational AI categories — including Nuance/Microsoft, Google CCAI, Amazon Connect, Genesys, Avaya, Five9, and NICE inContact — and develop technically rigorous competitive battle cards and displacement strategies Participate in competitive bake-offs and technical evaluations, positioning Omilia's architectural advantages, NLU accuracy, enterprise-grade security posture, and deployment flexibility against incumbent and emerging alternatives.

Cross-functional Collaboration and Internal Contribution

  • Work in close alignment with Account Executives and Account Managers on strategic accounts — providing technical qualification, deal strategy input, and stakeholder mapping support throughout the sales cycle.
  • Collaborate with Professional Services during the transition from pre-sales to delivery — ensuring that technical commitments, integration requirements, and POC outcomes are fully documented and handed over with sufficient context for successful implementation.
  • Maintain accurate records of technical engagement activity, POC status, RFP pipelines, and solution configurations in Salesforce and internal knowledge systems.

Travel

  • Travel whithin Latin America (and occasionally to Omilia offices or customer sites internationally) up to 30% of the time to support prospect meetings, POC delivery, and key account engagements.

Requirements

Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Required:

  • Minimum 6 years of experience in a pre-sales solutions consulting, sales engineering, or technical advisory role within enterprise SaaS, CCaaS, conversational AI, or contact centre technology.
  • Demonstrated track record of owning the technical pre-sales motion for complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals — including discovery, solution design, POC delivery, and RFP response — with verifiable contribution to technical win rates.
  • Deep technical knowledge of contact centre architecture and integration patterns — including telephony (SIP, PSTN, WebRTC), CRM integrations (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics), omnichannel platforms, and enterprise middleware.
  • Strong working knowledge of conversational AI concepts and technologies — NLU, dialogue management, ASR/TTS, intent classification, entity extraction, and voice biometrics — sufficient to engage credibly with customer platform architects and data science teams.
  • Proficiency in designing and delivering customised product demonstrations and POC environments that map directly to prospect business requirements and industry context.
  • Technical writing proficiency — able to produce clear, accurate, and commercially compelling responses to enterprise RFPs and RFIs, including security questionnaires, integration specifications, and compliance documentation.
  • Strong understanding of the enterprise IT landscape within regulated verticals — banking (OCC, FFIEC), healthcare (HIPAA, HL7/FHIR), insurance, and utilities — including security architecture, data governance requirements, and vendor evaluation processes.
  • Excellent verbal communication and presentation skills — able to engage a CTO or enterprise architect with technical depth while simultaneously communicating business value to a CFO or COO.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce CRM and standard pre-sales tooling (demo environments, solution configurators, proposal management platforms).
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 30% of the time within Latin America and internationally.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.

Nice to have:

  • Direct hands-on experience with Omilia's platform: OCP, miniApps, Pathfinder, CoPilot, TalkGuard, or OptimizeIQ — or with directly competing platforms (Nuance Mix, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex, Rasa).
  • Experience in a solutions consulting or SE role at a high-growth SaaS company scaling through Series C and beyond — familiarity with building pre-sales practice infrastructure (playbooks, demo environments, RFP libraries) in parallel with active deal execution.
  • Knowledge of US data privacy, AI governance, and voice data regulations relevant to enterprise deployments — CCPA, HIPAA, Illinois BIPA, and emerging federal AI frameworks.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and their native contact centre or AI/ML services — relevant for positioning Omilia's deployment flexibility and integration patterns.
  • Experience participating in Gartner Magic Quadrant or Forrester Wave evaluation processes, or supporting analyst briefings and customer reference programmes.
  • Scripting or development experience (Python, JavaScript, REST APIs) sufficient to build lightweight POC integrations or customise demo environments without full engineering support.
  • Relevant certifications in cloud platforms, contact centre technologies, or AI/ML (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Google Professional Cloud Architect, CCNA Collaboration).

Omilia Note

- Contribute actively and effectively as an integrated team member.
- Act as an Omilia ambassador in all interactions.

Benefits

  • Fixed compensation;
  • Long-term employment with the working days vacation;
  • Development in professional growth (courses, training, etc);
  • Being part of successful cutting-edge technology products that are making a global impact in the service industry;
  • Proficient and fun-to-work-with colleagues;
  • Apple gear.

Omilia is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that embracing diversity in all its forms enriches our workplace and drives our collective success. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels welcomed, valued, and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives without regard to factors such as race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, heredity, disability, age, or veteran status, all eligible candidates will be given consideration for employment.

raw.description:
Fuse Energy is a forward-thinking renewable energy startup on a mission to deliver a terawatt of renewable energy - fast. We're combining first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system. We raised $210M from top-tier investors including Multicoin, Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, Box Group and strategic angels like Nico Rosberg, the Co-Founder of Solana and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify, Uber and more.

We’re creating a fully integrated energy company: from developing solar, wind and hydrogen projects to real-time power trading and distributed energy installations. By selling directly to consumers, we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass on savings to customers.

But we’re not stopping there. We’re also building the Energy Network: a decentralised platform of smart devices to electrify our homes, shifting usage to off-peak hours and helping balance the grid. This network strengthens grid stability - a critical foundation for scaling AI data centers and other energy-intensive industries.

We’re looking for an Embedded Software Engineer in the US to help design, build, and scale the connected hardware powering the Energy Network. This is a hands-on role spanning embedded systems, networking, device security, and fleet connectivity from prototype through to deployment. You’ll contribute to building resilient connectivity, secure provisioning, and robust telemetry across a growing fleet of distributed energy devices.

You’ll play an important role in shaping how our devices connect, communicate, and evolve securely at scale, working closely with firmware, hardware, and backend teams to deliver production-ready systems.

Responsibilities:

Connectivity & Networking

  • Develop and maintain connectivity across Ethernet, Wi-Fi, Thread, Zigbee, and BLE.
  • Build and optimise secure, reliable device messaging using protocols such as MQTT, CoAP, HTTP, or WebSockets.
  • Support reliable device time synchronisation using NTP or PTP.

Device Security & OTA Management

  • Contribute to secure boot flows, key and certificate provisioning, and hardware-backed device identity using TPMs or secure elements.
  • Help build and maintain signed firmware update pipelines, including OTA update and rollback mechanisms.
  • Support security best practices across the device lifecycle, including vulnerability management and secure provisioning.

Edge & Cloud Integration

  • Integrate devices with cloud IoT platforms and backend services.
  • Define and improve telemetry, health monitoring, and observability for deployed devices.
  • Support reliable operation of connected devices in the field, including debugging fleet issues and improving resilience.

Compliance & Testing

  • Support testing and validation for safety, EMC, radio, and related product requirements.
  • Help prepare test plans, certification artefacts, and validation documentation.
  • Work with manufacturing and cross-functional teams through engineering and production validation cycles.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with firmware, hardware, power electronics, mechanical, and software teams to deliver production-ready devices.
  • Contribute to design reviews, technical documentation, and interface specifications.
  • Share knowledge and contribute to engineering best practices across connectivity, embedded systems, and device security.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of experience building connected embedded products, or strong relevant industry/project experience.
  • Good proficiency in C/C++ for embedded systems, with experience working with RTOS environments such as Zephyr or FreeRTOS.
  • Experience with Python for testing, tooling, or automation.
  • Solid understanding of device connectivity and networking fundamentals, including IP networking and common transport/application protocols.
  • Experience implementing or supporting secure device communications using TLS, certificates, or device provisioning workflows.
  • Familiarity with firmware update systems, bootloaders, or CI/CD workflows for embedded software.
  • Practical debugging experience using lab and software tools such as logic analysers, protocol analysers, network sniffers, or observability platforms.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work across hardware and software boundaries.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with low-power wireless technologies such as Thread, Zigbee, or BLE.
  • Familiarity with cloud IoT services on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Exposure to secure boot, TPMs, secure elements, or hardware attestation.
  • Experience with EMC/RF testing, antenna bring-up, or factory test processes.
  • Awareness of relevant cybersecurity or privacy standards such as IEC 62443, ETSI EN 303 645, ISO 27001, or GDPR.
  • Experience working on industrial, energy, or other distributed device deployments.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and an equity sign-on bonus
  • Biannual bonus scheme
  • Fully expensed tech to match your needs

raw.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and technically skilled BESS Fire Protection Engineer I to join an industry-leading team focused on clean energy technology solutions. This specialized role bridges the gap between complex regulatory codes and actionable product requirements. The successful candidate will drive informed business and technical decisions regarding safety across product lines, field deployments, and operational risk mitigation strategies.

Position Status: Full-Time, Salaried (Exempt), base and bonus

Work Location: 100% Fully Remote

Travel Requirements: Up to 40% travel required within the Americas region

Key Responsibilities

  • Code Translation: Collaborate with multi-disciplinary stakeholders to interpret complex local and international fire code regulations, converting them into precise, actionable technical product requirements or permitting solutions.
  • Compliance Matrixes: Design, implement, and maintain exhaustive code compliance matrixes to extract and track definitive regulatory criteria across distinct deployment areas.
  • Deficiency Resolution: Proactively identify regulatory compliance gaps or unique local jurisdictional (AHJ) variances, developing robust technical workarounds and engineering solutions.
  • Risk Mitigation & Testing: Support operational aspects of corporate fire safety initiatives, validating safety parameters by defining how systems are modeled, configured, and full-scale tested for deflagration and fire propagation potentials.
  • Reporting & Visibility: Synthesize complex test data and compliance profiles into clean, visual dashboards and executive reports (using Word, Excel, PowerPoint) to drive data-backed storytelling for regional leadership.
  • First Responder Education: Develop, update, and actively conduct specialized training frameworks to prepare internal teams, client representatives, and regional Fire Departments on proper emergency/first-responder protocols during thermal events.
  • Technical Issue Management: Directly participate in technical issue resolution pipelines, streamlining communications to uncover root causes and quickly finalize systemic engineering adjustments.
  • Industry Leadership: Keep a continuous pulse on shifting global codes, codes-committee rulings, and energy storage safety benchmarks to consistently advance the baseline safety of regional product deployments.

Requirements

Strict Candidate Screening Criteria

Mandatory BESS Experience: Candidates MUST possess between two (2) and five (5) years of dedicated, direct professional experience in Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) Fire Protection Engineering.

Strict Exclusion: This position is centered entirely on clean energy tech, deflagration, and thermal runaway mitigation. Candidates whose background is limited primarily or solely to traditional commercial building fire sprinkler/suppression systems design will not be entertained or considered.

Technical Standards & Core Competencies

Regulatory Familiarity: Demonstrated knowledge of, or direct testing/certification exposure to, UL 9540, UL 9540A, and UL 1973 protocols.

NFPA Competency: Practical structural application of NFPA Standards 855 (Energy Storage Systems), 68 (Deflagration Venting), 69 (Explosion Prevention), 70 (NEC), 72 (National Fire Alarm Code), 110, and 111.

Core Engineering Design: Proven experience drafting core fire compliance documentation, engineering briefs, and running Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) fire or plume modeling simulations.

Analytical Problem Solving: Highly adept at isolating anomalies within complex data models and translating dense engineering restrictions into direct operational workflows.

Continuous Learning: A proactive curiosity and proven ability to rapidly master emerging software platforms, technical modeling tools, and evolving BESS criteria.

Required Qualifications

Formal Education: Minimum of an Undergraduate or Master's degree in Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent technical field with verified engineering experience.

Execution & Ownership: A relentless focus on execution characterized by deep personal ownership, independent execution capabilities, and a collaborative, forward-thinking mindset.

Communication Savvy: Outstanding public presentation and relationship-building skills, with a track record of driving cross-functional alignment and clearly conveying complex hazards to non-technical audiences.

raw.description:
Data Analyst / Data Engineer – SQL, BI & Data Analytics | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Data Analyst / Data Engineer to transform business data into reliable reporting, actionable insights, and scalable data systems.

Depending on your experience, this role may lean toward data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or a combination of these areas.

You’ll work with SQL, dashboards, reporting tools, databases, and data pipelines to help teams better understand performance and make informed business decisions.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to explain data clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

What You’ll Own

Data Analysis & Business Insights

  • Collect, clean, organize, and analyze business data
  • Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and performance drivers
  • Translate raw data into meaningful business insights
  • Investigate data questions and provide evidence-based recommendations
  • Support stakeholders with ad hoc analysis and recurring reporting needs

SQL & Data Management

  • Write, maintain, and optimize SQL queries
  • Extract and combine data from multiple sources
  • Work with relational databases and structured datasets
  • Validate datasets for completeness and accuracy
  • Troubleshoot inconsistencies across reporting and source systems

Dashboards & Business Intelligence

  • Develop and maintain dashboards using tools such as:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
    • Similar BI platforms
  • Build recurring reports for business stakeholders
  • Create clear visualizations that make complex information easier to understand
  • Maintain consistent definitions and reporting logic across dashboards

Data Pipelines & Integrations

  • Build or maintain data pipelines and integrations
  • Help connect business systems and reporting environments
  • Support reliable movement of data between platforms
  • Troubleshoot pipeline and integration issues
  • Improve the scalability and reliability of data workflows

Reporting Automation

  • Automate recurring reporting and data preparation processes
  • Reduce manual spreadsheet and reporting work
  • Build repeatable workflows for common reporting requirements
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency
  • Help ensure stakeholders have timely access to reliable information

Data Quality & Reliability

  • Monitor and improve data accuracy
  • Identify missing, duplicated, or inconsistent information
  • Validate reporting outputs against source data
  • Improve processes that support reliable reporting
  • Maintain organized documentation around reporting and data workflows

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements
  • Translate business questions into analytical requirements
  • Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Explain trends, metrics, and recommendations in practical business terms
  • Collaborate across teams to improve data accessibility and reporting

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or a related role
  • Strong hands-on SQL skills
  • Experience with Excel and/or Google Sheets
  • Experience using at least one BI or visualization platform such as:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
    • Similar tools
  • Familiarity with databases and data warehouses
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to identify patterns and insights within complex datasets
  • Strong attention to data accuracy and reporting reliability
  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Professional working English
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Python for data analysis or automation
  • Experience building or maintaining data pipelines
  • Experience integrating data from multiple systems
  • Familiarity with cloud-based databases or data warehouses
  • Experience automating recurring reporting workflows
  • Experience with data modeling and reporting architecture
  • Experience supporting business intelligence or executive reporting

Tools & Technologies

SQL | Excel | Google Sheets | Power BI | Tableau | Looker | Python | Databases | Data Warehouses | Data Pipelines | BI & Reporting Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Enjoy turning messy data into clear, reliable information
  • Are comfortable working deeply with SQL and datasets
  • Question inconsistencies instead of accepting numbers at face value
  • Can move between technical analysis and business conversations
  • Look for opportunities to automate repetitive reporting
  • Care about data accuracy and reporting reliability
  • Can explain complex findings in simple, actionable terms
  • Take ownership of analytical problems from question through insight

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include writing SQL queries, cleaning datasets, updating dashboards, investigating business trends, or automating a recurring report.

Depending on the project, you may also maintain data pipelines, troubleshoot reporting inconsistencies, work with stakeholders to define new metrics, or present findings to business leaders.

In short: you turn company data into reliable reporting, useful insights, and better business decisions.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accuracy and reliability of reporting
  • Quality and usability of dashboards
  • Timely delivery of recurring reports and analysis
  • SQL query and reporting efficiency
  • Reduction in manual reporting processes
  • Reliability of data pipelines and integrations
  • Improvement in overall data quality
  • Stakeholder confidence in reporting and insights

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Data / Technical Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have experience with SQL, data analytics, business intelligence, dashboards, reporting, or data engineering and enjoy turning complex data into clear business insights, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build reliable data systems that support smarter business decisions.

Unlike an outsourcing agency, we place you directly with a client where you’re hired in-house as a valued member of their team. This means you work closely with internal teams, contribute to meaningful projects, and have real opportunities for career growth.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Job Summary

We are hiring a Go-To-Market (GTM) Engineer to design, build, and optimize the systems that power outbound sales, lead generation, and revenue operations. This is a highly technical, revenue-facing role that sits at the intersection of sales, marketing, and engineering.

You will be responsible for implementing scalable GTM infrastructure, automating workflows, integrating tools, and enabling sales teams to operate more efficiently. This role is ideal for someone with strong experience in CRM systems, sales automation tools, APIs, and data workflows.

  • Design and optimize automated outbound sales workflows and sequences
  • Integrate tools such as CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot), enrichment tools, and outreach platforms

  • Manage and maintain data integrity across systems

Requirements

  • 2–5+ years of experience in a GTM Engineering, RevOps, or Sales Operations role

  • Proficiency in automation tools (e.g., Zapier, Make, Clay, Outreach, Apollo)

raw.description:
Recruiting Coordinator / Sourcing Specialist

Do you enjoy finding great people and building strong candidate pipelines? Do you care deeply about details, organization, and doing high-quality work behind the scenes? Are you driven and ambitious—motivated by thoughtful problem-solving, strong follow-through, and being part of a team that values recruiting the right way?

If that sounds like you, we want to know you.

About Pax Recruiting Pax Recruiting is a boutique, high-touch recruiting firm based in Austin, Texas. We partner closely with organizations across industries to help them build exceptional teams. Our approach is thoughtful, relational, and quality-first. We care deeply about people, long-term fit, and doing this work with integrity.

We’re building Pax—not as a high-volume recruiting factory, but as a trusted talent partner. This role is foundational to that vision.

The Role We’re looking for a detail-oriented, proactive Recruiting Coordinator / Sourcing Specialist to support active searches by owning the front end of sourcing, coordination, and internal operations support. This person will help expand our capacity to identify strong candidates while preserving the high standard and personal touch Pax strives for.

This is not a full-cycle recruiter role. You’ll work closely with the founder and focus on sourcing, research, candidate coordination, and building strong internal systems.

What You’ll Own

Source and research candidates for open roles (LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, ZipRecruiter, and other job platforms, plus creative sourcing methods) Build thoughtful longlists of high-quality, relevant candidate profiles Draft and assemble clean, client-ready candidate profiles and summaries Support outbound outreach campaigns (sending messages, follow-ups, tracking responses) Own candidate logistics: scheduling interviews, coordinating availability, managing communication flow Maintain organized pipelines and candidate records (statuses, notes, next steps) Help build and improve internal systems, documentation, templates, and workflows as Pax grows Flag strong candidates for deeper review Keep searches moving forward with consistency, follow-through, and attention to detail

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

Prior experience in recruiting, sourcing, or talent research (agency or in-house is great) Strong written English and professional communication skills Comfortable using LinkedIn Recruiter and willing to learn / use other job platforms like Indeed, ZipRecruiter, and similar tools Highly organized with strong follow-through Good judgment—you understand what strong talent looks like and don’t just spray and pray Comfortable helping shape what the role looks like over time, iterating on process, and building structure as we go Who You Are You’re a self-starter who takes ownership and doesn’t wait to be told what to do You’re detail-oriented and take pride in producing clean, high-quality work You’re comfortable building the plane while flying it—helping shape what this role looks like over time You’re naturally organized and enjoy creating structure where there isn’t much yet You follow through—if you say you’ll do something, it gets done You’re steady under pressure and can roll with shifting priorities You care about doing recruiting well and want to help build strong organizations and careers You enjoy being part of a small, high-trust team and helping build something that lasts What Success Looks Like You consistently surface strong, relevant candidate pipelines—not just volume, but people who actually fit the role and the client. Candidate profiles sent to clients are clean, thoughtful, and well-organized Searches move faster and feel more controlled Internal systems, documentation, and workflows become cleaner and more useful over time because you’re constantly tightening them. The organization has more capacity to grow because the engine behind the scenes is running well. Pax’s quality and experience improve as capacity grows.

Why This Role Matters This is an early, foundational hire at Pax. You’ll help build the engine behind the scenes—sourcing talent, organizing searches, and creating the systems that allow a boutique firm to scale without losing quality. You’ll work closely with the founder and have real influence on how Pax operates day to day.

raw.title: Business Manager (Sales & Commercial Support)
raw.excerpt: Our client is a US medical device company.  They design, develop, and sell clinical products used in hospitals and emergency medicine, and their lead product is commercially available across the United States and supported by published, peer-reviewed research.
raw.description:
Our client is a US medical device company. They design, develop, and sell clinical products used in hospitals and emergency medicine, and their lead product is commercially available across the United States and supported by published, peer-reviewed research. They are small, they are growing, and the leadership team is in the work every day.

You will be the person who helps them grow. You report to and work side-by-side with the VP of Sales & Marketing, and you support the wider leadership team. The seat has two halves. The first is commercial: researching hospitals, health systems, EMS organizations, and distributors, finding the people inside them who actually make decisions, and opening conversations that turn into opportunities. The second is operational: keeping the business running underneath those conversations — purchase orders, fulfillment, inventory coordination, records, and reporting.

This is deliberately not a task-taking role. Our client is looking for someone who will learn the business, contribute ideas, create opportunities, and progressively take ownership of processes as the company grows. The schedule is Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM US Mountain Standard Time. Mountain Standard Time in this client's state does not observe daylight saving, so that window stays exactly where it is all year — you always know what your day looks like.

Key Responsibilities

Sales & Commercial

  • Research hospitals, health systems, EMS organizations, distributors, and other potential customers, and build target account lists from the ground up.
  • Identify the key clinical and business decision-makers inside each target account.
  • Run prospecting and lead generation across email, LinkedIn, phone, and other channels.
  • Develop new sales opportunities and keep consistent, disciplined follow-up on every prospect.
  • Communicate professionally with physicians, clinicians, department managers, hospital leadership, distributors, and other customers.
  • Maintain CRM records: leads, opportunities, activities, and follow-up.
  • Schedule sales meetings, product presentations, and customer follow-up.
  • Support the company's independent sales representatives and distribution partners.
  • Assist with marketing initiatives, including social media, email campaigns, conferences, presentations, and sales materials.
  • Work directly with the VP of Sales & Marketing to execute sales and marketing priorities.

Business Operations

  • Support customer and vendor onboarding.
  • Assist with purchase orders, order processing, fulfillment, and shipment tracking.
  • Help coordinate inventory and manufacturing-related activities.
  • Maintain organized company records, documents, and shared files.
  • Support distributor and customer administrative needs.
  • Assist with sales and operational reporting.
  • Coordinate meetings, conferences, and other company activities.
  • Provide general operational and project support to the leadership team.
  • Learn and progressively take ownership of the day-to-day business processes.

Requirements

  • Strong written and verbal English communication. You will be on video calls and outbound phone calls with US healthcare professionals and business leaders throughout your working day.
  • Availability Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM US Mountain Standard Time.
  • Comfortable making outbound calls and initiating conversations with prospective customers and healthcare professionals.
  • Strong research and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently identify contacts, information, and potential business opportunities rather than working only from a list you are handed.
  • Highly organized and capable of managing multiple priorities without dropping any of them.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, able to take direction, learn quickly, and eventually take ownership of projects independently.
  • A reliable home-office environment that supports participating in video meetings throughout the workday.

Preferred Qualifications

  • B2B sales, business development, or lead generation experience.
  • Healthcare, hospital, medical device, or other professional sales environments.
  • CRM and lead-management systems.
  • LinkedIn and social media.
  • Email marketing and prospecting.
  • Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Canva, ChatGPT, and Gemini.
  • Zoom and other virtual communication platforms.
  • Prior experience working with US-based companies, customers, or sales teams.

Healthcare or medical device experience is preferred but not required. Our client is willing to train the right individual who demonstrates strong sales instincts, professionalism, initiative, and a genuine desire to learn.

Tools & Software

  • CRM and lead-management system (your primary daily platform)
  • Microsoft 365: Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams
  • LinkedIn, including Sales Navigator where provided
  • Email marketing and email prospecting tools
  • Canva
  • ChatGPT and Gemini
  • Zoom and other virtual meeting platforms
  • Hubstaff for time tracking, standard on every Remote Raven placement

Equipment & Home Office

  • Windows-based computer preferred.
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection.
  • Webcam and a professional-quality headset and microphone for customer and internal video calls.
  • Dual-monitor setup preferred for productivity.
  • A computer capable of reliably running Microsoft 365, a CRM, Canva, Zoom and Teams, and multiple web applications at the same time.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You are sales-minded, and genuinely comfortable creating opportunities that did not exist yesterday.
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a physician or a hospital department head — and you know the difference between sounding confident and pretending to know something you do not.
  • You are persistent. A prospect who has not replied to three emails is a puzzle to you, not a closed door.
  • You are precise with detail, because on the operations half of this seat a wrong figure on a purchase order becomes a real shipment to a real hospital.
  • You keep your own records current without being chased, because you know a CRM nobody trusts is worse than no CRM at all.
  • You are comfortable in a small, fast-moving company where the shape of the job grows every quarter.
  • You are curious about medical devices, clinical selling, and how hospitals actually buy things.
  • You bring ideas to the table, not just completed tasks.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Up to $8/hour
  • 100% remote work
  • Full-time role

We hire for the long haul, so a steady track record of staying and growing always moves you up our list.

To apply:

Ensure your LinkedIn profile and resume are up-to-date and comprehensive (submit a comprehensive resume in English, PDF format), and complete the assessment in this link: Aptive Test

A quick note on how we will reach you: our recruitment team communicates primarily through Telegram, using the mobile number on your application and resume. Please make sure that number is active and registered on Telegram, since this is where screening and interview scheduling happen. If it is not registered yet, you can set it up right after you apply — it takes only a few minutes and keeps your application moving without delay.

By applying, you consent to being contacted via the contact information provided in your application for recruitment purposes only.

Because of the volume of applications we receive, we're only able to follow up directly with candidates whose experience closely matches this role. raw.description:
Data Analyst / Data Engineer – SQL, BI & Data Analytics | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Data Analyst / Data Engineer to transform business data into reliable reporting, actionable insights, and scalable data systems.

Depending on your experience, this role may lean toward data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or a combination of these areas.

You’ll work with SQL, dashboards, reporting tools, databases, and data pipelines to help teams better understand performance and make informed business decisions.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to explain data clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

What You’ll Own

Data Analysis & Business Insights

  • Collect, clean, organize, and analyze business data
  • Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and performance drivers
  • Translate raw data into meaningful business insights
  • Investigate data questions and provide evidence-based recommendations
  • Support stakeholders with ad hoc analysis and recurring reporting needs

SQL & Data Management

  • Write, maintain, and optimize SQL queries
  • Extract and combine data from multiple sources
  • Work with relational databases and structured datasets
  • Validate datasets for completeness and accuracy
  • Troubleshoot inconsistencies across reporting and source systems

Dashboards & Business Intelligence

  • Develop and maintain dashboards using tools such as:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
    • Similar BI platforms
  • Build recurring reports for business stakeholders
  • Create clear visualizations that make complex information easier to understand
  • Maintain consistent definitions and reporting logic across dashboards

Data Pipelines & Integrations

  • Build or maintain data pipelines and integrations
  • Help connect business systems and reporting environments
  • Support reliable movement of data between platforms
  • Troubleshoot pipeline and integration issues
  • Improve the scalability and reliability of data workflows

Reporting Automation

  • Automate recurring reporting and data preparation processes
  • Reduce manual spreadsheet and reporting work
  • Build repeatable workflows for common reporting requirements
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency
  • Help ensure stakeholders have timely access to reliable information

Data Quality & Reliability

  • Monitor and improve data accuracy
  • Identify missing, duplicated, or inconsistent information
  • Validate reporting outputs against source data
  • Improve processes that support reliable reporting
  • Maintain organized documentation around reporting and data workflows

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements
  • Translate business questions into analytical requirements
  • Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Explain trends, metrics, and recommendations in practical business terms
  • Collaborate across teams to improve data accessibility and reporting

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or a related role
  • Strong hands-on SQL skills
  • Experience with Excel and/or Google Sheets
  • Experience using at least one BI or visualization platform such as:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
    • Similar tools
  • Familiarity with databases and data warehouses
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to identify patterns and insights within complex datasets
  • Strong attention to data accuracy and reporting reliability
  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Professional working English
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Python for data analysis or automation
  • Experience building or maintaining data pipelines
  • Experience integrating data from multiple systems
  • Familiarity with cloud-based databases or data warehouses
  • Experience automating recurring reporting workflows
  • Experience with data modeling and reporting architecture
  • Experience supporting business intelligence or executive reporting

Tools & Technologies

SQL | Excel | Google Sheets | Power BI | Tableau | Looker | Python | Databases | Data Warehouses | Data Pipelines | BI & Reporting Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Enjoy turning messy data into clear, reliable information
  • Are comfortable working deeply with SQL and datasets
  • Question inconsistencies instead of accepting numbers at face value
  • Can move between technical analysis and business conversations
  • Look for opportunities to automate repetitive reporting
  • Care about data accuracy and reporting reliability
  • Can explain complex findings in simple, actionable terms
  • Take ownership of analytical problems from question through insight

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include writing SQL queries, cleaning datasets, updating dashboards, investigating business trends, or automating a recurring report.

Depending on the project, you may also maintain data pipelines, troubleshoot reporting inconsistencies, work with stakeholders to define new metrics, or present findings to business leaders.

In short: you turn company data into reliable reporting, useful insights, and better business decisions.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accuracy and reliability of reporting
  • Quality and usability of dashboards
  • Timely delivery of recurring reports and analysis
  • SQL query and reporting efficiency
  • Reduction in manual reporting processes
  • Reliability of data pipelines and integrations
  • Improvement in overall data quality
  • Stakeholder confidence in reporting and insights

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Data / Technical Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have experience with SQL, data analytics, business intelligence, dashboards, reporting, or data engineering and enjoy turning complex data into clear business insights, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build reliable data systems that support smarter business decisions.
