title: Inside Sales Representative- Fitness Education Certifications
description: ISSA is looking for an Inside Sales Representative!

raw.title: Inside Sales Representative- Fitness Education Certifications
raw.excerpt: ISSA is looking for an Inside Sales Representative!
raw.description:
ISSA is looking for an Inside Sales Representative!

Key Details You Need to Know:

  • Now hiring for our upcoming (November) training class
  • Compensation:Base salary of $40,000, with an uncapped commission structure bringing your On-Target Earnings (OTE) to $100,000.
  • Free enrollment in the Certified Personal Trainer (CPT) course starting on Day 1!
  • Remote position (must reside in an ISSA-eligible state: (AZ, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, NC, NV, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WI)
  • Core business hours: 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM, Monday–Friday (Arizona Time).
  • Work-to-goal environment: motivated sellers can work beyond their assigned shift to exceed goals and maximize earnings

About ISSA: ISSA is an education and certification company for fitness trainers, personal trainers, strength and conditioning coaches, nutritionists, nutrition coaches, yoga instructors, health coaches, medical professionals, and more! For over 35 years, ISSA has created a personal fitness training program to merge gym experience with practical and applied sciences. With over 250 employees, we have certified nearly 500,000 trainers in 174 countries. We were recently recognized as a Best Place to Work and Healthiest Employer by The Phoenix Business Journal, Fastest Growing Private Company by Inc. Southwest Regionals, and Top Workplace by USA Today!

We are adding an Inside Sales Representative (Fitness Education Advisor) to our team of relationship-builders who are laser-focused on providing exceptional service to our students. We are tenacious and resilient in pursuing personal and professional success while incorporating fun into every day!

So What's the Job?

We’re looking for competitive, coachable, and high-energy Inside Sales Representatives who thrive in a fast-paced, phone-first environment. You’ll engage with prospective students, uncover their goals, and guide them to the right ISSA program, all while driving toward individual and team performance goals.

At ISSA, you’re not just selling, you’re helping people transform their lives through education. We believe in doing the right thing, growing together, and celebrating the wins that matter.

WHAT is ISSA looking for?

  • Make 120–200 outbound calls daily to prospective students from warm and cold lists.
  • Conduct high-energy phone consultations to identify goals, build rapport, and recommend training programs.
  • Manage your pipeline through a CRM with disciplined notes, tasks, and follow-ups.
  • Close sales in a short cycle (same-day to 7 days) using ethical persuasion and student-first judgment.
  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly enrollment and revenue targets.
  • Collaborate with peers and leaders to improve scripts, objection handling, and conversion rates.
  • Represent ISSA’s mission and brand with integrity and enthusiasm.

Required Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of phone-based inside sales experience in a quota-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to sustain high activity levels (120–200+ dials per day).
  • Experience in short-cycle or one-call closes (same day to 7 days).
  • Comfort working shift-based schedules in a fully remote setup.
  • Strong verbal communication, active listening, and empathy.
  • Track record of hitting or exceeding individual sales targets.
  • Familiarity with CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar).
  • Continuously identifies opportunities to leverage AI tools for efficiency and innovation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in B2C or consumer-style B2B sales environments.
  • Prior success with outbound sales or lead follow-up campaigns.
  • High energy and resilience in competitive, metrics-driven settings.
  • Interest in the fitness, health, or education industries.
  • Prior ISSA certification or wellness industry exposure.
  • Advanced CRM hygiene and data management habits.

WHO is ISSA looking for?

Skills can be developed. Experience can be built. What's harder to teach, and what we pay close attention to, is mindset. The qualifications below are specific to this role. But across every role at ISSA, we're looking for the same kind of person.

  • Someone who leads with curiosity. Who asks "why do we do it this way?" as a genuine question, not a complaint.
  • Someone humble enough to know what they don't know, and bold enough to challenge the way things have always been done.
  • Someone who can advocate hard for an idea and then fully commit when the team goes a different direction.
  • Someone who takes ownership of their mistakes, shares credit for their wins, and believes the best idea should win regardless of who had it.

We're looking for people who are personally invested in healthy living, not because it's their job, but because they believe in its power to change lives. You don't have to have it all figured out. You just have to care.

We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for growth-oriented, mission-driven, and genuinely invested in doing something that matters. If that sounds like you, you'll fit in great here!

Anything else? Absolutely! Benefits and Perks:

This is a place where every day we are inspired by our teammates, encouraging each other to be our best. The environment is friendly and upbeat! And we feel it’s important to reward our team with competitive pay and benefits. Here are some of the highlights:

Free Certifications: Who wants to be their best self? WE DO! As an ISSA team member, you have access to our courses and certifications…at no expense! Additionally, you'll receive exclusive discounts on leading products in the fitness industry. Cool, right? Employees can also enroll up to 5 friends/family members each year in our courses...FOR FREE!

Health & Wellness Reimbursement: If our company’s mission is to encourage healthy living, we need to walk the talk and ensure each employee is supported in their wellness journey! Employees can submit fitness purchases (gym membership, fitness equipment, classes) and professional and mental health purchases (personal learning courses, wellness apps, art classes, and more) for reimbursement up to $50/month…$600/year.

Work-Life Synergy: Our Team members start with 3 weeks of PTO each year and can earn up to 6 weeks each year! And everyone at ISSA gets 9 paid national holidays every year...PLUS 1 floating holiday! Work hard, play hard!

Parental Time Off: We support our team members as they grow their families! Eligible employees giving birth can receive up to 12 weeks of paid leave, while other parents welcoming a new child (including partners and adoptive/foster parents) receive up to 6 weeks of paid bonding leave.

Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: A key component to living a healthy lifestyle is having access to the care we (and our families) need. We offer 2 medical insurance plans accompanied by Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Savings Account (FSA) options, as well as Dental and Vision coverage. And you don’t have to wait forever! Eligibility begins on the 1st of the month after you start.

Team Building: We may be remote, but we don’t have to be alone! We host a monthly schedule of virtual team activities, town halls, brown bag lunches, and other special events…so many fun ways for us to connect and support one another.

Tools To Do The Job: We ensure you are hooked up with the tools, equipment, and systems you need. We begin the process before your start date, so you are ready to rock ‘n roll on your first day. We also provide a monthly work-from-home allowance!

100% Remote Work: You can say goodbye to long commutes because all of our roles can be performed from the comfort of your own home. To connect and communicate more effectively, ISSA is a camera-friendly culture in which cameras are on for scheduled meetings. We have found that this bridges the gap that can exist since we are not working together in an office.

What Else? We have a 401(k) company match and 100% company-paid life/AD&D insurance/short-term disability. We also offer an employee assistance program to assist with work-life concerns (legal, financial, and mental health). Our ultimate goal is to support you and your overall wellness.

Transform your career at ISSA!

Working Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM U.S. Mountain Time

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an AI Developer to help build the next generation of AI-powered solutions as they transition into a native-AI agency.

This is a hands-on role focused on designing, building, and maintaining AI agents using modern AI development tools and automation frameworks. You’ll own projects from scoping through deployment, working closely with leadership to build scalable, production-ready AI systems.

If you enjoy building AI agents, solving complex problems, and taking ownership of technical decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

AI Agent Development

  • Design, build, and maintain AI agents that power the company’s transition to a native-AI agency.
  • Own the full development lifecycle from scoping through deployment.
  • Monitor agent performance, identify failures, and continuously improve AI capabilities.

Tooling & Orchestration

  • Build reliable AI workflows using Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Inngest.
  • Develop scalable automation pipelines and event-driven workflows.

Backend & Data Layer

  • Develop and manage solutions using Supabase.
  • Build and maintain database schemas, authentication, and real-time functionality to support AI agents.

Technical Ownership

  • Take full ownership of AI architecture, tooling decisions, and production quality.
  • Work independently while making technical decisions with minimal oversight.

Required Experience & Skills

  • At least 1 year of professional experience building AI agents or AI-powered applications.
  • Experience with Claude Code and/or OpenAI Codex for AI development and code generation.
  • Working knowledge of Inngest for event-driven orchestration and background jobs.
  • Hands-on experience with Supabase, including database design, authentication, and real-time features.
  • Comfortable working independently as the primary AI developer.
  • Availability to work U.S. Mountain Time (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM).

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You take ownership and proactively identify what needs to be built.
  • You’re comfortable working in a fast-changing environment with evolving requirements.
  • You communicate clearly and proactively, especially when blocked or shipping new work.
  • You focus on practical, working solutions and know when to prototype versus optimize.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review AI agent logs and resolve production issues.
  • Build new AI agents and extend Inngest workflows.
  • Develop and maintain Supabase databases and integrations.
  • Participate in standups or async team updates.
  • Document completed work and communicate technical decisions.
  • Own projects from design through deployment without handoffs.

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. AI Technical Assessment
  4. Recruiter Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating your experience across multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself and discuss your experience building AI agents, working with tools like Claude Code, Codex, Inngest, and Supabase, and solving real-world technical challenges. Your video will be reviewed before moving forward to the next stage.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re excited about building AI agents, owning technical decisions, and helping shape the future of an AI-first company, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today to join a fast-moving team building production-ready AI solutions.

We are looking for a results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) with proven closing experience to take ownership of the full sales cycle—from outbound prospecting to closing deals. This role goes beyond traditional SDR responsibilities and is ideal for someone who can confidently move prospects through the funnel and convert opportunities into revenue.

  • Identify, prospect, and engage high-quality leads through outbound channels (cold calls, emails, LinkedIn outreach).

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Full-Stack Software Engineer to design, build, and maintain modern web applications across frontend and backend systems.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone comfortable working across the full development lifecycle — from building user-facing applications and backend services to designing APIs, working with databases, troubleshooting production issues, and supporting cloud deployments.

You’ll collaborate with product, design, and engineering stakeholders while using modern development practices and AI-assisted engineering tools to ship reliable, scalable software.

What You’ll Own

Full-Stack Application Development

  • Develop and maintain frontend and backend applications
  • Build scalable, reliable, and maintainable application features
  • Translate product and technical requirements into working software
  • Write clean, well-structured, and reusable code
  • Improve existing applications as requirements evolve

Frontend Development

  • Build responsive and user-friendly web interfaces
  • Work with modern frontend frameworks and component-based architectures
  • Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and services
  • Troubleshoot frontend performance and functionality issues

Backend, APIs & Integrations

Testing, Debugging & Code Quality

Cloud, Deployment & Development Workflows

  • Work with cloud infrastructure and deployment workflows
  • Support application releases and production deployments
  • Use Git and version-control best practices
  • Contribute to reliable development and deployment processes

AI-Assisted Software Development

  • Use modern AI development tools to improve engineering productivity
  • Apply AI-assisted workflows to coding, debugging, research, and development
  • Evaluate new AI development capabilities where they can improve execution
  • Maintain strong engineering judgment while using AI-assisted tools

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional software development experience
  • Strong experience with at least one modern frontend framework
  • Backend development experience using a modern programming language and/or framework
  • Experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases

  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and scalable code

  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools

  • Familiarity with automated testing and CI/CD workflows
  • Experience working with cloud-native applications
  • Experience collaborating directly with product and design teams

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Enjoy building across both frontend and backend systems
  • Take ownership of features from development through deployment
  • Write code with scalability and maintainability in mind
  • Can independently troubleshoot technical problems
  • Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Are comfortable learning new technologies quickly
  • Use AI development tools thoughtfully to improve speed and productivity

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include developing frontend features, building backend services, integrating APIs, working with databases, reviewing code, and troubleshooting application issues.

You may also participate in technical planning, collaborate with product and design stakeholders, support deployments, and use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding and problem-solving.

In short: you build, improve, and maintain reliable web applications across the full technology stack.

  • Consistent delivery of reliable application features
  • Clean, maintainable, and scalable code
  • Stable frontend and backend systems
  • Reliable API and third-party integrations
  • Effective debugging and resolution of production issues
  • Strong code quality and testing practices
  • Smooth deployments and development workflows

raw.description:
Rockstar is recruiting for a mission-driven company focused on supporting US small businesses. Statistics show that 50% of US Small Businesses fail within the first 5 years. Of those that fail, 82% cite cash flow management and visibility as the primary reason for failure. This company is on a mission to change that.

The company offers bookkeeping services to US small businesses that give them a clear picture of their business performance. It integrates its bookkeeping service directly within the POS systems and bank accounts that these small businesses already use, eliminating the need for them to use Quickbooks, Xero, or separate accounting software.

Role Overview

The company is looking for a highly skilled and experienced Bookkeeper to join its team. The Bookkeeper will play a critical role in maintaining accurate financial records and overseeing day-to-day accounting tasks for the small businesses using its bookkeeping service. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in bookkeeping principles, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

The Bookkeeper will work directly within the company’s software system to perform bookkeeping tasks. Strong candidates will be comfortable learning new software systems and ideal candidates will be strong communicators about opportunities for improving both their own workflow and the company’s software.

Responsibilities:

  • Financial Record Maintenance: Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records, general ledger entries, and bank reconciliations for the small business users. This includes reaching out to the small businesses to collect additional information as needed as well as organizing and maintaining document records for each business.
  • Financial Reporting: Prepare monthly financial reports, including income statements and balance sheets.
  • Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline bookkeeping processes, improve efficiency, and enhance internal controls. Implement best practices and automation solutions to optimize financial operations.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Stay current with accounting standards, regulations, and industry trends to ensure compliance with all reporting requirements. Implement new accounting standards as required.
  • Special Projects: Participate in special projects and initiatives as assigned by management, contributing financial expertise and insights to support strategic decision-making.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in bookkeeping or accounting roles, with a focus on general ledger maintenance and financial reporting.
  • Proficiency in common bookkeeping software (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero) and excitement to learn the company’s bookkeeping software. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial record-keeping.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact professionally with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and as part of a collaborative team environment.
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and integrity in handling sensitive financial information.

Successful CSAs apply their analytical aptitude and communication skills to resolve technical and functional issues, communicate directly with customers in a professional manner, and take pride in delivering quality solutions in a timely manner. About Seven Starling

Seven Starling is revolutionizing women's behavioral health through our clinically-validated virtual care platform. As a venture-backed, rapidly scaling startup at the forefront of maternal healthcare innovation, we've developed a groundbreaking clinical model that combines specialized therapy, peer support, and medication management to effectively treat perinatal mood disorders. Our approach delivers exceptional results — 90% of patients experience clinically significant symptom improvement.

We've established strategic partnerships with leading health plans including UnitedHealthcare, Cigna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and Aetna, plus a growing network of OBGYN clinics nationwide, positioning us for accelerated growth in the $50B+ women's behavioral health market.

About the role

We’re seeking a results-driven Clinical Recruiter to accelerate our hiring of therapists and nurse practitioners for 1099 contractor and W2 positions. This role reports to the Senior Manager of Provider Operations. We’re looking for someone who thinks like a sales professional and who is focused on building a strong provider pipeline by finding better ways to reach and win over specialized clinicians.

What You'll Do

  • Execute full-cycle recruitment of licensed mental health therapists (LCSW, LMFT, LPC) and nurse practitioners for 1099 contractor and W2 positions, from initial outreach through onboarding handoff, coordinating with credentialing and onboarding teams and keeping accurate records in the ATS

  • Execute our sourcing playbook to build strong candidate pipelines across multiple states, and serve as a subject matter expert who helps inform sourcing strategy decisions

  • Balance recruitment targets and business needs with our commitment to the highest clinical quality standards, applying the standards set with clinical leadership and ensuring all hires meet licensing and credentialing requirements

  • Identify and recommend new sourcing channels, including professional associations, social media, referral programs, and industry events

  • Represent our brand to candidates and contribute to our clinical hiring marketing and storytelling approach to attract exceptional talent

  • Own your numbers: track, analyze, and report on pipeline health, conversion, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and ROI by channel, and optimize conversion at each stage of the funnel

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to drive key KPI’s and ensure a seamless experience for candidates

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of high-volume recruitment experience, with demonstrated experience in clinical mental health recruiting

  • A strong talent sourcer, comfortable with cold outreach

  • Data-driven recruiter with experience using recruitment analytics to drive decision-making

  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding hiring targets

  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building abilities

  • Sales mentality: comfortable with targets, metrics, and performance accountability

  • Team player that loves the fast pace of startup environments and is passionate about our mission

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Lever

  • Experience at a venture-backed startup

Details

  • Full-time; remote

  • The compensation for this position is $90,000

  • Meaningful equity package with significant upside potential

Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive paid time off

  • Competitive parental leave policy

  • One-time stipend to enhance your work from home experience

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401K

  • Bereavement leave, including for miscarriage and pregnancy loss

  • Annual stipend for your choice of wellness benefits

  • Annual professional development stipend

  • Virtual team events

Seven Starling is an equal opportunity employer, passionately committed to equitable hiring and boldly dedicated to diversity in our teams. We do not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related conditions), age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, uniformed service member status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.excerpt: THE POSITION: Medical Information is a critically important customer-facing function that supports the safe and effective use of pharmaceutical company products by providing timely, scientifically balanced, evidence based, non-promotional information in response to unsolicited requests from healthcare professionals, patients, caregivers, and payers.
raw.description:
THE POSITION:

Medical Information is a critically important customer-facing function that supports the safe and effective use of pharmaceutical company products by providing timely, scientifically balanced, evidence based, non-promotional information in response to unsolicited requests from healthcare professionals, patients, caregivers, and payers. Medical Information also plays an important role in post-marketing managing of adverse events and product complaints. As a functional member of the Medical Information Contact Center (MICC) team, this position delivers industry-leading services, which include Contact Center staffing for responding to product information requests as well as identifying and managing of adverse events and/or product quality issues. This position requires clinical and therapeutic knowledge, critical and analytical thinking, and customer/patient-centric approach. Medical Information Representatives typically support multiple pharmaceutical clients, products, and therapeutic areas.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

Medical Information Support

  • Independently respond to unsolicited medical information inquiries from physicians, pharmacists, nurses, and other health care professionals, consumers, and payers.
  • Utilize medical information and clinical expertise to identify, research, and critically evaluate medical literature to create responses to medical information inquiries.
  • Identify & accurately document adverse events and product complaints during customer interactions.
  • Perform intake & generate accurate adverse event and product complaint reports in compliance with EVERSANA-MICC and client standard operating procedures.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of FDA’s post-marketing adverse event reporting regulations and safety terminology.
  • Ability to make accurate assessments regarding level & depth of information required.
  • Utilize writing skills for adverse event and product complaint narrative during intake as well as documentation of medical inquiry.
  • Independently Handle requests across multiple channels and platforms (phone, email, CRM, chat, etc.)
  • Coordinate & support processes necessary for responding to product quality-related complaints. This process may involve collaborating with personnel in the following departments: Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and the complainant.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of products, therapeutic areas, and client specific requirements.
  • Ensure accurate documentation, high quality, and excellent customer service.
  • Staffing at scientific medical affairs booths.
  • On-call responsibilities on an assigned basis.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, it is the policy of EVERSANA to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by an employee with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for EVERSANA. If reasonable accommodation is needed to perform the essential functions of your job position, please contact Human Resources.

EXPECTATIONS OF THE JOB:

  • Metrics: Independently contribute towards process improvement which positively impacts metrics associated with activities of the Medical Communications l Contact Center; metrics are subject to change annually or more often as deemed necessary.
  • Customer Services: Maintain and enhance customer service associated with activities of the Medical Information Contact Center. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with demonstrated ability to engage effectively with healthcare professionals, patients, and caregivers. Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within teams.
  • Hours: Able to work full time (40+ hours per week, typically Monday to Friday) and be flexible with work scheduling as required by clients and management.
  • Travel: In general, this position does not travel; however, the incumbent may need to be able to travel up to 10%

The above list reflects the general details necessary to describe the expectations of the position and shall not be construed as the only expectations that may be assigned for the position.

An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the expectations listed above.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • Education: Associate, Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Nursing or a related healthcare discipline (e.g. allied health, clinical sciences) from an accredited institution.
  • Experience and/or Training: Strong clinical and healthcare background with excellent verbal/written communications skills along with the ability to work independently and as part of a team. Strong healthcare or clinical background with the ability to interpret and communicate medical information clearly and accurately.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Education: Advanced healthcare degree or higher in healthcare-related field or equivalent
  • Licenses/Certificates: Registered Nurse (RN) or equivalent licensure.
  • Experience and/or Training: Minimum 2 years of work experience in medical and healthcare, pharmaceutical industry, or equivalent. Direct clinical or patient-facing healthcare experience is strongly preferred. Experience in a Contact Center.
  • Technology/Equipment: Technology proficiency in the areas of telephony, Medical Information database, Microsoft Office, and video conference platforms.
  • Knowledge: Therapeutic expertise. Ability to critically evaluate medical literature. Medical Information contact center systems and processes. Experience in Drug Information or a specialty area, particularly in Oncology, Hematology, Immunology, rare disease, Neurology, Cardiology, or other specialties.
  • Positive Attitude and Energy: Exhibits an upbeat attitude, a genuine interest in others and a sense of humor. Energizes others and heightens morale through her/his attitude.
  • Communication Skills: Possesses the ability to develop and articulate ideas and information that generate understanding and creates a climate that motivates and encourages others to participate.
  • Innovator: Transforms creative ideas into original solutions that positively impact the company’s performance.
  • Highly Principled: Proves to be a professional of unquestionable integrity, credibility and character who demonstrates high moral and ethical behavior.

PHYSICAL/MENTAL DEMANDS AND WORKING ENVIRONMENT:

The physical and mental requirements along with the work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an individual encounters while performing the essential functions of this position.

Office: While performing the essential functions of this job the employee is frequently required to reach, grasp, stand and/or sit for long periods of time (up to 90% of the shift), walk, talk and hear; occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderately quiet, with frequent interruptions and multiple demands.

raw.description:
The Appointment Setter will work with the Marketing and Sales Departments to generate appointments with leads and prospects, as well as work to schedule reviews with the current client base.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Get information, such as contact details and signatures, from potential leads and clients for follow-up
  • Confidently answer questions and rebuff excuses to meet objectives
  • Consistently meet daily and weekly quotas
  • Reach out to prospects identified through lead generation activities
  • Generate qualified leads primarily through calling campaigns
  • Gather intelligence about the accounts you are assigned to input into CRM
  • Schedule qualified appointments for the sales team
  • Understand how to navigate a CRM system to gain insights and record activity
  • Provide data and quantitative analysis on lead quality to help improve lead acquisition
  • Participate in marketing and lead generation email campaigns
  • Distribute marketing materials and set appointments to/for interested customers
  • Provide the proper feedback to the Sales Manager in a timely fashion
  • Accurately keep records on customer information
  • Develop your sales skills and learn the optimal sales process
  • Perform other duties or responsibilities as required

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Sales experience is a big plus, but not required.
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Desire to be successful
  • Prior customer service experience preferred
  • Professional and courteous demeanor
  • Excellent verbal communication skills is a must, as is the ability to build rapport with clients
  • Previous experience in cold calling, sales, customer service, or other related fields
  • Strong interest in pursuing a sales career with the ability to meet and exceed goals and expectations
  • Strong and proven online research skills
  • Self-motivated and creative thinker with the drive to learn, grow and succeed.
  • Ability to consistently produce reliable results on time.
  • Highly motivated and detail-oriented individual who thrives in a startup team environment
  • A strong communicator and have a knack for being quick on your feet
  • Excellent communication skills including eloquence, active listening and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to learn about multiple products and sell without being aggressive
  • Ability to work within a team and independently as needed
  • Relentless determination!!
  • Excellent time management skills to fulfill quotas within a specific period

If you have an interest and meet these requirements, we encourage you to apply online!

  • Must be a United States Citizen to Apply 
  • EOE Principles Only.
